4.80.s:
varṣāṃte pratimāmiṣṭāṃ kārayitvā suśobhanām..
svarṇakena yathā śaktyā śaṃkhaśārṅgavibhūṣitām .. 17 ..
4.80.d:
वर्षांते प्रतिमामिष्टां कारयित्वा सुशोभनाम्॥
स्वर्णकेन यथा शक्त्या शंखशार्ङ्गविभूषिताम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.80.m: At the end of the year, having had a beloved, very beautiful image made / of gold according to one's means, adorned with a conch and the Śārṅga bow,

4.80.s:
puṣpavastrayugacchannāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
dvādaśa brāhmaṇāṃstatra bhojayitvā kṣamāpayet ..18..
4.80.d:
पुष्पवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नां ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
द्वादश ब्राह्मणांस्तत्र भोजयित्वा क्षमापयेत् ॥18॥
4.80.m: covered with a pair of flower-patterned garments, one should present it to a brāhmaṇa. / Having fed twelve brāhmaṇas there, one should ask their pardon.

4.80.s:
dvādaśātra pradātavyāḥ kuṃbhāḥ sānnajalākṣatāḥ ..
chatropānadyugaiḥ sārddhaṃ dakṣiṇābhiśca bhārata .. 19 ..
4.80.d:
द्वादशात्र प्रदातव्याः कुंभाः सान्नजलाक्षताः ॥
छत्रोपानद्युगैः सार्द्धं दक्षिणाभिश्च भारत ॥ 19 ॥
4.80.m: Twelve jars filled with cooked grain, water, and unbroken grains are to be given here, / together with pairs of parasols and sandals, and with fees, O Bhārata.

4.80.s:
eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā dvādaśī phalamicchatām ..
yathābhilaṣitānkāmāndadāti nṛpasattama ..4.80.20..
4.80.d:
एषा पुण्या पापहरा द्वादशी फलमिच्छताम् ॥
यथाभिलषितान्कामान्ददाति नृपसत्तम ॥4.80.20॥
4.80.m: This holy, sin-destroying twelfth [lunar day], to those who desire fruit, / grants wishes just as desired, O best of kings.

4.80.s:
pūrayatyakhilānbhaktyā yataścaiṣāṃ manorathān ..
manorathā dvādaśīyaṃ tato lokeṣu viśrutā ..21..
4.80.d:
पूरयत्यखिलान्भक्त्या यतश्चैषां मनोरथान् ॥
मनोरथा द्वादशीयं ततो लोकेषु विश्रुता ॥21॥
4.80.m: And since through devotion it fulfills all their desires, / therefore this twelfth [lunar day] is renowned in the worlds as Manorathā ("Desire-granting").

4.80.s:
upoṣyaitāṃ tribhuvanaṃ labdhamindreṇa vai purā ..
ādityāśceṣṭitāḥ putrā dhanamauśanasā tathā .. 22 ..
4.80.d:
उपोष्यैतां त्रिभुवनं लब्धमिन्द्रेण वै पुरा ॥
आदित्याश्चेष्टिताः पुत्रा धनमौशनसा तथा ॥ 22 ॥
4.80.m: Having fasted on this [day] of old, the three worlds were indeed obtained by Indra, / sons were obtained by the Ādityas, and wealth likewise by the son of Uśanas (Śukra).

4.80.s:
dhaumyenādhyayanaṃ prāptamanyaiścābhimataṃ phalam ..
rājarṣibhistathā vipraiḥ strīviṭśūdraiśca bhūtale .. 23 ..
4.80.d:
धौम्येनाध्ययनं प्राप्तमन्यैश्चाभिमतं फलम् ॥
राजर्षिभिस्तथा विप्रैः स्त्रीविट्शूद्रैश्च भूतले ॥ 23 ॥
4.80.m: Vedic study was attained by Dhaumya, and desired fruit by others, / by royal sages, by brāhmaṇas, and on earth by women, vaiśyas, and śūdras.

4.80.s:
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya vratametadupoṣitam ..
tattadāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ viṣṇorārādhanodyataḥ .. 24 ..
4.80.d:
यंयं काममभिध्याय व्रतमेतदुपोषितम् ॥
तत्तदाप्नोत्यसंदिग्धं विष्णोराराधनोद्यतः ॥ 24 ॥
4.80.m: Whatever desire one ponders while observing this votive fast, / that very thing one undoubtedly obtains, intent upon the worship of Viṣṇu.

4.80.s:
aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam ..
rogābhibhūtaścārogyaṃ kanyā prāpnoti satpatim .. 25 ..
4.80.d:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो लभते धनम् ॥
रोगाभिभूतश्चारोग्यं कन्या प्राप्नोति सत्पतिम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.80.m: The childless obtains a son; the poor obtains wealth; / one afflicted by disease [attains] freedom from illness; a maiden obtains a good husband.

4.80.s:
samāgamaṃ pravasanairupoṣyaitāmavāpyate ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti mṛtaḥ svarge ca modate .. 26 ..
4.80.d:
समागमं प्रवसनैरुपोष्यैतामवाप्यते ॥
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति मृतः स्वर्गे च मोदते ॥ 26 ॥
4.80.m: Reunion with those living abroad is obtained by fasting on this [day]; / one attains all desires, and upon death rejoices in heaven.

4.80.s:
nāputro nādhano jyeṣṭho viyogī na ca nirguṇaḥ ..
upoṣyaitadvrataṃ martyaḥ strīśūdro vāpi jāyate .. 27 ..
4.80.d:
नापुत्रो नाधनो ज्येष्ठो वियोगी न च निर्गुणः ॥
उपोष्यैतद्व्रतं मर्त्यः स्त्रीशूद्रो वापि जायते ॥ 27 ॥
4.80.m: Neither childless, nor poor, nor an outcaste, nor separated [from kin], nor devoid of virtues / is a mortal born, whether a woman or even a śūdra, after fasting on this votive observance.

4.80.s:
svargaloke sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāmayutāni ca ..
bhogānabhimatānbhuktvā tatratatra yathecchayā .. 28 ..
4.80.d:
स्वर्गलोके सहस्राणि वर्षाणामयुतानि च ॥
भोगानभिमतान्भुक्त्वा तत्रतत्र यथेच्छया ॥ 28 ॥
4.80.m: In the heavenly world, for tens of thousands of years, / having enjoyed desired pleasures there at will,

4.80.s:
iha puṇyavatāṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanināṃ laghuśālinām ..
gṛhe prajāyate rājansarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ .. 29 ..
4.80.d:
इह पुण्यवतां नॄणां धनिनां लघुशालिनाम् ॥
गृहे प्रजायते राजन्सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः ॥ 29 ॥
4.80.m: here [on earth], in the house of virtuous, wealthy, and noble men, / one is born, O king, free from all diseases.

4.80.s:
na dvādaśīmupavasanti manorathākhyāṃ naivārcayaṃti puruṣottamamādidevam ..
gobrāhmaṇāṃśca na namaṃti na pūjayaṃti ye te manobhilaṣitaṃ kathamāpnuvaṃti .. 4.80.30 ..
ulkānavamīvratavarṇanam
4.80.d:
न द्वादशीमुपवसन्ति मनोरथाख्यां नैवार्चयंति पुरुषोत्तममादिदेवम् ॥
गोब्राह्मणांश्च न नमंति न पूजयंति ये ते मनोभिलषितं कथमाप्नुवंति ॥ 4.80.30 ॥
उल्कानवमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.80.m:
Those who do not fast on the twelfth [lunar day] named Manorathā, nor worship the Supreme Spirit, the primordial god, / nor bow to or revere cows and brāhmaṇas—how do they obtain their heart's desire?
Description of the Tiladvādaśī Votive Observance

4.81.s:
..yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
alpāyāsena bhagavandhanenālpena vā vibho ..
pāpaṃ praśamamāyāti yena tadvaktumarhasi .. .. 1 ..
4.81.d:
॥युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
अल्पायासेन भगवन्धनेनाल्पेन वा विभो ॥
पापं प्रशममायाति येन तद्वक्तुमर्हसि ॥ ॥ 1 ॥
4.81.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / With little effort, O Blessed One, or with little wealth, O Lord, / by which sin goes to cessation—you ought to speak of that.

4.81.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu pārtha parāṃ puṇyāṃ dvādaśīṃ pāpanāśinīm ..
yāmupoṣya paraṃ puṇyamāpnuyācchraddhayānvitaḥ .. 2 ..
4.81.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु पार्थ परां पुण्यां द्वादशीं पापनाशिनीम् ॥
यामुपोष्य परं पुण्यमाप्नुयाच्छ्रद्धयान्वितः ॥ 2 ॥
4.81.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear, O son of Pṛthā, of the supreme, holy twelfth [lunar day] that destroys sin, / by fasting on which, endowed with faith, one attains supreme merit.

4.81.s:
māghamāse ca saṃprāpte āṣāḍharkṣaṃ bhavedyadi ..
mūlaṃ vā kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ niyatavrataḥ .. 3 ..
4.81.d:
माघमासे च संप्राप्ते आषाढर्क्षं भवेद्यदि ॥
मूलं वा कृष्णपक्षस्य द्वादश्यां नियतव्रतः ॥ 3 ॥
4.81.m: When the month of Māgha arrives, if there should be the asterism of Āṣāḍhā / or Mūla on the twelfth [lunar day] of the dark fortnight, one firm in vows

4.81.s:
gṛhṇīyātpuṇyaphaladaṃ vidhānaṃ tasya me śṛṇu ..
devadevaṃ samabhyarcya susnātaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ .. 4 ..
4.81.d:
गृह्णीयात्पुण्यफलदं विधानं तस्य मे शृणु ॥
देवदेवं समभ्यर्च्य सुस्नातः प्रयतः शुचिः ॥ 4 ॥
4.81.m: should undertake it, which yields holy fruit; listen to its procedure from me: / Having worshipped the God of gods, well-bathed, self-restrained, and pure,

4.81.s:
kṛṣṇanāmnā ca saṃpūjya ekādaśyāṃ mahāmate ..
upoṣito dvitīyehni punaḥ saṃpūjya keśavam .. 5 ..
4.81.d:
कृष्णनाम्ना च संपूज्य एकादश्यां महामते ॥
उपोषितो द्वितीयेह्नि पुनः संपूज्य केशवम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.81.m: having worshipped [him] with the name of Kṛṣṇa on the eleventh [lunar day], O wise one, / having fasted, on the second day, having worshipped Keśava again,

4.81.s:
saṃstūya nāmnā tenaiva kṛṣṇākhyena punaḥpunaḥ ..
dadyāttilāṃśca viprāya kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti .. 6 ..
4.81.d:
संस्तूय नाम्ना तेनैव कृष्णाख्येन पुनःपुनः ॥
दद्यात्तिलांश्च विप्राय कृष्णो मे प्रीयतामिति ॥ 6 ॥
4.81.m: having praised him repeatedly with that very name of Kṛṣṇa, / one should give sesame seeds to a brāhmaṇa, saying, "May Kṛṣṇa be pleased with me."

4.81.s:
tataśca prāśayecchastāṃstathā kṛṣṇatilānnṛpa ..
viṣṇuprīṇanamaṃtrokte samāpte varṣapāraṇe .. 7 ..
4.81.d:
ततश्च प्राशयेच्छस्तांस्तथा कृष्णतिलान्नृप ॥
विष्णुप्रीणनमंत्रोक्ते समाप्ते वर्षपारणे ॥ 7 ॥
4.81.m: And then one should consume the praised black sesame seeds, O king, / when the yearly fast-breaking, pronounced with mantras pleasing to Viṣṇu, is completed.

4.81.s:
kṛṣṇakuṃbhāṃstilaiḥ sārddhaṃ pakvānnena ca saṃyutāḥ ..
chatropānadyugairvastraiḥ sahitā annagarbhiṇaḥ ..
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradeyāste yathāvanmāsasaṃkhyayā .. 8 ..
4.81.d:
कृष्णकुंभांस्तिलैः सार्द्धं पक्वान्नेन च संयुताः ॥
छत्रोपानद्युगैर्वस्त्रैः सहिता अन्नगर्भिणः ॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदेयास्ते यथावन्माससंख्यया ॥ 8 ॥
4.81.m: Black jars filled with sesame seeds, along with cooked food, / provided with umbrellas, pairs of shoes, garments, and filled with grains, / should be properly given to brāhmaṇas according to the number of months.

4.81.s:
tilaprarohājjāyaṃte yāvatsaṃkhyāstilā nṛpa ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ..
arogo jāyate nityaṃ naro janmanijanmani .. 9 ..
4.81.d:
तिलप्ररोहाज्जायंते यावत्संख्यास्तिला नृप ॥
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
अरोगो जायते नित्यं नरो जन्मनिजन्मनि ॥ 9 ॥
4.81.m: As many sesame seeds as are produced from the sprout of a sesame, O king, / for that many thousands of years one is honoured in the world of heaven; / a man is constantly born free from disease in birth after birth.

4.81.s:
aṃdho na badhiraścaiva na kuṣṭhī na ca kutsitaḥ ..
bhavatyetāmuṣitvā tu tilākhyāṃ dvādaśīṃ naraḥ .. 4.81.10 ..
4.81.d:
अंधो न बधिरश्चैव न कुष्ठी न च कुत्सितः ॥
भवत्येतामुषित्वा तु तिलाख्यां द्वादशीं नरः ॥ 4.81.10 ॥
4.81.m: Neither blind, nor deaf, nor a leper, nor deformed / does a man become after observing this twelfth [day] named Tilā.

4.81.s:
anena pārtha vidhinā tiladātā na saṃśayaḥ ..
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairanāyāsena mānavaḥ .. 11 ..
4.81.d:
अनेन पार्थ विधिना तिलदाता न संशयः ॥
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैरनायासेन मानवः ॥ 11 ॥
4.81.m: By this procedure, O son of Pṛthā, the giver of sesame, without a doubt, / is easily liberated from all sins.

4.81.s:
dānaṃ vidhistathā śrāddhaṃ sarvapātakaśāṃtaye ..
nārthaḥ prabhūto nāyāsaḥ śarīre nṛpasattama .. 12 ..
4.81.d:
दानं विधिस्तथा श्राद्धं सर्वपातकशांतये ॥
नार्थः प्रभूतो नायासः शरीरे नृपसत्तम ॥ 12 ॥
4.81.m: The gift, the ritual, and likewise the śrāddha are for the appeasement of all sins; / there is neither great expense nor physical distress, O best of kings.

4.81.s:
sarvopabhoganiratohni pare daśamyāṃ snānaṃ tilaistilanivedanakṛttilāśī ..
dattvā tilāndvijavarāya virājaketu saṃpūjya viṣṇupadavīṃ samupaiti martyaḥ .. 13 ..
sukṛtadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.81.d:
सर्वोपभोगनिरतोह्नि परे दशम्यां स्नानं तिलैस्तिलनिवेदनकृत्तिलाशी ॥
दत्त्वा तिलान्द्विजवराय विराजकेतु संपूज्य विष्णुपदवीं समुपैति मर्त्यः ॥ 13 ॥
सुकृतद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.81.m:
Engrossed in every enjoyment on the previous day, on the tenth [day] bathing with sesame, offering sesame, eating sesame, / giving sesame to an excellent twice-born, [and] worshipping the One with the bird on his banner, a mortal attains the abode of Viṣṇu.
Description of the Sukṛtadvādaśī Vrata.

4.82.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yanna tāpāya vai puṃsāṃ bhavatyāmuṣmikaṃ kṛtam ..
tadapāpāya bhavati tadācakṣva yadūttama .. 1 ..
4.82.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
यन्न तापाय वै पुंसां भवत्यामुष्मिकं कृतम् ॥
तदपापाय भवति तदाचक्ष्व यदूत्तम ॥ 1 ॥
4.82.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What is done for the other world does not lead to torment for men; / tell that which leads to freedom from sin, O best of the Yadus.

4.82.s:
upavāsaprabhāvaṃ vai kṛṣṇārādhanakāṃkṣiṇām ..
kathayeha mahābāho naiva tṛpyāmi jalpataḥ .. 2 ..
4.82.d:
उपवासप्रभावं वै कृष्णाराधनकांक्षिणाम् ॥
कथयेह महाबाहो नैव तृप्यामि जल्पतः ॥ 2 ॥
4.82.m: Tell here the power of fasting for those who desire the worship of Kṛṣṇa, / O mighty-armed one; I am not satisfied by your speech.

4.82.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śrūyatāṃ pārtha yatpṛṣṭāḥ kautukādbhavatā vayam ..
āmuṣmikaṃ na tāpāya pratāpāya ca jāyate .. 3 ..
4.82.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
श्रूयतां पार्थ यत्पृष्टाः कौतुकाद्भवता वयम् ॥
आमुष्मिकं न तापाय प्रतापाय च जायते ॥ 3 ॥
4.82.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen, O son of Pṛthā, to what we are asked by you out of curiosity; / what is done for the other world does not lead to torment, but results in majesty.

4.82.s:
upoṣitaprabhāvaṃ ca kṛṣṇārādhanakāṃkṣiṇām ..
kathayāmi yathāvṛttaṃ pūrvameva narottama .. 4 ..
4.82.d:
उपोषितप्रभावं च कृष्णाराधनकांक्षिणाम् ॥
कथयामि यथावृत्तं पूर्वमेव नरोत्तम ॥ 4 ॥
4.82.m: And the power of fasting for those who desire the worship of Kṛṣṇa / I shall tell just as it happened formerly, O best of men.

4.82.s:
vaidiśaṃ nāma nagaraṃ prakhyātaṃ nṛpasattama ..
tatra vaiśyo'bhavatpūrvaṃ sīrabhadra iti śrutaḥ .. 5 ..
4.82.d:
वैदिशं नाम नगरं प्रख्यातं नृपसत्तम ॥
तत्र वैश्योऽभवत्पूर्वं सीरभद्र इति श्रुतः ॥ 5 ॥
4.82.m: There is a renowned city named Vaidiśa, O best of kings; / there lived formerly a vaiśya known as Sīrabhadra.

4.82.s:
bhāryayā mātṛduhitā putrapautraiḥ samanvitaḥ ..
prabhūta bhṛtyavargaśca bahuvyāpārakārakaḥ .. 6 ..
4.82.d:
भार्यया मातृदुहिता पुत्रपौत्रैः समन्वितः ॥
प्रभूत भृत्यवर्गश्च बहुव्यापारकारकः ॥ 6 ॥
4.82.m: Accompanied by his wife, mother, daughter, sons, and grandsons, / possessing a large group of servants, and carrying on many trades,

4.82.s:
putrapautrādibharaṇe vyāsaktirmatireva ca ..
paralokaṃ prati matistasya nāsītkadācana .. 7 ..
4.82.d:
पुत्रपौत्रादिभरणे व्यासक्तिर्मतिरेव च ॥
परलोकं प्रति मतिस्तस्य नासीत्कदाचन ॥ 7 ॥
4.82.m: his mind and intellect were deeply attached to supporting his sons, grandsons, and others; / his mind was never turned towards the other world.

4.82.s:
cakārānudinaṃ so'tha nyāyānyāyairddhanārjanam ..
sarvatrānyatra niḥsnehaḥ putrasnehapariplutaḥ .. 8 ..
4.82.d:
चकारानुदिनं सोऽथ न्यायान्यायैर्द्धनार्जनम् ॥
सर्वत्रान्यत्र निःस्नेहः पुत्रस्नेहपरिप्लुतः ॥ 8 ॥
4.82.m: Then, day by day, he acquired wealth by fair means and foul; / devoid of affection everywhere else, he was overflowed with love for his sons.

4.82.s:
na juhotyudite kāle na dadātyatitṛṣṇayā ..
babhūva codyamastasya putrādibharaṇe paraḥ .. 9 ..
4.82.d:
न जुहोत्युदिते काले न ददात्यतितृष्णया ॥
बभूव चोद्यमस्तस्य पुत्रादिभरणे परः ॥ 9 ॥
4.82.m: He did not offer sacrifice at the proper time; he did not give out of excessive greed; / and his exertion was entirely devoted to maintaining his sons and others.

4.82.s:
nityanaimittikānāṃ ca hāniṃ cakre svakarmaṇā ..
tṛṣṇābhibhūto rājendra svavargabharaṇojjhitaḥ .. 4.82.10 ..
4.82.d:
नित्यनैमित्तिकानां च हानिं चक्रे स्वकर्मणा ॥
तृष्णाभिभूतो राजेन्द्र स्ववर्गभरणोज्झितः ॥ 4.82.10 ॥
4.82.m: Through his own conduct he caused the neglect of daily and occasional rites; / overcome by greed, O lord of kings, he neglected the maintenance of his own kindred.

4.82.s:
kālenāgacchatāso'tha mṛto viṃdhyāṭavītaṭe ..
yātanādehabhṛtpreto grīṣmakāle'bhavannṛpa .. 11 ..
4.82.d:
कालेनागच्छतासोऽथ मृतो विंध्याटवीतटे ॥
यातनादेहभृत्प्रेतो ग्रीष्मकालेऽभवन्नृप ॥ 11 ॥
4.82.m: Then in the course of time he died on the edge of the Vindhya forest; / bearing a body of torture, he became a preta in the summer season, O king.

4.82.s:
taṃ dadarśa mahābhāgo divyayānasamanvitaḥ ..
vedavedāṅgavidveṣī vipīto nāma vai dvijaḥ ..
bhāskarasyāśubhirddīptairdahaṃtamatidāruṇaiḥ .. 12 ..
4.82.d:
तं ददर्श महाभागो दिव्ययानसमन्वितः ॥
वेदवेदाङ्गविद्वेषी विपीतो नाम वै द्विजः ॥
भास्करस्याशुभिर्द्दीप्तैर्दहंतमतिदारुणैः ॥ 12 ॥
4.82.m: A highly fortunate twice-born named Vipīta, a despiser of the Veda and Vedāṅgas, / travelling in a celestial chariot, saw him / burning under the blazing, extremely cruel rays of the sun,

4.82.s:
prataptavālukāmadhye tṛṣārtaṃ cātipīḍitam ..
kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭhaṃ śuṣkāsyaṃ tathodvṛttavilocanam ..
niṣkrāṃtajihvamaṃgeṣu visphoṭaiḥ sarvataścitam .. 13 ..
4.82.d:
प्रतप्तवालुकामध्ये तृषार्तं चातिपीडितम् ॥
क्षुत्क्षामकंठं शुष्कास्यं तथोद्वृत्तविलोचनम् ॥
निष्क्रांतजिह्वमंगेषु विस्फोटैः सर्वतश्चितम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.82.m: amidst scorching sands, tormented by thirst and sorely distressed, / his throat emaciated by hunger, his mouth dry, his eyes rolled back, / his tongue protruding, covered all over his limbs with boils,

4.82.s:
niśvāsāyāsakhedena vihvalaṃ pīḍitodaram ..
nijena karmaṇā baddhamasamarthaṃ prasarpaṇe .. 14 ..
4.82.d:
निश्वासायासखेदेन विह्वलं पीडितोदरम् ॥
निजेन कर्मणा बद्धमसमर्थं प्रसर्पणे ॥ 14 ॥
4.82.m: distressed by the agony of sighing, his belly tormented, / bound by his own deeds, incapable of crawling.

4.82.s:
tathādṛśamatho dṛṣṭvā gardabheyo mahānṛṣiḥ ..
vipītaḥ prāha rājendra kāruṇyabharitaṃ vacaḥ .. 15 ..
4.82.d:
तथादृशमथो दृष्ट्वा गर्दभेयो महानृषिः ॥
विपीतः प्राह राजेन्द्र कारुण्यभरितं वचः ॥ 15 ॥
4.82.m: Seeing him in such a state, the great sage, the son of Gārdabhī, / Vipīta, spoke words filled with compassion, O lord of kings,

4.82.s:
jānannapi yathāprāptaṃ tasyānuṣṭhānajaṃ phalam ..
jaṃtostasyopakārāya sarvato hlādayanniva .. 16 ..
4.82.d:
जानन्नपि यथाप्राप्तं तस्यानुष्ठानजं फलम् ॥
जंतोस्तस्योपकाराय सर्वतो ह्लादयन्निव ॥ 16 ॥
4.82.m: though knowing the fruit born of that creature's actions to have arrived justly, / as if gladdening [him] on every side for his benefit.

4.82.s:
.. vipīta uvāca .. ..
adhaḥ sūryāṃśubhistaptairbahubhiḥ pathi pāṃśubhiḥ ..
uparyarkakaraistīkṣṇaistṛṣāvātanipīḍitam .. 17 ..
4.82.d:
॥ विपीत उवाच ॥ ॥
अधः सूर्यांशुभिस्तप्तैर्बहुभिः पथि पांशुभिः ॥
उपर्यर्ककरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तृषावातनिपीडितम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.82.m: Vipīta said: / Below, by the many sands on the path heated by the sun's rays, / above, by the sharp rays of the sun, afflicted by thirst and wind,

4.82.s:
anyastatrāṇakairghorairaviṣahyaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ ..
kathayeha yathātattvamekākī dahyase katham .. 18 ..
4.82.d:
अन्यस्तत्राणकैर्घोरैरविषह्यैः सुदारुणैः ॥
कथयेह यथातत्त्वमेकाकी दह्यसे कथम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.82.m: and by other terrible, unbearable, most dreadful afflictions— / tell me here truly, how are you burned all alone?

4.82.s:
tasyaitadvacanaṃ śrutvā vipītasya savedanaḥ ..
vedanārta uvācedaṃ kṛcchrāducchusya maṃdakam .. 19 ..
4.82.d:
तस्यैतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विपीतस्य सवेदनः ॥
वेदनार्त उवाचेदं कृच्छ्रादुच्छुस्य मंदकम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.82.m: Hearing these words of Vipīta, full of pain / and afflicted by agony, he sighed faintly with difficulty and said this:

4.82.s:
.. sīrabhadra uvāca .. ..
brahmannālocitaṃ pūrvaṃ kathamaṃte bhaviṣyati ..
aśāśvate śāśvatadhīstena dahyāmi durmatiḥ .. 4.82.20 ..
4.82.d:
॥ सीरभद्र उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्रह्मन्नालोचितं पूर्वं कथमंते भविष्यति ॥
अशाश्वते शाश्वतधीस्तेन दह्यामि दुर्मतिः ॥ 4.82.20 ॥
4.82.m: Sīrabhadra said: / O brāhmaṇa, I did not consider beforehand how it would be in the end; / perceiving permanence in the impermanent, therefore I, evil-minded, burn.

4.82.s:
idaṃ kariṣyāmyaparaṃ tvidaṃ kṛtvā tvidaṃ punaḥ ..
itīcchā śatamārūḍhastena dahyāmi durmatiḥ .. 21 ..
4.82.d:
इदं करिष्याम्यपरं त्विदं कृत्वा त्विदं पुनः ॥
इतीच्छा शतमारूढस्तेन दह्यामि दुर्मतिः ॥ 21 ॥
4.82.m: ‘I shall do this; then, having done this, I shall do yet another thing’— / thus mounted upon a hundred desires, therefore I, evil-minded, burn.

4.82.s:
śītoṣṇavarṣādibhavaṃ lobhātsoḍhaṃ mayā'śubham ..
tadeva hi na dharmārthaṃ tena dahyāmi durmatiḥ .. 22 ..
4.82.d:
शीतोष्णवर्षादिभवं लोभात्सोढं मयाऽशुभम् ॥
तदेव हि न धर्मार्थं तेन दह्यामि दुर्मतिः ॥ 22 ॥
4.82.m: Suffering born of cold, heat, rain, and the like was endured by me out of greed; / that very [hardship was] not for the sake of dharma, therefore I, evil-minded, burn.

4.82.s:
pitṛdevamanupyāṇāmadattvā yāpitā hi ye ..
te gatā nāpi vartaṃta dahyāmyeko'tra durmatiḥ ..23..
4.82.d:
पितृदेवमनुप्याणामदत्त्वा यापिता हि ये ॥
ते गता नापि वर्तंत दह्याम्येकोऽत्र दुर्मतिः ॥23॥
4.82.m: Those on whom [life] was spent without giving to ancestors, gods, and men / have departed and are not here; I, evil-minded, burn here alone.

4.82.s:
putrakṣetrakalatreṣu mamatvāhṛtacetasā ..
bahvasādhu kṛtaṃ karma tena dahyāmi durmatiḥ .. 24 ..
4.82.d:
पुत्रक्षेत्रकलत्रेषु ममत्वाहृतचेतसा ॥
बह्वसाधु कृतं कर्म तेन दह्यामि दुर्मतिः ॥ 24 ॥
4.82.m: With a mind captivated by possessiveness towards sons, fields, and wives, / many an unrighteous deed was done; therefore I, evil-minded, burn.

4.82.s:
mṛte mayi dhane tasminnanyāyopārjite sadā ..
rūpavaṃto'bhivartaṃte dahyāmyekotra durmatiḥ .. 25 ..
4.82.d:
मृते मयि धने तस्मिन्नन्यायोपार्जिते सदा ॥
रूपवंतोऽभिवर्तंते दह्याम्येकोत्र दुर्मतिः ॥ 25 ॥
4.82.m: When I died, upon that wealth always acquired unjustly, / handsome men live comfortably; I, evil-minded, burn here alone.

4.82.s:
na mayā pūjitā gehānnirgatā dvijasattamāḥ ..
svavargamiha kāmena tena dahyāmyahaṃmatiḥ .. 26 ..
4.82.d:
न मया पूजिता गेहान्निर्गता द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
स्ववर्गमिह कामेन तेन दह्याम्यहंमतिः ॥ 26 ॥
4.82.m: The best of the twice-born were not honoured by me and departed from my house; / [cherishing only] my own kin here out of desire, therefore I, egoistic, burn.

4.82.s:
yanme na pūjitā devāḥ kuṭuṃbaṃ poṣitaṃ param ..
ekākī tatra dahyāmi ye sutāste'nyato gatāḥ ..27..
4.82.d:
यन्मे न पूजिता देवाः कुटुंबं पोषितं परम् ॥
एकाकी तत्र दह्यामि ये सुतास्तेऽन्यतो गताः ॥27॥
4.82.m: Since the gods were not worshipped by me, and only my family was nourished, / I burn there alone; those who were my sons have gone elsewhere.

4.82.s:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ karma pūrveṣāṃ caiva no kṛtam ..
ekākī tena dahyāmi gataste phalabhoginaḥ .. 28 ..
4.82.d:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं कर्म पूर्वेषां चैव नो कृतम् ॥
एकाकी तेन दह्यामि गतस्ते फलभोगिनः ॥ 28 ॥
4.82.m: The daily and occasional rituals and [rites] for the ancestors were not performed by me; / therefore I burn alone; they who enjoyed the fruits have gone.

4.82.s:
dārāḥ putrāśca bhṛtyāśca pāpabuddhyā mayā bhṛtāḥ ..
ekākī tena dahyāmi gatāste phalabhoginaḥ .. 29 ..
4.82.d:
दाराः पुत्राश्च भृत्याश्च पापबुद्ध्या मया भृताः ॥
एकाकी तेन दह्यामि गतास्ते फलभोगिनः ॥ 29 ॥
4.82.m: Wives, sons, and servants were maintained by me with a sinful mind; / therefore I burn alone; they who enjoyed the fruits have gone.

4.82.s:
dārāḥ putrāśca bhṛtyārthe mayā nyāyārthasaṃcayaḥ ..
kṛtastenātra dahyāmi ye bhuktāste'nyato gatāḥ .. 4.82.30 ..
4.82.d:
दाराः पुत्राश्च भृत्यार्थे मया न्यायार्थसंचयः ॥
कृतस्तेनात्र दह्यामि ये भुक्तास्तेऽन्यतो गताः ॥ 4.82.30 ॥
4.82.m: For the sake of wives, sons, and servants, an accumulation of worldly wealth / was made by me; therefore I burn here; those who enjoyed it have gone elsewhere.

4.82.s:
kṣatapāpaṃ mayā bhuktamanyaistatkarma saṃcitam ..
dahyāmyeko'hamatyaṃtaṃ gatāste phalabhoginaḥ .. .. 31 ..
4.82.d:
क्षतपापं मया भुक्तमन्यैस्तत्कर्म संचितम् ॥
दह्याम्येकोऽहमत्यंतं गतास्ते फलभोगिनः ॥ ॥ 31 ॥
4.82.m: The diminished sin was consumed by me; that karma was accumulated for others; / I burn completely alone; they who enjoyed the fruits have gone.

4.82.s:
yanmamatvābhibhūtena mayā pāpamupārjitam ..
na tadanyasya kasyāpi kevalaṃ mama duṣkatam .. 32 ..
4.82.d:
यन्ममत्वाभिभूतेन मया पापमुपार्जितम् ॥
न तदन्यस्य कस्यापि केवलं मम दुष्कतम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.82.m: The sin that was accumulated by me, overcome by possessiveness, / belongs to no one else at all; it is solely my own misdeed.

4.82.s:
aṃtarduḥkhena dagdho'haṃ bahirdahyāmi bhāvayan ..
tāvadduḥkhaṃ navābhaṃ tu pāpamekaṃ dvidhāsthitam .. 33 ..
4.82.d:
अंतर्दुःखेन दग्धोऽहं बहिर्दह्यामि भावयन् ॥
तावद्दुःखं नवाभं तु पापमेकं द्विधास्थितम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.82.m: Consumed by inward grief, I burn outwardly reflecting [upon it]; / such is the fresh-looking pain, yet the single sin stands divided into two.

4.82.s:
kuru tasmātsamuddhāraṃ paśyasyamṛtasāgaram ..
tava yenāhamāhlādaṃ prāpnuyāṃ munisattama .. .. 34 ..
4.82.d:
कुरु तस्मात्समुद्धारं पश्यस्यमृतसागरम् ॥
तव येनाहमाह्लादं प्राप्नुयां मुनिसत्तम ॥ ॥ 34 ॥
4.82.m: Therefore, effect my deliverance! You behold an ocean of nectar / by which I might obtain delight from you, O best of sages!

4.82.s:
.. vipīta uvāca .. ..
alpakālika uddhāre tava paśyāmi saṃśayam ..
prakṣīṇaṃ pāpametāvatsuvṛttaṃ cāsti te param .. 35 ..
4.82.d:
॥ विपीत उवाच ॥ ॥
अल्पकालिक उद्धारे तव पश्यामि संशयम् ॥
प्रक्षीणं पापमेतावत्सुवृत्तं चास्ति ते परम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.82.m:
Vipīta said:
I see your doubt regarding [such] a swift deliverance.
Your sin has been worn away to this degree, and your good conduct is supreme.

4.82.s:
pratīte daśame janmanyacyutārādhanecchayā ..
sukarmajayadā bhadradvādaśīṃ samupoṣitaḥ ..
na ca tasyāḥ prasādena pāpamatyantadurjayam .. 36 ..
4.82.d:
प्रतीते दशमे जन्मन्यच्युताराधनेच्छया ॥
सुकर्मजयदा भद्रद्वादशीं समुपोषितः ॥
न च तस्याः प्रसादेन पापमत्यन्तदुर्जयम् ॥ 36 ॥

4.82.s:
alpairahobhiḥ saṃkṣīṇamāmapātre yathā jalam ..
gataṃ pāpamayaṃ hyasyāḥ prabhāvo'tyantadurllabhaḥ .. 37 ..
4.82.d:
अल्पैरहोभिः संक्षीणमामपात्रे यथा जलम् ॥
गतं पापमयं ह्यस्याः प्रभावोऽत्यन्तदुर्ल्लभः ॥ 37 ॥
4.82.m:
has wasted away in a few days, like water in an unbaked vessel.
The sin is gone, for its power is exceedingly difficult to obtain.

4.82.s:
nāśaṃ pāpasya kurute jayaṃ sukṛtakarmaṇaḥ ..
sakṛtkarmapradā hyeṣā tato vai dvādaśī smṛtā .. 38 ..
4.82.d:
नाशं पापस्य कुरुते जयं सुकृतकर्मणः ॥
सकृत्कर्मप्रदा ह्येषा ततो वै द्वादशी स्मृता ॥ 38 ॥
4.82.m:
It destroys sin and brings victory to meritorious deeds.
Indeed, it grants [the fruit of] deeds at once; therefore it is remembered as dvādaśī.

4.82.s:
yathaitadvadatārtena bhavatā paridevitam ..
tamuvācātra saṃdeho mama tāpāya deva kim .. 39 ..
4.82.d:
यथैतद्वदतार्तेन भवता परिदेवितम् ॥
तमुवाचात्र संदेहो मम तापाय देव किम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.82.m:
As you, distressed, lamented while speaking this,
he said to him: 'Why, O lord, is this doubt causing me torment?'

4.82.s:
pāpamatra kṛtaṃ pretya bhadra tāpāya jāyate ..
āhlādāya tathā puṇyamiha puṇyakṛtāṃ nṛṇām .. 4.82.40 ..
4.82.d:
पापमत्र कृतं प्रेत्य भद्र तापाय जायते ॥
आह्लादाय तथा पुण्यमिह पुण्यकृतां नृणाम् ॥ 4.82.40 ॥
4.82.m:
'A sin committed here leads to torment after death, O gentle one;
likewise, merit leads to joy here for people who perform meritorious deeds.'

4.82.s:
sīrabhadraṃ samāśvāsya yayāvitthaṃ mahāmuniḥ ..
sopyalpenaiva kālena tato mokṣamavāptavān .. 41 ..
4.82.d:
सीरभद्रं समाश्वास्य ययावित्थं महामुनिः ॥
सोप्यल्पेनैव कालेन ततो मोक्षमवाप्तवान् ॥ 41 ॥
4.82.m:
Having consoled Sīrabhadra in this manner, the great sage departed.
And he too, in a short time, attained liberation thereafter.

4.82.s:
upavāsaprabhāvaśca kathitaste narottama ..
yenālpaireva divasairbhūri pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam .. 42 ..
4.82.d:
उपवासप्रभावश्च कथितस्ते नरोत्तम ॥
येनाल्पैरेव दिवसैर्भूरि पापं क्षयं गतम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.82.m:
Thus the power of the fast has been told to you, O best of men,
by which, in merely a few days, abundant sin was destroyed.

4.82.s:
tasmānnareṇa puṇyāya yatitavyaṃ na pātakam ..
upavāsāśca kartavyāḥ sadaivātmahitaiṣiṇā .. 43 ..
4.82.d:
तस्मान्नरेण पुण्याय यतितव्यं न पातकम् ॥
उपवासाश्च कर्तव्याः सदैवात्महितैषिणा ॥ 43 ॥
4.82.m:
Therefore, a man should strive for merit, not for sin.
And fasts should always be observed by one who desires his own welfare.

4.82.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
athaitatkaṣṭapāpānāṃ vipāko narakasthitaiḥ ..
puruṣairbhujyate śaśvattaṃ mokṣaṃ vada sattama .. 44 ..
4.82.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
अथैतत्कष्टपापानां विपाको नरकस्थितैः ॥
पुरुषैर्भुज्यते शश्वत्तं मोक्षं वद सत्तम ॥ 44 ॥
4.82.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Now, this fruition of terrible sins is continually endured
by men stationed in hell; tell me of their release, O best of beings.

4.82.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
jayāsametāḥ puruṣāḥ sadā sukṛtakarmaṇaḥ ..
jayā sā dvādaśī śastā nṛṇāṃ sukṛtakarmaṇām .. 45 ..
4.82.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
जयासमेताः पुरुषाः सदा सुकृतकर्मणः ॥
जया सा द्वादशी शस्ता नृणां सुकृतकर्मणाम् ॥ 45 ॥
4.82.m:
Lord Kṛṣṇa said:
Men who perform meritorious deeds are always endowed with victory.
That victorious dvādaśī is celebrated for men of virtuous deeds.

4.82.s:
phālgunāmalapakṣasya ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ ..
dvādaśyāṃ tu dvijaśreṣṭha pūjayenmadhusūdanam .. 46 ..
4.82.d:
फाल्गुनामलपक्षस्य एकादश्यामुपोषितः ॥
द्वादश्यां तु द्विजश्रेष्ठ पूजयेन्मधुसूदनम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.82.m:
Having fasted on the ekādaśī of the bright fortnight of Phālguna,
one should worship Madhusūdana on the dvādaśī, O best of the twice-born.

4.82.s:
ekādaśyāṃ samuttiṣṭhanviṣṇornāmānukīrtayan ..
pūjāyāṃ vāsudevasya bhuñjīta susamāhitaḥ .. 47 ..
4.82.d:
एकादश्यां समुत्तिष्ठन्विष्णोर्नामानुकीर्तयन् ॥
पूजायां वासुदेवस्य भुञ्जीत सुसमाहितः ॥ 47 ॥
4.82.m:
Rising on the ekādaśī, chanting the name of Viṣṇu,
one should eat while deeply concentrated upon the worship of Vāsudeva.

4.82.s:
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca madaṃ mohaṃ ca varjayet ..
drohādīnvarjayeddoṣānsarvāndhanamadodbhavān .. 48-..
bhāyayedviṣṇubhaktaśca saṃsāre'sāratāṃ tathā ..
evaṃ bhāvitacittena prāṇināṃ hitamicchatā .. ..49..
4.82.d:
कामं क्रोधं च लोभं च मदं मोहं च वर्जयेत् ॥
द्रोहादीन्वर्जयेद्दोषान्सर्वान्धनमदोद्भवान् ॥ 48-॥
भाययेद्विष्णुभक्तश्च संसारेऽसारतां तथा ॥
एवं भावितचित्तेन प्राणिनां हितमिच्छता ॥ ॥49॥

4.82.s:
namo nārāyaṇāyeti vaktavyaṃ svapatā niśi ..
tathaiva kuryāddvādaśyāṃ nāmnā kṣutpāraṇaṃ nṛpa ..4.82.50..
4.82.d:
नमो नारायणायेति वक्तव्यं स्वपता निशि ॥
तथैव कुर्याद्द्वादश्यां नाम्ना क्षुत्पारणं नृप ॥4.82.50॥
4.82.m:
one should utter 'Obeisance to Nārāyaṇa' while falling asleep at night.
Likewise on the dvādaśī, O king, one should break the fast using the name.

4.82.s:
sauvarṇatāmrapātrāṇi mṛnmayānyapi pāṃḍava ..
yavapātrāṇi pūrvaṃ tu dadyānmāsacatuṣṭayam..51..
4.82.d:
सौवर्णताम्रपात्राणि मृन्मयान्यपि पांडव ॥
यवपात्राणि पूर्वं तु दद्यान्मासचतुष्टयम्॥51॥
4.82.m:
Vessels of gold, copper, or even clay,
filled with barley, O Pāṇḍava, one should first give for four months.

4.82.s:
āṣāḍhādidvitīyaṃ tu pārayecca mahāmate ..
tatrāpi ghṛtapātrāṇi dadyācchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..52..
4.82.d:
आषाढादिद्वितीयं तु पारयेच्च महामते ॥
तत्रापि घृतपात्राणि दद्याच्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥52॥
4.82.m:
One should conclude the second [period] beginning with Āṣāḍha, O wise one;
there too, endowed with faith, one should give vessels of clarified butter.

4.82.s:
kārttikādiṣu māseṣu māghāṃteṣu tathā tilān..
viprāya dadyātpātraṃ tu pratimāsamupoṣitaḥ ..53..
4.82.d:
कार्त्तिकादिषु मासेषु माघांतेषु तथा तिलान्॥
विप्राय दद्यात्पात्रं तु प्रतिमासमुपोषितः ॥53॥
4.82.m:
In the months beginning with Kārttika and ending with Māgha, one should give sesame seeds;
having fasted each month, one should give a vessel to a brāhmaṇa.

4.82.s:
nāmatrayamaśeṣeṇa māsimāsi dinadvayam..
tathaivoccārayandadyānmāsimāsi yavādikam ..
praṇamya ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ kṛtapūjaḥ prasādayet ..54..
4.82.d:
नामत्रयमशेषेण मासिमासि दिनद्वयम्॥
तथैवोच्चारयन्दद्यान्मासिमासि यवादिकम् ॥
प्रणम्य च हृषीकेशं कृतपूजः प्रसादयेत् ॥54॥
4.82.m:
Uttering the three names in full for two days month after month,
one should likewise give barley and other [grains] month after month.
And having bowed to Hṛṣīkeśa and performed the worship, one should propitiate [him]:

4.82.s:
viṣṇo namaste jagatī prasotre śrīvāsudevāya namo namaste ..
nārāyaṇākhyaḥ praṇatairviciṃtyaḥ karotu māṃ śāśvatapuṇyarāśim..55..
4.82.d:
विष्णो नमस्ते जगती प्रसोत्रे श्रीवासुदेवाय नमो नमस्ते ॥
नारायणाख्यः प्रणतैर्विचिंत्यः करोतु मां शाश्वतपुण्यराशिम्॥55॥
4.82.m:
'O Viṣṇu, obeisance to you, the creator of the world! Obeisance, obeisance to you, glorious Vāsudeva!
May the one named Nārāyaṇa, to be meditated upon by the bowed, make me a heap of eternal merit.

4.82.s:
prasīda puṇyaṃ jayameti viṣṇo śrīvāsudevarddhimupaitu puṇyam..
prayātu vāśeṣamatho vināśaṃ mā teṃ'ghripadmāditaratra me matiḥ..56..
4.82.d:
प्रसीद पुण्यं जयमेति विष्णो श्रीवासुदेवर्द्धिमुपैतु पुण्यम्॥
प्रयातु वाशेषमथो विनाशं मा तेंऽघ्रिपद्मादितरत्र मे मतिः॥56॥
4.82.m:
Be gracious, O Viṣṇu, may my merit attain victory; may the merit reach prosperity through glorious Vāsudeva!
Or let [sin] pass into complete destruction; may my mind not wander elsewhere than your lotus feet!

4.82.s:
viṣṇo puṇyodbhavo mestu vāsudevāstu me śubham ..
nārāyaṇostu dharmo jahi pāpamaśeṣataḥ ..57..
4.82.d:
विष्णो पुण्योद्भवो मेस्तु वासुदेवास्तु मे शुभम् ॥
नारायणोस्तु धर्मो जहि पापमशेषतः ॥57॥
4.82.m:
O Viṣṇu, may there be the rising of merit for me! From Vāsudeva, may there be auspiciousness for me!
Through Nārāyaṇa, may there be righteousness; destroy sin completely!

4.82.s:
aneka janmajanitaṃ bālyayauvanavārddhake..
puṇyaṃ vivṛddhimāyātu yātu pāpaṃ ca saṃkṣayam ..58..
4.82.d:
अनेक जन्मजनितं बाल्ययौवनवार्द्धके॥
पुण्यं विवृद्धिमायातु यातु पापं च संक्षयम् ॥58॥
4.82.m:
Born of many births, in childhood, youth, and old age,
may merit increase, and may sin go to destruction!

4.82.s:
ākāśādiṣu śabdādau śrotrādau mahadādiṣu..
prakṛtau puruṣe caiva brahmaṇyapi ca sa prabhuḥ..59..
4.82.d:
आकाशादिषु शब्दादौ श्रोत्रादौ महदादिषु॥
प्रकृतौ पुरुषे चैव ब्रह्मण्यपि च स प्रभुः॥59॥
4.82.m:
In space and the rest, in sound and the rest, in the ear and the rest, in the intellect and the rest,
in nature, in the spirit, and even in Brahman, he is the Lord.

4.82.s:
yathaika eva dharmātmā vāsudevo vyavasthitaḥ..
tena satyena pāpaṃ me narakārtipradaṃ kṣayam ..4.82.60..
4.82.d:
यथैक एव धर्मात्मा वासुदेवो व्यवस्थितः॥
तेन सत्येन पापं मे नरकार्तिप्रदं क्षयम् ॥4.82.60॥
4.82.m:
Just as Vāsudeva, the sole righteous self, remains established,
by that truth, may my sin that grants the agony of hell be destroyed!

4.82.s:
prayātu sukṛtasyāstu mamānudivasañjayaḥ..
pāpasya hāniḥ puṇyasya vṛddhirmestūttamottamā..61..
4.82.d:
प्रयातु सुकृतस्यास्तु ममानुदिवसञ्जयः॥
पापस्य हानिः पुण्यस्य वृद्धिर्मेस्तूत्तमोत्तमा॥61॥
4.82.m:
May it pass away, and may there be victory for my good deeds day by day!
May there be loss of sin, and may the increase of merit be highest of the high for me!'

4.82.s:
evamuccārya viprāya dadyādyatkathitaṃ tava..
bhuñjīta kṛtakṛtyastu pāraṇepāraṇe gate..62..
4.82.d:
एवमुच्चार्य विप्राय दद्याद्यत्कथितं तव॥
भुञ्जीत कृतकृत्यस्तु पारणेपारणे गते॥62॥
4.82.m:
Having spoken thus, one should give to a brāhmaṇa what was described to you.
Having accomplished one's duty, one should eat as each breaking of the fast arrives.

4.82.s:
pāraṇāṃte tu deveśa prīṇanaṃ śaktito nṛpa ..
kurvītākhilapākhaṇḍairālāpaṃ ca vivarjayet .. 63 ..
4.82.d:
पारणांते तु देवेश प्रीणनं शक्तितो नृप ॥
कुर्वीताखिलपाखण्डैरालापं च विवर्जयेत् ॥ 63 ॥
4.82.m:
At the conclusion of breaking the fast, O king, one should propitiate the Lord of the gods according to one's capacity,
and one should completely avoid conversation with all heretics.

4.82.s:
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte kāṃcanīṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ..
pūjayitvā vastrapuṣpairghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutaiḥ .. 64 ..
4.82.d:
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते कांचनीं प्रतिमां हरेः॥
पूजयित्वा वस्त्रपुष्पैर्घृतपात्रेण संयुतैः ॥ 64 ॥
4.82.m:
In this manner, at the end of the year, having worshipped a golden image of Hari
with garments and flowers accompanied by a vessel of clarified butter,

4.82.s:
gāṃ savatsāṃ ca viprāya dadyācchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
vilaṃbitaṃ ca yatpūrvaṃ devānanyānbhajedyadi .. 65 ..
4.82.d:
गां सवत्सां च विप्राय दद्याच्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥
विलंबितं च यत्पूर्वं देवानन्यान्भजेद्यदि ॥ 65 ॥
4.82.m:
endowed with faith, one should give a cow along with her calf to a brāhmaṇa.
And if one should worship other gods as was previously delayed,

4.82.s:
tasminnahani dātavyaṃ bhojane cānivāritam ..
ityeṣā kathitā puṇyā sukṛtasya jayāvahā ..
dvādaśī narakaṃ pārtha yāmupoṣya na paśyati ..66..
4.82.d:
तस्मिन्नहनि दातव्यं भोजने चानिवारितम् ॥
इत्येषा कथिता पुण्या सुकृतस्य जयावहा ॥
द्वादशी नरकं पार्थ यामुपोष्य न पश्यति ॥66॥
4.82.m:
gifts are to be given on that day, and food unrestrained.
Thus has been told the holy dvādaśī that brings victory to good deeds,
having fasted on which, O son of Pṛthā, one does not see hell.

4.82.s:
nāgnayo na ca śastrāṇi na ca lohamukhāḥ khagāḥ ..
nārakāstaṃ prabādhante matiryasya janārdane .. 67 ..
4.82.d:
नाग्नयो न च शस्त्राणि न च लोहमुखाः खगाः ॥
नारकास्तं प्रबाधन्ते मतिर्यस्य जनार्दने ॥ 67 ॥
4.82.m:
Neither fires nor weapons nor iron-beaked birds of hell
torment him whose mind is fixed on Janārdana.

4.82.s:
nāmoccāraṇamātreṇa viṣṇoḥ kṣīṇāghasaṃcayaḥ ..
bhavatyagha vināśaśca narake patanaṃ kutaḥ .. 68 ..
4.82.d:
नामोच्चारणमात्रेण विष्णोः क्षीणाघसंचयः ॥
भवत्यघ विनाशश्च नरके पतनं कुतः ॥ 68 ॥
4.82.m:
By the mere utterance of the name of Viṣṇu, one's accumulation of sins is exhausted;
when destruction of sin occurs, how could there be a fall into hell?

4.82.s:
namo nārāyaṇa hare vāsudeveti kīrtayan ..
na yāti narakaṃ martyaḥ saṃkṣīṇāśeṣapātakaḥ .. 69 ..
4.82.d:
नमो नारायण हरे वासुदेवेति कीर्तयन् ॥
न याति नरकं मर्त्यः संक्षीणाशेषपातकः ॥ 69 ॥
4.82.m:
Praising, 'Obeisance to Nārāyaṇa, Hari, Vāsudeva,'
a mortal whose sins are completely worn away does not go to hell.

4.82.s:
tasmātpākhaṃḍisaṃsargamakurvandvādaśīmimām ..
upoṣya puṇyopacaye na yāti narakaṃ naraḥ .. 4.82.70 ..
4.82.d:
तस्मात्पाखंडिसंसर्गमकुर्वन्द्वादशीमिमाम् ॥
उपोष्य पुण्योपचये न याति नरकं नरः ॥ 4.82.70 ॥
4.82.m:
Therefore, not keeping company with heretics and fasting on this dvādaśī,
accumulating merit, a person does not go to hell.

4.82.s:
pāpaṃ kṣiṇoti sukṛtasya karoti vṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ prayacchati niyacchati sarvadoṣān ..
yaddvādaśīha sukṛtātihitā ca loke kasmānna tāmupavasaṃti vimūḍhacittāḥ ..71 .. ..
dharaṇīvratavarṇanam
4.82.d:
पापं क्षिणोति सुकृतस्य करोति वृद्धिं वृद्धिं प्रयच्छति नियच्छति सर्वदोषान् ॥
यद्द्वादशीह सुकृतातिहिता च लोके कस्मान्न तामुपवसंति विमूढचित्ताः ॥71 ॥ ॥
धरणीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.82.m:
It destroys sin, it causes the increase of good deeds, it bestows prosperity, and it restrains all faults.
Since dvādaśī is extremely beneficial for good deeds here in the world, why do those of deluded minds not fast upon it?
Description of the Dharaṇī Votive Observance

4.83.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yadetatparamaṃ guhyaṃ sarvavedeṣu paṭhyate ..
sa devaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo hariḥ .. 1 ..
4.83.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
यदेतत्परमं गुह्यं सर्ववेदेषु पठ्यते ॥
स देवः पुण्डरीकाक्षः स्वयं नारायणो हरिः ॥ 1 ॥
4.83.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
That supreme secret which is recited in all the Vedas
is the lotus-eyed god himself, Nārāyaṇa, Hari.

4.83.s:
sa yajñairvividhairiṣṭairvrataiśca yadusattama ..
prāpyate paramo devaḥ sanātanaḥ kathañcana... 2..
4.83.d:
स यज्ञैर्विविधैरिष्टैर्व्रतैश्च यदुसत्तम ॥
प्राप्यते परमो देवः सनातनः कथञ्चन॥। 2॥
4.83.m:
Through various offered sacrifices and through votive observances, O best of the Yadus,
that supreme, eternal god is somehow attained.

4.83.s:
bahuvittena bhagavannṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ ..
prāpyante susahāyaiśca kvacittyaktāḥ suduṣkarāḥ .. 3 ..
4.83.d:
बहुवित्तेन भगवन्नृत्विग्भिर्वेदपारगैः ॥
प्राप्यन्ते सुसहायैश्च क्वचित्त्यक्ताः सुदुष्कराः ॥ 3 ॥
4.83.m:
Through great wealth, O Blessed One, through officiating priests who have crossed to the other shore of the Vedas,
and through excellent helpers are [sacrifices] attained; elsewhere, exceedingly difficult [rites] are abandoned.

4.83.s:
vittena ca vinā dānaṃ dātuṃ kṛṣṇa na śakyate ..
vidyamāne'pi na matiḥ kuṭuṃbāsaktacetasaḥ .. 4 ..
4.83.d:
वित्तेन च विना दानं दातुं कृष्ण न शक्यते ॥
विद्यमानेऽपि न मतिः कुटुंबासक्तचेतसः ॥ 4 ॥
4.83.m:
And without wealth, O Kṛṣṇa, a gift cannot be given;
even when it exists, the mind of one attached to his family is unwilling.

4.83.s:
tasya mokṣaḥ kathaṃ kṛṣṇa sarvathā durllabho hariḥ ..
alpāyāsena labhate yena devaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
tanme sāmānyato brūhi sarvavarṇeṣu yadbhavet ..5..
4.83.d:
तस्य मोक्षः कथं कृष्ण सर्वथा दुर्ल्लभो हरिः ॥
अल्पायासेन लभते येन देवः सनातनः ॥
तन्मे सामान्यतो ब्रूहि सर्ववर्णेषु यद्भवेत् ॥5॥
4.83.m:
How can such a man attain liberation, O Kṛṣṇa? Hari is difficult to attain by every means.
Tell me that common practice applicable to all castes,
by which the eternal God is attained with little exertion.

4.83.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kathayāmi paraṃ guhyaṃ rahasyaṃ devanirmitam ..
dharaṇyā yatkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ majjantyā vasudhātale .. 6 ..
4.83.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
कथयामि परं गुह्यं रहस्यं देवनिर्मितम् ॥
धरण्या यत्कृतं पूर्वं मज्जन्त्या वसुधातले ॥ 6 ॥
4.83.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall tell you the supreme mystery, a secret devised by the gods,
which was performed long ago by the earth when she was sinking into the netherworld.

4.83.s:
pṛthivyāḥ pārthiva purā saṃjātaḥ saṃgamo'mbubhiḥ ..
tasminsalilasaṃlagne mahī prāyādrasātalam.. 7 ..
4.83.d:
पृथिव्याः पार्थिव पुरा संजातः संगमोऽम्बुभिः ॥
तस्मिन्सलिलसंलग्ने मही प्रायाद्रसातलम्॥ 7 ॥
4.83.m:
Formerly, O king, there occurred the union of the earth with waters;
when it became submerged in those waters, the earth sank to Rasātala.

4.83.s:
sā bhūtadhātrī dharaṇī rasātalagatā śubhā ..
ārādhayāmāsa vibhuṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param .. 8 ..
4.83.d:
सा भूतधात्री धरणी रसातलगता शुभा ॥
आराधयामास विभुं देवं नारायणं परम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.83.m:
She, the auspicious supporter of beings, the earth, having reached Rasātala,
worshipped the all-pervading, supreme God Nārāyaṇa.

4.83.s:
upavāsavratairdevī niyamaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
kālena mahatā tasyāḥ prasanno garuḍadhvajaḥ ..
ujjahāra sthitau cemāṃ sthāpayāmāsa cācyutaḥ .. 9 ..
4.83.d:
उपवासव्रतैर्देवी नियमैश्च पृथग्विधैः ॥
कालेन महता तस्याः प्रसन्नो गरुडध्वजः ॥
उज्जहार स्थितौ चेमां स्थापयामास चाच्युतः ॥ 9 ॥

4.83.s:
prāpte mārgaśire māse daśamyāṃ niyatātmavān ..
snātvā devārcanaṃ kṛtvā agnikāryaṃ yathāvidhi .. 4.83.10 ..
4.83.d:
प्राप्ते मार्गशिरे मासे दशम्यां नियतात्मवान् ॥
स्नात्वा देवार्चनं कृत्वा अग्निकार्यं यथाविधि ॥ 4.83.10 ॥
4.83.m:
When the month of Mārgaśīrṣa arrives, on the tenth lunar day, having self-control,
after bathing, worshipping the gods, and performing the fire ritual according to rule,

4.83.s:
śucivāsāḥ prasannātmā hyatyalpānna susaṃskṛtam ..
bhuktvā pañcapadaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ śaucaṃ ca pādayoḥ .. 11 ..
4.83.d:
शुचिवासाः प्रसन्नात्मा ह्यत्यल्पान्न सुसंस्कृतम् ॥
भुक्त्वा पञ्चपदं कृत्वा पुनः शौचं च पादयोः ॥ 11 ॥
4.83.m:
clad in clean garments, with a cheerful mind, having eaten very little well-prepared food,
having taken five steps, and having cleaned his feet again,

4.83.s:
kṛtvāṣṭāṃgulamātraṃ tu kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhavam ..
bhakṣayeddantakāṣṭhaṃ tu tataścācamya yatnataḥ .. 12 ..
4.83.d:
कृत्वाष्टांगुलमात्रं तु क्षीरवृक्षसमुद्भवम् ॥
भक्षयेद्दन्तकाष्ठं तु ततश्चाचम्य यत्नतः ॥ 12 ॥
4.83.m:
and having fashioned [a tooth-stick] measuring eight finger-breadths from a milky-sap tree,
he should chew the tooth-stick, and then carefully rinse his mouth.

4.83.s:
spṛṣṭvā nyasyānyakarmāṇi ciraṃ dhyātvā janārdanam ...
śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ pītāmbarasamāvṛtam .. 13 ..
4.83.d:
स्पृष्ट्वा न्यस्यान्यकर्माणि चिरं ध्यात्वा जनार्दनम् ॥।
शंखचक्रगदापाणिं पीताम्बरसमावृतम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.83.m:
Having touched [the water], renouncing other activities, and meditating for a long time on Janārdana,
who holds the conch, discus, and mace in his hands, and is clad in yellow garments,

4.83.s:
evamuccārayedvācaṃ tasminkāle mahādyute ..
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvāhamaparehani ..
saṃbhokṣye puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta .. 14 ..
4.83.d:
एवमुच्चारयेद्वाचं तस्मिन्काले महाद्युते ॥
एकादश्यां निराहारः स्थित्वाहमपरेहनि ॥
संभोक्ष्ये पुण्डरीकाक्ष शरणं मे भवाच्युत ॥ 14 ॥
4.83.m:
he should utter these words at that time, O one of great splendour:
'Remaining without food on the eleventh lunar day, on the following day
I shall feast, O lotus-eyed one! Be my refuge, O Acyuta!'

4.83.s:
evamuktvā tato deva devadevasya sannidhau ..
japennārāyaṇāyeti rūpe tatra vidhānataḥ .. 15 ..
4.83.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो देव देवदेवस्य सन्निधौ ॥
जपेन्नारायणायेति रूपे तत्र विधानतः ॥ 15 ॥
4.83.m:
Having spoken thus, O king, in the presence of the God of gods,
he should chant "To Nārāyaṇa" in the manner prescribed there.

4.83.s:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale nadīṃ gatvā samudragām ..
itarāṃ vā taḍāgaṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān .. 16 ..
4.83.d:
ततः प्रभाते विमले नदीं गत्वा समुद्रगाम् ॥
इतरां वा तडागं वा गृहे वा नियतात्मवान् ॥ 16 ॥
4.83.m:
Then, at clear daybreak, going to a river that reaches the ocean,
or to another [stream], or to a pond, or at home, with self-restraint,

4.83.s:
ānīya mṛttikāṃ śuddhāṃ maṃtreṇānena mānavaḥ ..
dhāraṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ tvatto bhūtānāṃ devi sarvadā ..
tena sattvena māṃ pāhi pāpānmocaya suvrate .. 17 .. .. iti mṛttikāmantraḥ ..
4.83.d:
आनीय मृत्तिकां शुद्धां मंत्रेणानेन मानवः ॥
धारणं पोषणं त्वत्तो भूतानां देवि सर्वदा ॥
तेन सत्त्वेन मां पाहि पापान्मोचय सुव्रते ॥ 17 ॥ ॥ इति मृत्तिकामन्त्रः ॥
4.83.m:
a man, bringing pure clay, [should recite] this mantra:
'Sustenance and nourishment of beings are always from you, O goddess!
By that strength protect me, free me from sin, O you of noble vows!'
— Thus the clay mantra.

4.83.s:
brahmāṇḍodaratīrthāni karaiḥ spṛṣṭāni te raveḥ ..
bhavaṃti bhūtāni satāṃ mṛttikāmālabhetpunaḥ .. 18 .. ityadityādarśanamantraḥ ..
4.83.d:
ब्रह्माण्डोदरतीर्थानि करैः स्पृष्टानि ते रवेः ॥
भवंति भूतानि सतां मृत्तिकामालभेत्पुनः ॥ 18 ॥ इत्यदित्यादर्शनमन्त्रः ॥

4.83.s:
evaṃ mṛdaṃ raveragre kṛtvāthātmānamā labhet ..
triḥkṛtvāśeṣamṛdayā kuṇḍamālikhya vai jale .. 19 ..
4.83.d:
एवं मृदं रवेरग्रे कृत्वाथात्मानमा लभेत् ॥
त्रिःकृत्वाशेषमृदया कुण्डमालिख्य वै जले ॥ 19 ॥
4.83.m:
Having thus placed the clay before the Sun, he should smear himself with it;
having done so three times, he should draw a sacrificial pit in the water with the remaining clay.

4.83.s:
tataḥ snātvā naraḥ samyakcakravartyupacārakaḥ ..
ācamyāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā punardeva gṛhaṃ vrajet .. 4.83.20 ..
4.83.d:
ततः स्नात्वा नरः सम्यक्चक्रवर्त्युपचारकः ॥
आचम्यावश्यकं कृत्वा पुनर्देव गृहं व्रजेत् ॥ 4.83.20 ॥
4.83.m:
Then, having properly bathed, performing the rituals like an emperor,
having rinsed his mouth and fulfilled mandatory duties, he should return to the temple or home.

4.83.s:
tamārādhya mahāyogaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ..
keśavāya namaḥ pādau kaṭiṃ dāmodarāya ca .. 21 ..
4.83.d:
तमाराध्य महायोगं देवं नारायणं प्रभुम् ॥
केशवाय नमः पादौ कटिं दामोदराय च ॥ 21 ॥
4.83.m:
Having worshipped him, the Lord Nārāyaṇa of great yoga:
'Salutations to Keśava' [worshipping] the feet, and to Dāmodara the waist,

4.83.s:
ūruyugmaṃ nṛsiṃhāya uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe ..
kaṇṭhaṃ kaustubhanāthāya vakṣaḥ śrīpataye tathā .. 22 ..
4.83.d:
ऊरुयुग्मं नृसिंहाय उरः श्रीवत्सधारिणे ॥
कण्ठं कौस्तुभनाथाय वक्षः श्रीपतये तथा ॥ 22 ॥
4.83.m:
to Nṛsiṃha the pair of thighs, to the bearer of the Śrīvatsa the chest,
to the Lord of the Kaustubha the throat, and likewise to the Lord of Śrī the breast,

4.83.s:
trailokyavijayāyeti bāhu sarvātmane śiraḥ ..
rathāṃgadhāriṇe cakraṃ śaṃkarāyeti cāṃbujam .. 23 ..
4.83.d:
त्रैलोक्यविजयायेति बाहु सर्वात्मने शिरः ॥
रथांगधारिणे चक्रं शंकरायेति चांबुजम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.83.m:
saying 'To the conqueror of the three worlds' [he worships] the arms; 'To the Universal Soul' the head;
to the bearer of the chariot-wheel [he offers] the discus; and saying 'To Śaṅkara' the lotus,

4.83.s:
gambhīrāyeti ca gadāmabhayaṃ śāṃtamūrtaye ..
evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum .. 24 ..
4.83.d:
गम्भीरायेति च गदामभयं शांतमूर्तये ॥
एवमभ्यर्च्य देवेशं देवं नारायणं प्रभुम् ॥ 24 ॥
4.83.m:
and saying 'To the deep one' [he offers] the mace, and fearlessness 'To the peaceful form.'
Having thus worshipped the Lord of gods, the divine master Nārāyaṇa,

4.83.s:
punastasyāgrataḥ kumbhāṃścaturaḥ sthāpayedbudhaḥ ..
jalapūrṇānsamālyāṃśca sitacandanacarcitān .. 25 ..
4.83.d:
पुनस्तस्याग्रतः कुम्भांश्चतुरः स्थापयेद्बुधः ॥
जलपूर्णान्समाल्यांश्च सितचन्दनचर्चितान् ॥ 25 ॥
4.83.m:
the wise man should then place four jars before him,
filled with water, accompanied by garlands, and smeared with white sandalwood paste,

4.83.s:
caturbhistilapātraiśca sthagitānratnasaṃyutān ..
catvāraste samudrāstu kalaśāḥ parikīrtitāḥ .. 26 ..
4.83.d:
चतुर्भिस्तिलपात्रैश्च स्थगितान्रत्नसंयुतान् ॥
चत्वारस्ते समुद्रास्तु कलशाः परिकीर्तिताः ॥ 26 ॥
4.83.m:
covered with four dishes of sesame seeds and accompanied by gems.
Those four water pots are indeed celebrated as the four oceans.

4.83.s:
teṣāṃ madhye tu saṃpīṭhaṃ sthāpayedvastrasaṃvṛtam ..
tasminsauvarṇaṃ raupyaṃ vā tāmraṃ vā dāravaṃ tathā ..
pātraṃ toyabhṛtaṃ kṛtvā tasya madhye tato nyaset .. 27 ..
4.83.d:
तेषां मध्ये तु संपीठं स्थापयेद्वस्त्रसंवृतम् ॥
तस्मिन्सौवर्णं रौप्यं वा ताम्रं वा दारवं तथा ॥
पात्रं तोयभृतं कृत्वा तस्य मध्ये ततो न्यसेत् ॥ 27 ॥

4.83.s:
sauvarṇaṃ mātsyarūpeṇa kṛtvā devaṃ janārdanam ..
vedavedāṃgasaṃyuktaṃ śrutismṛti vibhūṣitam .. 28 ..
4.83.d:
सौवर्णं मात्स्यरूपेण कृत्वा देवं जनार्दनम् ॥
वेदवेदांगसंयुक्तं श्रुतिस्मृति विभूषितम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.83.m:
Having fashioned Lord Janārdana out of gold in the form of a fish,
associated with the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, adorned with Śruti and Smṛti,

4.83.s:
bhakṣyairbahuvidhai rājanphalaiḥ puṣpaiśca śobhitam ..
gandhairdhūpairmaṃtravarairarcayitvā yathāvidhi .. 29 ..
4.83.d:
भक्ष्यैर्बहुविधै राजन्फलैः पुष्पैश्च शोभितम् ॥
गन्धैर्धूपैर्मंत्रवरैरर्चयित्वा यथाविधि ॥ 29 ॥
4.83.m:
adorned with various kinds of foods, O king, with fruits and flowers,
and having worshipped him with perfumes, incenses, and choice mantras according to rule, [he says]:

4.83.s:
rasātalagatā vedā yathā deva tvayāhṛtāḥ ..
matsyarūpeṇa tadvanmāṃ bhavāduddhara keśava .. 4.83.30 ..
4.83.d:
रसातलगता वेदा यथा देव त्वयाहृताः ॥
मत्स्यरूपेण तद्वन्मां भवादुद्धर केशव ॥ 4.83.30 ॥
4.83.m:
'Just as the Vedas that had gone to Rasātala were brought back by you, O God,
in the form of a fish, in the same way deliver me from worldly existence, O Keśava!'

4.83.s:
evamuccārya tasyāgre jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet ..
yathāvibhavasāreṇa prabhā te'pi punaḥpunaḥ ..
caturṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu caturo dāpayeddhaṭān .. 31 ..
4.83.d:
एवमुच्चार्य तस्याग्रे जागरं तत्र कारयेत् ॥
यथाविभवसारेण प्रभा तेऽपि पुनःपुनः ॥
चतुर्णां ब्राह्मणानां तु चतुरो दापयेद्धटान् ॥ 31 ॥
4.83.m:
Having uttered this before him, he should keep a vigil there
according to the measure of his wealth, and repeatedly at daybreak
he should give four jars to four brahmins.

4.83.s:
pūrvaṃ tu bahvṛce dayācchaṃdoge dakṣiṇaṃ tathā ..
yajuḥśākhānvite dadyātpaścimaṃ ghaṭamuttamam .. 32 ..
4.83.d:
पूर्वं तु बह्वृचे दयाच्छंदोगे दक्षिणं तथा ॥
यजुःशाखान्विते दद्यात्पश्चिमं घटमुत्तमम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.83.m:
He should give the eastern [jar] to a Ṛgvedic priest, and the southern to a Chāndoga [priest];
he should give the excellent western jar to one endowed with the Yajur-branch,

4.83.s:
uttaraṃ kāmato dadyāddeśa eva vidhikramāt ..
ṛgvedaḥ prīyatāṃ pūrvaṃ sāmavedaśca dakṣiṇaḥ .. 33 ..
4.83.d:
उत्तरं कामतो दद्याद्देश एव विधिक्रमात् ॥
ऋग्वेदः प्रीयतां पूर्वं सामवेदश्च दक्षिणः ॥ 33 ॥
4.83.m:
and according to rule, in due order of regions, he should bestow the northern one by choice,
[saying:] 'May the Ṛgveda be pleased' for the east, 'and the Sāmaveda' for the south,

4.83.s:
yajuṣaḥ paścimo nāmnā ātharvāyottaraṃ tathā ..
pūrṇapātraistu satilaiḥ sthagitānkārayeddhaṭān .. 34 ..
4.83.d:
यजुषः पश्चिमो नाम्ना आथर्वायोत्तरं तथा ॥
पूर्णपात्रैस्तु सतिलैः स्थगितान्कारयेद्धटान् ॥ 34 ॥
4.83.m:
'For the Yajurveda' the western by name, and likewise 'For the Atharvaveda' the northern;
he should have the jars covered with full dishes containing sesame seeds.

4.83.s:
tatastaṃ jalapātrasthaṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine ..
dadyādevaṃ mahābhāga tataḥ paścāttu bhojayet .. 35 ..
4.83.d:
ततस्तं जलपात्रस्थं ब्राह्मणाय कुटुंबिने ॥
दद्यादेवं महाभाग ततः पश्चात्तु भोजयेत् ॥ 35 ॥
4.83.m:
Then, O fortunate one, he should give that [image of the fish] situated in the water vessel
to a family-man brahmin; and thereafter he should feed

4.83.s:
brāhmaṇānpāyasānnena tataḥ paścātsvayaṃ gṛhī ..
bhuñjīta bhṛtyasahito vāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ .. 36 ..
4.83.d:
ब्राह्मणान्पायसान्नेन ततः पश्चात्स्वयं गृही ॥
भुञ्जीत भृत्यसहितो वाग्यतः संयतेन्द्रियः ॥ 36 ॥
4.83.m:
the brahmins with milk-rice; and after that the householder himself,
accompanied by his servants, restrained in speech and with controlled senses, should eat.

4.83.s:
anena vidhinā yastu dvādaśīṃ kṣapayennaraḥ ..
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājañchṛṇu satyavatāṃ vara .. 37 ..
4.83.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु द्वादशीं क्षपयेन्नरः ॥
तस्य पुण्यफलं राजञ्छृणु सत्यवतां वर ॥ 37 ॥
4.83.m:
The man who spends the twelfth lunar day according to this rule—
hear the meritorious fruit of that, O king, best of the truthful!

4.83.s:
yadi vaktrasahasrāṇi bhavaṃti hi yugeyuge ..
āyuśca brahmaṇastulyaṃ bhavedyadi mahāmate ..
tadasya phalasaṃkhyānaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ na dhārayet .. 38 ..
4.83.d:
यदि वक्त्रसहस्राणि भवंति हि युगेयुगे ॥
आयुश्च ब्रह्मणस्तुल्यं भवेद्यदि महामते ॥
तदस्य फलसंख्यानं कर्तुं शक्यं न धारयेत् ॥ 38 ॥
4.83.m:
Even if one had thousands of mouths in age after age,
and a lifespan equal to Brahmā's, O wise one,
even so, one could not succeed in counting its fruit.

4.83.s:
yaḥ kṛṣṇadvādaśīmetāmanena vidhinā nṛpa ..
karoti brahmalokaṃ sa samāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ .. 39 ..
4.83.d:
यः कृष्णद्वादशीमेतामनेन विधिना नृप ॥
करोति ब्रह्मलोकं स समाप्नोति न संशयः ॥ 39 ॥
4.83.m:
The king who observes this twelfth lunar day of Kṛṣṇa according to this rule,
he attains the world of Brahmā; there is no doubt about this.

4.83.s:
brahmahatyādipāpāni janmāṃtarakṛtānyapi ..
akāmataḥ kāmato vā praṇaśyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ .. 4.83.40 ..
4.83.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि जन्मांतरकृतान्यपि ॥
अकामतः कामतो वा प्रणश्यंति न संशयः ॥ 4.83.40 ॥
4.83.m:
Sins such as the murder of a brahmin, even those committed in another lifetime,
whether done unintentionally or intentionally, are destroyed without a doubt.

4.83.s:
tathaiva pauṣamāsena amṛtaṃ mathitaṃ suraiḥ ..
tacca kūrmobhavaddevaḥ svayameva janārdanaḥ .. 41 ..
4.83.d:
तथैव पौषमासेन अमृतं मथितं सुरैः ॥
तच्च कूर्मोभवद्देवः स्वयमेव जनार्दनः ॥ 41 ॥
4.83.m:
In the very same way, in the month of Pauṣa, the nectar was churned by the gods;
and Lord Janārdana became the Tortoise himself.

4.83.s:
tasyeyaṃ tithiruddiṣṭā harervai kūrmarūpiṇaḥ ..
pauṣamāsaṃ samāsādya dvādaśīṃ śuklasaṃyutām .. 42 ..
4.83.d:
तस्येयं तिथिरुद्दिष्टा हरेर्वै कूर्मरूपिणः ॥
पौषमासं समासाद्य द्वादशीं शुक्लसंयुताम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.83.m:
This lunar day is designated for Hari in the form of the Tortoise:
reaching the month of Pauṣa on the twelfth lunar day joined with the bright [fortnight],

4.83.s:
tasyāṃ prāgvatsaṃkalpaḥ prātaḥsnānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
nirvartyārādhayedrātryāmekādaśyāṃ janārdanam ..
prīyamaṃtrairnṛpaśreṣṭha devadevaṃ jagadgurum .. 43 ..
4.83.d:
तस्यां प्राग्वत्संकल्पः प्रातःस्नानादिकाः क्रियाः ॥
निर्वर्त्याराधयेद्रात्र्यामेकादश्यां जनार्दनम् ॥
प्रीयमंत्रैर्नृपश्रेष्ठ देवदेवं जगद्गुरुम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.83.m:
having on that [day] made the resolution as before, and completed the morning ablutions and other rites,
he should worship Janārdana at night on the eleventh lunar day,
the God of gods, teacher of the world, with propitiating mantras, O best of kings.

4.83.s:
kūrmāya pādau prathamaṃ supūjya nārāṇāyeti kaṭiṃ harestu ..
saṅkarṣaṇāyetyudaraṃ viśodhetpurobhavāyeti ca kaṃṭhapīṭham .. 44 ..
4.83.d:
कूर्माय पादौ प्रथमं सुपूज्य नाराणायेति कटिं हरेस्तु ॥
सङ्कर्षणायेत्युदरं विशोधेत्पुरोभवायेति च कंठपीठम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.83.m: Having first duly worshipped the feet with '[Homage] to the Tortoise,' and the waist of Hari with '[Homage] to Nārāyaṇa,' / one should purify the belly with '[Homage] to Saṅkarṣaṇa,' and the neck-base with '[Homage] to the First-Born,'

4.83.s:
subāhavetyeva bhujau śiraśca sarvātmane pāṃḍava pūjanīyau ..
svanāmamaṃtreṇa ca śaṃkhacakre gadāṃ namaskārapareṇa caiva .. 45 ..
4.83.d:
सुबाहवेत्येव भुजौ शिरश्च सर्वात्मने पांडव पूजनीयौ ॥
स्वनाममंत्रेण च शंखचक्रे गदां नमस्कारपरेण चैव ॥ 45 ॥
4.83.m: the two arms with '[Homage] to the Well-Armed,' and the head with '[Homage] to the Universal Self, O Pāṇḍava, are to be worshipped; / and the conch and discus with the mantra of their own names, and the mace with '[Homage] with salutation.'

4.83.s:
ebhirmantraiḥ puṣpasugandhadhūpairnaive dyadīpairvividhaiḥ phalaiśca ..
abhyarcya devaṃ kalaśaṃ tadagre saṃsthāpayenmālyavilepanādyam .. 46 ..
4.83.d:
एभिर्मन्त्रैः पुष्पसुगन्धधूपैर्नैवे द्यदीपैर्विविधैः फलैश्च ॥
अभ्यर्च्य देवं कलशं तदग्रे संस्थापयेन्माल्यविलेपनाद्यम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.83.m: Having worshipped the god with these mantras, with flowers, fragrant incenses, / food-offerings, lamps, and various fruits, one should set up a jar before him, with garlands, ointments, and so forth.

4.83.s:
taṃ ratnagarbhaṃ susugaṃdhatoyaṃ kṛtvā tato hemamayaṃ svaśa ktyā ..
samaṃdaraṃ kūrmatanuṃ sureśaṃ saṃsthāpayeccātra śubhe ca pātre ..47..
4.83.d:
तं रत्नगर्भं सुसुगंधतोयं कृत्वा ततो हेममयं स्वश क्त्या ॥
समंदरं कूर्मतनुं सुरेशं संस्थापयेच्चात्र शुभे च पात्रे ॥47॥
4.83.m: Having made it filled with gems and sweet-scented water, one should then, according to one's means, place the lord of gods, / having the form of a tortoise, fashioned of gold together with Mount Mandara, in an auspicious vessel there,

4.83.s:
ghṛtaiśca pūrṇe kalaśā'grasaṃsthaṃ saṃpūjayejjāgaranṛtyagītaiḥ..
saṃpūjya viprānghṛtapāyasena nivedya pūrvaṃ dvijapuṅgavāya ..
nirvartya sarvaṃ vidhivattataśca bhuñjīta saṃtuṣṭamanāḥ sabhṛtyaḥ .. 48 ..
4.83.d:
घृतैश्च पूर्णे कलशाऽग्रसंस्थं संपूजयेज्जागरनृत्यगीतैः॥
संपूज्य विप्रान्घृतपायसेन निवेद्य पूर्वं द्विजपुङ्गवाय ॥
निर्वर्त्य सर्वं विधिवत्ततश्च भुञ्जीत संतुष्टमनाः सभृत्यः ॥ 48 ॥
4.83.m: filled with clarified butter, resting on the mouth of the jar, and worship him with vigils, dances, and songs. / Having worshipped the brahmins with clarified butter and milk-rice, first offering it to an eminent twice-born, / and having accomplished everything according to rule, he should then eat with a contented mind, together with his servants.

4.83.s: evaṃ kṛte kalpayugāṃtarāṇi svarge vasetsarvasamṛddhakāmaḥ ..49..
4.83.d: एवं कृते कल्पयुगांतराणि स्वर्गे वसेत्सर्वसमृद्धकामः ॥49॥
4.83.m: When this is done, he dwells in heaven for kalpas and yugas, with all his desires fulfilled.

4.83.s:
saṃsāracakraṃ sa vihāya śīghramāpnoti loke tu hareḥ purāṇe ..
prayāṃti pāpāni vināśamāśu śriyā yuto jāyati satyadharma ..4.83.50..
4.83.d:
संसारचक्रं स विहाय शीघ्रमाप्नोति लोके तु हरेः पुराणे ॥
प्रयांति पापानि विनाशमाशु श्रिया युतो जायति सत्यधर्म ॥4.83.50॥
4.83.m: Leaving behind the cycle of rebirth, he swiftly reaches the ancient world of Hari. / His sins swiftly go to destruction; endowed with prosperity, he is born upholding the true law.

4.83.s:
anekajanmārjitasaṃyutāni naśyaṃti pāpāni narasya bhaktyā ..
prāguktarūpaṃ ca phalaṃ labheta nārāyaṇaṃ vastumupaiti sadyaḥ .. 51 ..
4.83.d:
अनेकजन्मार्जितसंयुतानि नश्यंति पापानि नरस्य भक्त्या ॥
प्रागुक्तरूपं च फलं लभेत नारायणं वस्तुमुपैति सद्यः ॥ 51 ॥
4.83.m: Sins accumulated across many lifetimes are destroyed by a man's devotion. / He obtains the fruit described earlier, and at once attains to dwelling with Nārāyaṇa.

4.83.s:
evaṃ māghe site pakṣe dvādaśīṃ dharaṇīdhara ..
varāhasya śṛṇuṣvānyāṃ rājanparamadhārmika .. 52 ..
4.83.d:
एवं माघे सिते पक्षे द्वादशीं धरणीधर ॥
वराहस्य शृणुष्वान्यां राजन्परमधार्मिक ॥ 52 ॥
4.83.m: In this manner, on the twelfth day in the bright fortnight of Māgha, O supporter of the earth, / listen to another [observance] of Varāha, O most righteous king.

4.83.s:
prāguktena vidhānena snānaṃ saṃkalpameva ca ..
kṛtvā devaṃ samabhyarcya ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ .. 53 ..
4.83.d:
प्रागुक्तेन विधानेन स्नानं संकल्पमेव च ॥
कृत्वा देवं समभ्यर्च्य एकादश्यां समाहितः ॥ 53 ॥
4.83.m: Having performed the bath and solemn resolve according to the rule declared before, / and having worshipped the god with a concentrated mind on the eleventh day,

4.83.s:
dhūpanaivedyagaṃdhaistu arcayitvā punarnaraḥ ..
paścāttasyāgrataḥ kuṃbhaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ tu vinyaset .. 54 ..
4.83.d:
धूपनैवेद्यगंधैस्तु अर्चयित्वा पुनर्नरः ॥
पश्चात्तस्याग्रतः कुंभं जलपूर्णं तु विन्यसेत् ॥ 54 ॥
4.83.m: and having worshipped again with incenses, food-offerings, and perfumes, a man / should then place before him a pot filled with water.

4.83.s:
varāhāyeti pādau tu mādhavāyeti vai kaṭim ..
kṣetrajñāyeti jaṭharaṃ viśvarūpetyuro hareḥ ..55..
4.83.d:
वराहायेति पादौ तु माधवायेति वै कटिम् ॥
क्षेत्रज्ञायेति जठरं विश्वरूपेत्युरो हरेः ॥55॥
4.83.m: The feet with '[Homage] to the Boar,' the waist with '[Homage] to Mādhava,' / the belly with '[Homage] to the Knower of the Field,' the chest of Hari with '[Homage] to the Cosmic-Formed,'

4.83.s:
pūrvatrāyeti kaṃṭhaṃ tu prajānāṃ pataye śiraḥ ..
pradyumnāyeti ca bhujau divyāstrā ya sudarśanam ..56..
4.83.d:
पूर्वत्रायेति कंठं तु प्रजानां पतये शिरः ॥
प्रद्युम्नायेति च भुजौ दिव्यास्त्रा य सुदर्शनम् ॥56॥
4.83.m: the neck with '[Homage] to the Former Protector,' the head to the Lord of Creatures, / the arms with '[Homage] to Pradyumna,' the Sudarśana [discus] with '[Homage] to the Divine Weapon,'

4.83.s:
amṛtodbhavāya śaṃkhaṃ tu gadine ca gadāṃ tathā ..
evamabhyarcya medhāvī tasminkuṃbhe'pi vinyaset ..57..
4.83.d:
अमृतोद्भवाय शंखं तु गदिने च गदां तथा ॥
एवमभ्यर्च्य मेधावी तस्मिन्कुंभेऽपि विन्यसेत् ॥57॥
4.83.m: the conch with '[Homage] to the One Arisen from Nectar,' and the mace with '[Homage] to the Mace-Bearer'— / having thus worshipped, the wise man should also place upon that pot

4.83.s:
sauvarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ tāmraṃ vā pātraṃ vibhavaśaktitaḥ ..
sarvabījaistu saṃpūrṇaṃ sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 58 ..
4.83.d:
सौवर्णं रूप्यं ताम्रं वा पात्रं विभवशक्तितः ॥
सर्वबीजैस्तु संपूर्णं स्थापयित्वा विचक्षणः ॥ 58 ॥
4.83.m: a vessel of gold, silver, or copper, according to the extent of his wealth. / Having placed it, filled with all kinds of seeds, the discerning man

4.83.s:
tatra śaktyā ca sauvarṇaṃ vārāhaṃ kārayettataḥ ..
daṃṣṭrāgreṇoddharanpṛthvīṃ saparvatavanadrumām .. 59 ..
4.83.d:
तत्र शक्त्या च सौवर्णं वाराहं कारयेत्ततः ॥
दंष्ट्राग्रेणोद्धरन्पृथ्वीं सपर्वतवनद्रुमाम् ॥ 59 ॥
4.83.m: should then cause a golden image of the Boar to be made there, according to his means, / lifting up the earth with the tip of his tusk, along with mountains, forests, and trees—

4.83.s:
mādhavaṃ madhuhaṃtāraṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitam ..
sarvabījabhṛtaiḥ pātrai ratnagarbhaghaṭopari .. 4.83.60 ..
4.83.d:
माधवं मधुहंतारं वाराहं रूपमास्थितम् ॥
सर्वबीजभृतैः पात्रै रत्नगर्भघटोपरि ॥ 4.83.60 ॥
4.83.m: Mādhava, the slayer of Madhu, who has assumed the form of the Boar. / Upon the jar containing gems, with vessels filled with all seeds,

4.83.s:
sthāpayetparamaṃ devaṃ jātarūpamayaṃ harim ..
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ tāmrābhāve tu vaiṇave .. 61 ..
4.83.d:
स्थापयेत्परमं देवं जातरूपमयं हरिम् ॥
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं ताम्राभावे तु वैणवे ॥ 61 ॥
4.83.m: he should install the supreme god, Hari, made of gold, / covered with a pair of white garments; or in a bamboo vessel if copper is lacking.

4.83.s:
sthāpyārcayedgandhapuṣpairnaivedyairvividhaiḥ phalaiḥ ..
puṣpamaṃḍapikāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet .. 62 ..
4.83.d:
स्थाप्यार्चयेद्गन्धपुष्पैर्नैवेद्यैर्विविधैः फलैः ॥
पुष्पमंडपिकां कृत्वा जागरं तत्र कारयेत् ॥ 62 ॥
4.83.m: Having installed it, he should worship with perfumes, flowers, food-offerings, and various fruits. / Having made a small pavilion of flowers, he should keep a vigil there.

4.83.s:
prādurbhāvaṃ harerdivyaṃ vācayedgāpayedbudhaḥ ..
evaṃ saniyamasyāsya prabhāte udite ravau .. 63 ..
4.83.d:
प्रादुर्भावं हरेर्दिव्यं वाचयेद्गापयेद्बुधः ॥
एवं सनियमस्यास्य प्रभाते उदिते रवौ ॥ 63 ॥
4.83.m: The wise man should cause the divine manifestation of Hari to be recited and sung. / Thus keeping this observance, at dawn when the sun has risen,

4.83.s:
vedavedāṅgaviduṣe sādhuvṛttāya dhīmate ..
viṣṇubhaktāya rājendra viśeṣeṇa pradāpayet .. 64 ..
4.83.d:
वेदवेदाङ्गविदुषे साधुवृत्ताय धीमते ॥
विष्णुभक्ताय राजेन्द्र विशेषेण प्रदापयेत् ॥ 64 ॥
4.83.m: he should specially bestow it, O king of kings, upon a wise man / who knows the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, of virtuous conduct, devoted to Viṣṇu.

4.83.s:
evaṃ sakuṃbhaṃ dattvā ca hariṃ vārāharūpiṇam ..
brāhmaṇāya bhavedyadvatphalaṃ tanme niśāmaya .. 65 ..
4.83.d:
एवं सकुंभं दत्त्वा च हरिं वाराहरूपिणम् ॥
ब्राह्मणाय भवेद्यद्वत्फलं तन्मे निशामय ॥ 65 ॥
4.83.m: Having thus given Hari in the form of the Boar together with the pot / to a brahmin, listen from me to the fruit that comes to be:

4.83.s:
iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ śrīkāntī puṣṭimeva ca ..
prāpnoti puruṣo rājanyadyadicchati kiṃcana .. 66 ..
4.83.d:
इह जन्मनि सौभाग्यं श्रीकान्ती पुष्टिमेव च ॥
प्राप्नोति पुरुषो राजन्यद्यदिच्छति किंचन ॥ 66 ॥
4.83.m: In this lifetime, a man obtains good fortune, beauty, splendour, and nourishment, O king, / whatever he might desire.

4.83.s:
ekā'pi vidhinopāstā dadātyamṛtamuttamam ..
kiṃpunarvarṣamekaṃ ca karoti kurunaṃdana .. 67 ..
4.83.d:
एकाऽपि विधिनोपास्ता ददात्यमृतमुत्तमम् ॥
किंपुनर्वर्षमेकं च करोति कुरुनंदन ॥ 67 ॥
4.83.m: Even a single [observance] worshipped according to rule gives supreme immortality; / how much more so if one performs it for an entire year, O delight of the Kurus!

4.83.s:
eṣā ca phālgune māsi śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśī ..
upoṣyā pūrvavidhinā harimārādhayetsudhīḥ .. 68 ..
4.83.d:
एषा च फाल्गुने मासि शुक्लपक्षे तु द्वादशी ॥
उपोष्या पूर्वविधिना हरिमाराधयेत्सुधीः ॥ 68 ॥
4.83.m: And this twelfth day in the bright fortnight in the month of Phālguna / is to be fasted on according to the prior rule; the wise man should worship Hari:

4.83.s:
narasiṃhāya pādau tu goviṃdāyodaraṃ tathā ..
kaṭiṃ viśvasṛje pūjya aniruddhetyuro hareḥ .. 69 ..
4.83.d:
नरसिंहाय पादौ तु गोविंदायोदरं तथा ॥
कटिं विश्वसृजे पूज्य अनिरुद्धेत्युरो हरेः ॥ 69 ॥
4.83.m: The feet with '[Homage] to Narasiṃha,' and the belly with '[Homage] to Govinda,' / having worshipped the waist with '[Homage] to the Creator of the Universe,' and the chest of Hari with '[Homage] to Aniruddha,'

4.83.s:
kaṃṭhaṃ tu śitikaṃṭhāya vainateyāya vai śiraḥ ...
asuradhvaṃsanāyeti vaktraṃ toyātmane namaḥ .. 4.83.70 ..
4.83.d:
कंठं तु शितिकंठाय वैनतेयाय वै शिरः ॥।
असुरध्वंसनायेति वक्त्रं तोयात्मने नमः ॥ 4.83.70 ॥
4.83.m: the neck with '[Homage] to the Blue-Throated,' the head with '[Homage] to the Son of Vinatā,' / the mouth with '[Homage] to the Destroyer of Asuras,' [and saying] 'Homage to the Self of Water,'

4.83.s:
śaṃkhamityeva saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ phalaistathā ..
tadagre tu ghaṭaṃ sthāpya sitavastrayugānvitam .. 71 ..
4.83.d:
शंखमित्येव संपूज्य गंधपुष्पैः फलैस्तथा ॥
तदग्रे तु घटं स्थाप्य सितवस्त्रयुगान्वितम् ॥ 71 ॥
4.83.m: having thus worshipped the conch, and likewise with perfumes, flowers, and fruits, / and having set up a pot before him, covered with a pair of white garments,

4.83.s:
tasyopari nṛsiṃhaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ tāmrabhājane ..
haime ca śaktitaḥ kṛtvā dāruvaṃśamaye'pi vā .. 72 ..
4.83.d:
तस्योपरि नृसिंहं तु सौवर्णं ताम्रभाजने ॥
हैमे च शक्तितः कृत्वा दारुवंशमयेऽपि वा ॥ 72 ॥
4.83.m: and having made a golden Narasiṃha upon it in a copper bowl, / or in a golden one, according to his means, or even one made of wood or bamboo,

4.83.s:
ratnagarbhamaye sthāpya bhaktyā saṃpūjya mānavaḥ ..
dvādaśyāṃ vedaviduṣe brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 73 ..
4.83.d:
रत्नगर्भमये स्थाप्य भक्त्या संपूज्य मानवः ॥
द्वादश्यां वेदविदुषे ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 73 ॥
4.83.m: and placing it upon [the pot] containing gems, having worshipped with devotion, a man / should offer it on the twelfth day to a brahmin learned in the Vedas.

4.83.s:
eṣā vaṃdyā pāpaharā dvādaśī bhavate mayā ..
kathitā ca prayatnena śrutā ca bhavatepsitā .. 74 ..
4.83.d:
एषा वंद्या पापहरा द्वादशी भवते मया ॥
कथिता च प्रयत्नेन श्रुता च भवतेप्सिता ॥ 74 ॥
4.83.m: This adorable, sin-destroying twelfth day has been declared by me / to you with effort, and heard by you as desired.

4.83.s:
evamenāṃ naravyāghra caitre saṃkalpya dvādaśīm ..
upoṣyārādhayetpaścāddevadevaṃ janārdanam .. 75 ..
4.83.d:
एवमेनां नरव्याघ्र चैत्रे संकल्प्य द्वादशीम् ॥
उपोष्याराधयेत्पश्चाद्देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ॥ 75 ॥
4.83.m: Having thus resolved upon this twelfth day in Caitra, O tiger among men, / and fasted, one should subsequently worship Janārdana, the god of gods.

4.83.s:
kuṇḍikāṃ sthāpayetpārśve chatrikāṃ pāduke tathā ..
amalaṃ vāmanaṃ sthāpya bṛsīṃ kāṃsaparicchadām .. 76 ..
4.83.d:
कुण्डिकां स्थापयेत्पार्श्वे छत्रिकां पादुके तथा ॥
अमलं वामनं स्थाप्य बृसीं कांसपरिच्छदाम् ॥ 76 ॥
4.83.m: One should place an ascetic's water-pot beside him, as well as a small parasol and two sandals; / having installed the stainless Dwarf, [one should place] a grass cushion furnished with bronze,

4.83.s:
phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sugandhaiśca prabhāte saddvijātaye ..
dāpayetprīyatāṃ viṣṇurhrasvarūpītyudīrayet .. .. 77 ..
4.83.d:
फलैः पुष्पैः सुगन्धैश्च प्रभाते सद्द्विजातये ॥
दापयेत्प्रीयतां विष्णुर्ह्रस्वरूपीत्युदीरयेत् ॥ ॥ 77 ॥
4.83.m: with fruits, flowers, and sweet scents; at dawn, he should cause it to be given to a good twice-born, / and should say: 'May Viṣṇu in the form of a dwarf be pleased.'

4.83.s:
māsanāmnātra saṃyuktaṃ prādurbhāvaṃ vidhānataḥ ..
prīyatāmiti sarvatra vidhireva prakīrtitaḥ .. 78 ..
4.83.d:
मासनाम्नात्र संयुक्तं प्रादुर्भावं विधानतः ॥
प्रीयतामिति सर्वत्र विधिरेव प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 78 ॥
4.83.m: Here, combined with the name of the month, the manifestation [is worshipped] according to rule. / 'May he be pleased' is proclaimed as the rule everywhere.

4.83.s:
aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamāpnuyāt ..
bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyaṃ mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet .. 79 ..
4.83.d:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो धनमाप्नुयात् ॥
भ्रष्टराज्यो लभेद्राज्यं मृतो विष्णुपुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 79 ॥
4.83.m: One without a son obtains a son; one without wealth obtains wealth; / one fallen from his kingdom obtains a kingdom; when dead, he goes to the city of Viṣṇu.

4.83.s:
krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālamiha martyamupāgataḥ ..
cakravartī bhaveddhīmānyayātiriti nāhuṣaḥ..4.83.80..
4.83.d:
क्रीडित्वा सुचिरं कालमिह मर्त्यमुपागतः ॥
चक्रवर्ती भवेद्धीमान्ययातिरिति नाहुषः॥4.83.80॥
4.83.m: Having sported for a very long time, and returned here to the mortal world, / he becomes a wise universal monarch, like Yayāti, son of Nahuṣa.

4.83.s:
vaiśākhe'pyevamevaṃ tu saṃkalpya vidhivannaraḥ ..
tadvatsnānaṃ mṛdā tadvattato devālayaṃ vrajet .. 81 ..
4.83.d:
वैशाखेऽप्येवमेवं तु संकल्प्य विधिवन्नरः ॥
तद्वत्स्नानं मृदा तद्वत्ततो देवालयं व्रजेत् ॥ 81 ॥
4.83.m: In Vaiśākha as well, having formed the solemn resolve in this very manner according to rule, a man, / after bathing likewise with earth, should then go to the temple of the god.

4.83.s:
tatrārādhya hariṃ bhaktyā ebhirmantrairvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
jāmadagnyāya pādau tu udaraṃ sarvadhāriṇe .. 82 ..
4.83.d:
तत्राराध्य हरिं भक्त्या एभिर्मन्त्रैर्विचक्षणः ॥
जामदग्न्याय पादौ तु उदरं सर्वधारिणे ॥ 82 ॥
4.83.m: Having worshipped Hari there with devotion by means of these mantras, the discerning man / [worships] the feet with '[Homage] to the Son of Jamadagni,' and the belly with '[Homage] to the Bearer of All,'

4.83.s:
madhusūdanāyeti kaṭimuraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe ..
kṣatrāṃtakāya ca bhujau maṇikaṇṭhāya kaṇṭhakam .. 83 ..
4.83.d:
मधुसूदनायेति कटिमुरः श्रीवत्सधारिणे ॥
क्षत्रांतकाय च भुजौ मणिकण्ठाय कण्ठकम् ॥ 83 ॥
4.83.m: the waist with '[Homage] to the Slayer of Madhu,' the chest with '[Homage] to the Bearer of the Śrīvatsa,' / the arms with '[Homage] to the Destroyer of Kṣatriyas,' the neck with '[Homage] to the Jewel-Necked,'

4.83.s:
pūjayenniyato bhūtvā surūpāyeti vai mukham ..
svanāmnā śaṃkhacakre ca śiro brahmāṃḍadhāriṇe .. 84 ..
4.83.d:
पूजयेन्नियतो भूत्वा सुरूपायेति वै मुखम् ॥
स्वनाम्ना शंखचक्रे च शिरो ब्रह्मांडधारिणे ॥ 84 ॥
4.83.m: being restrained, he should worship the face with '[Homage] to the Handsome,' / the conch and discus with their own names, and the head with '[Homage] to the Bearer of the Egg of Brahmā.'

4.83.s:
evamabhyarcya medhāvī prāgvaṃśasyāgrato ghaṭam ..
vinyasyetpuṣpavastrāḍhyaṃ sitacandanacarcitam .. 85 ..
4.83.d:
एवमभ्यर्च्य मेधावी प्राग्वंशस्याग्रतो घटम् ॥
विन्यस्येत्पुष्पवस्त्राढ्यं सितचन्दनचर्चितम् ॥ 85 ॥
4.83.m: Having thus worshipped, the wise man should place a pot before the Prāgvaṃśa, / abundant in flowers and cloth, and smeared with white sandalwood.

4.83.s:
vaiṇave'bhinave pātre sthāpayenmadhusūdanam ..
jāmadagnyena rūpeṇa kṛtvā sauvarṇamagrataḥ .. 86 ..
4.83.d:
वैणवेऽभिनवे पात्रे स्थापयेन्मधुसूदनम् ॥
जामदग्न्येन रूपेण कृत्वा सौवर्णमग्रतः ॥ 86 ॥
4.83.m: In a fresh bamboo vessel he should place Madhusūdana, / having first fashioned him in gold in the form of Paraśurāma, son of Jamadagni.

4.83.s:
dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ haste tasya devasya kārayet ..
sarvagandhaistu saṃpūjya puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..87..
4.83.d:
दक्षिणे परशुं हस्ते तस्य देवस्य कारयेत् ॥
सर्वगन्धैस्तु संपूज्य पुष्पैर्नानाविधैः शुभैः ॥87॥
4.83.m: In the right hand of that deity an axe should be made. / Worshiping him with all perfumes and various auspicious flowers,

4.83.s:
tatastasyāgrataḥ kuryājjāgaraṃ bhaktimānnaraḥ ..
prabhāte vimale sūrye brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 88 ..
4.83.d:
ततस्तस्याग्रतः कुर्याज्जागरं भक्तिमान्नरः ॥
प्रभाते विमले सूर्ये ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 88 ॥
4.83.m: the devoted man should then keep a night vigil before him; / at dawn, when the sun is clear, he should present it to a brāhmaṇa.

4.83.s:
evaṃ niyamayuktasya yatphalaṃ tannibodha me ..
kāśyape brahmaṇo loke coṣitvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ..
sthitvā bhaute ca sṛṣṭau ca cakravartī bhaveddhruvam .. 89 ..
4.83.d:
एवं नियमयुक्तस्य यत्फलं तन्निबोध मे ॥
काश्यपे ब्रह्मणो लोके चोषित्वाप्सरसां गणैः ॥
स्थित्वा भौते च सृष्टौ च चक्रवर्ती भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 89 ॥
4.83.m: Hear from me the fruit of one who undertakes such an observance: / having dwelt in Kaśyapa's world, in the realm of Brahmā, with hosts of apsarases, / and having remained in the elemental realm and in creation, he will surely become an emperor.

4.83.s:
jyeṣṭhe māse'pyevameva saṃkalpya vidhivannaraḥ ..
arcayetparamaṃ devaṃ puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..4.83.90..
4.83.d:
ज्येष्ठे मासेऽप्येवमेव संकल्प्य विधिवन्नरः ॥
अर्चयेत्परमं देवं पुष्पैर्नानाविधैः शुभैः ॥4.83.90॥
4.83.m: In the month of Jyeṣṭha likewise, having formed the resolve according to rule, a man / should worship the supreme god with various auspicious flowers:

4.83.s:
namo dāmodarāyeti pādau pūrvaṃ samarcayet ..
trivikramāyeti kaṭiṃ dhṛtaviśvāya codaram ..91..
4.83.d:
नमो दामोदरायेति पादौ पूर्वं समर्चयेत् ॥
त्रिविक्रमायेति कटिं धृतविश्वाय चोदरम् ॥91॥
4.83.m: First he should worship the feet, saying, 'Homage to Dāmodara,' / the hips with 'To Trivikrama,' and the belly with 'To the Holder of the Universe';

4.83.s:
uraḥ saṃvartakāyeti kaṇṭhaṃ saṃvatsarāya ca ..
sarvāsudhāriṇe bāhuṃ svanāmnābjarathāṃgake .. 92 ..
4.83.d:
उरः संवर्तकायेति कण्ठं संवत्सराय च ॥
सर्वासुधारिणे बाहुं स्वनाम्नाब्जरथांगके ॥ 92 ॥
4.83.m: the chest with 'To Saṃvartaka,' and the throat with 'To Saṃvatsara,' / the arms with 'To the Bearer of all weapons,' and the lotus and discus with their own names;

4.83.s:
sahasraśirase'bhyarcya śirastasya mahātmanaḥ ..
evamabhyarcya vidhivatprāguktavidhivannyaset .. 93 ..
4.83.d:
सहस्रशिरसेऽभ्यर्च्य शिरस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥
एवमभ्यर्च्य विधिवत्प्रागुक्तविधिवन्न्यसेत् ॥ 93 ॥
4.83.m: having worshiped the head of that great-souled one with 'To the Thousand-headed,' / and having thus worshiped him according to rule, he should deposit them as previously prescribed.

4.83.s:
prāgvadvastrasugandhaiśca sauvarṇau rāmalakṣmaṇau ..
arcayitvā vidhānena prabhāte brāhmaṇāya tau ..
dātavyau manasā kāmamīhatā puruṣeṇa tu .. 94 ..
4.83.d:
प्राग्वद्वस्त्रसुगन्धैश्च सौवर्णौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥
अर्चयित्वा विधानेन प्रभाते ब्राह्मणाय तौ ॥
दातव्यौ मनसा काममीहता पुरुषेण तु ॥ 94 ॥
4.83.m: With cloth and sweet scents as before, two golden images of Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa / having been worshiped according to the rite, in the morning they should / be given to a brāhmaṇa by a man desiring the fulfillment of his wish in mind.

4.83.s:
aputreṇa purā pṛṣṭo rājñā daśarathena tu ..
putrakāmena yajatā vaśiṣṭhaḥ paramārcitaḥ .. 95 ..
4.83.d:
अपुत्रेण पुरा पृष्टो राज्ञा दशरथेन तु ॥
पुत्रकामेन यजता वशिष्ठः परमार्चितः ॥ 95 ॥
4.83.m: Formerly, when King Daśaratha, having no son, / sacrificed in desire for a son, the supremely revered Vasiṣṭha was questioned.

4.83.s:
idameva vidhānaṃ tu kathayāmāsa vai dvijaḥ ..
sarahasyaṃ viditvātra sa rājā kṛtavāni dam .. 96 ..
4.83.d:
इदमेव विधानं तु कथयामास वै द्विजः ॥
सरहस्यं विदित्वात्र स राजा कृतवानि दम् ॥ 96 ॥
4.83.m: The twice-born sage explained this very procedure; / understanding it with its secret mystery, that king performed this.

4.83.s:
tasya putraḥ svayaṃ jajñe rāmo nāma mahābalaḥ ..
caturddhā so'vyayo viṣṇuḥ paritoṣādajāyata ..
etadevaṃ mayākhyātaṃ paraloke sukhapra dam .. 97 ..
4.83.d:
तस्य पुत्रः स्वयं जज्ञे रामो नाम महाबलः ॥
चतुर्द्धा सोऽव्ययो विष्णुः परितोषादजायत ॥
एतदेवं मयाख्यातं परलोके सुखप्र दम् ॥ 97 ॥
4.83.m: To him was born directly a son named Rāma, possessed of great strength; / fourfold was the imperishable Viṣṇu born out of his satisfaction. / This has thus been narrated by me, bestowing happiness in the other world.

4.83.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
āṣāḍhe'pyevameva tu saṃkalpya vidhinā naraḥ ..
arcayetparamaṃ devaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ samāhitaḥ .. 98 ..
4.83.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
आषाढेऽप्येवमेव तु संकल्प्य विधिना नरः ॥
अर्चयेत्परमं देवं गंधपुष्पैः समाहितः ॥ 98 ॥
4.83.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In Āṣāḍha likewise, having formed the resolve according to rule, a man / should worship the supreme god with concentrated mind using perfumes and flowers:

4.83.s:
vāsudevāya pādau tu kaṭiṃ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca ..
pradyumnāyeti jaṭharamaniruddhāya vai namaḥ .. 99 ..
4.83.d:
वासुदेवाय पादौ तु कटिं संकर्षणाय च ॥
प्रद्युम्नायेति जठरमनिरुद्धाय वै नमः ॥ 99 ॥
4.83.m: the feet with 'To Vāsudeva,' and the hips with 'To Saṃkarṣaṇa,' / the belly with 'To Pradyumna,' and indeed 'Homage to Aniruddha';

4.83.s:
cakrapāṇiṃ bhujau kaṃṭhaṃ mukhaṃ bhūpataye tathā ..
svanāmnā śaṃkhacakre tu puruṣāyeti vai śiraḥ .. 4.83.100 ..
4.83.d:
चक्रपाणिं भुजौ कंठं मुखं भूपतये तथा ॥
स्वनाम्ना शंखचक्रे तु पुरुषायेति वै शिरः ॥ 4.83.100 ॥
4.83.m: the arms with 'To the Discus-handed,' the throat and face likewise with 'To the Lord of the Earth,' / the conch and discus with their own names, and the head with 'To the Puruṣa.'

4.83.s:
evamabhyarcya medhāvī prāgvattasyāgrato ghaṭam ..
vinyasya vastrasaṃyuktaṃ tasyopari tato nyaset ..
kāṃcanaṃ vāsudeveti cakrabāhuṃ sanātanam .. 101 ..
4.83.d:
एवमभ्यर्च्य मेधावी प्राग्वत्तस्याग्रतो घटम् ॥
विन्यस्य वस्त्रसंयुक्तं तस्योपरि ततो न्यसेत् ॥
कांचनं वासुदेवेति चक्रबाहुं सनातनम् ॥ 101 ॥
4.83.m: Having thus worshiped, the wise man, having placed a jar before him as before / covered with cloth, should then deposit upon it / an eternal golden image of Vāsudeva holding a discus in his arm.

4.83.s:
tamabhyarcya vidhānena gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt ..
prāgvattadbrāhmaṇe dadyādvedavādini suvrate .. 102 ..
eṣā hyupoṣitā rājanvidyāṃ vipre prayacchati ..
rājyaṃ ca bhraṣṭarājyānāmaputrāṇāṃ sutānbahūn ..1 03..
mṛto viṣṇupure ramye krīḍate kālamakṣayam..1 04..
4.83.d:
तमभ्यर्च्य विधानेन गंधपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् ॥
प्राग्वत्तद्ब्राह्मणे दद्याद्वेदवादिनि सुव्रते ॥ 102 ॥
एषा ह्युपोषिता राजन्विद्यां विप्रे प्रयच्छति ॥
राज्यं च भ्रष्टराज्यानामपुत्राणां सुतान्बहून् ॥1 03॥
मृतो विष्णुपुरे रम्ये क्रीडते कालमक्षयम्॥1 04॥
4.83.m:
Having worshiped him according to rule in proper order with perfumes, flowers, and the like, / as before he should give it to a brāhmaṇa who recites the Veda and keeps good vows.
Indeed, this [observance] fasted gives learning to a priest, O King, / a kingdom to those who have lost their kingdom, and many sons to the sonless.
When dead, he disports himself in the delightful city of Viṣṇu for imperishable time.

4.83.s:
manvaṃtarāṇi ṣaṭtriṃśattataḥ kālātyaye punaḥ ..
iha loke bhavedrājā saptajanmani mānavaḥ ..
dātā yaśaḥkṣamāyuktastato nirvāṇamāpnuyāt .. 105 .. ..
4.83.d:
मन्वंतराणि षट्त्रिंशत्ततः कालात्यये पुनः ॥
इह लोके भवेद्राजा सप्तजन्मनि मानवः ॥
दाता यशःक्षमायुक्तस्ततो निर्वाणमाप्नुयात् ॥ 105 ॥ ॥
4.83.m: For thirty-six manvantaras; then, at the end of that time, once again / in this world he becomes a king for seven births, / a generous giver, endowed with renown and forbearance; thereafter he attains liberation.

4.83.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
evamevaṃ śrāvaṇe tu māsi saṃkalpya dvādaśīm ..
arcayetparamaṃ devaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpanivedanaiḥ .. 106 ..
4.83.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
एवमेवं श्रावणे तु मासि संकल्प्य द्वादशीम् ॥
अर्चयेत्परमं देवं गंधपुष्पनिवेदनैः ॥ 106 ॥
4.83.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In this very way, in the month of Śrāvaṇa, having formed the resolve for the twelfth day, / he should worship the supreme god with perfumes, flowers, and food-offerings:

4.83.s:
budhāya pādau saṃpūjya śrīdharāyeti vai kaṭim ..
padmodbhavāya jaṭharamuraḥ saṃvatsarāya ca .. 107 ..
4.83.d:
बुधाय पादौ संपूज्य श्रीधरायेति वै कटिम् ॥
पद्मोद्भवाय जठरमुरः संवत्सराय च ॥ 107 ॥
4.83.m: having worshiped the feet with 'To Budha,' and the hips with 'To Śrīdhara,' / the belly with 'To the Lotus-born,' and the chest with 'To Saṃvatsara';

4.83.s:
sugrīvāyeti vai kaṇṭhaṃ bhujau vai citrabāhave ..
prāgvadastrāṇi saṃpūjya brāhma ṇāya nivedayet .. 108 ..
4.83.d:
सुग्रीवायेति वै कण्ठं भुजौ वै चित्रबाहवे ॥
प्राग्वदस्त्राणि संपूज्य ब्राह्म णाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 108 ॥
4.83.m: the throat with 'To the Fine-necked,' and the arms with 'To the Manifold-armed'; / having worshiped the weapons as before, he should present it to a brāhmaṇa.

4.83.s:
anena vidhinā sarvāṃ dvādaśīṃ samupoṣitaḥ ..
śudaudanena tasyābhūtsvayaṃ putro janārdanaḥ .. 109 ..
4.83.d:
अनेन विधिना सर्वां द्वादशीं समुपोषितः ॥
शुदौदनेन तस्याभूत्स्वयं पुत्रो जनार्दनः ॥ 109 ॥
4.83.m: Fasting throughout the entire twelfth day according to this rule, / Janārdana himself became the son of Śuddhodana.

4.83.s:
mahatīṃ ca śriyaṃ prāpya putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ..
bhuktvā rājyaśriyaṃ sotha gataḥ paramikāṃ gatim .. 4.83.110 ..
4.83.d:
महतीं च श्रियं प्राप्य पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः ॥
भुक्त्वा राज्यश्रियं सोथ गतः परमिकां गतिम् ॥ 4.83.110 ॥
