4.83.m: Having attained immense royal fortune and endowed with sons and grandsons, / having enjoyed royal prosperity, he then went to the supreme state.

4.83.s:
eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi sattama..
ekaikopoṣitāpyastu rājyamekaiva yacchati ..
kiṃ punardvādaśaivātra dadyuraindraṃ mahatpadam .. 111 ..
4.83.d:
एष ते विधिरुद्दिष्टः श्रावणे मासि सत्तम॥
एकैकोपोषिताप्यस्तु राज्यमेकैव यच्छति ॥
किं पुनर्द्वादशैवात्र दद्युरैन्द्रं महत्पदम् ॥ 111 ॥
4.83.m: This rule has been declared to you for the month of Śrāvaṇa, O best of men; / even if only one is fasted, that single one grants a kingdom; / how much more will twelve here grant the great station of Indra!

4.83.s:
tadvadbhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśīm ..
saṃkalpya vidhinā devamarcayetparameśvaram .. 112 ..
4.83.d:
तद्वद्भाद्रपदे मासि शुक्लपक्षे तु द्वादशीम् ॥
संकल्प्य विधिना देवमर्चयेत्परमेश्वरम् ॥ 112 ॥
4.83.m: Likewise in the month of Bhādrapada, on the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight, / having formed the resolve according to rule, he should worship the supreme Lord:

4.83.s:
namo'stu kalkine pādau hṛṣīkeśāya vai kaṭim ..
mlecchapradhvaṃsanāyeti jaganmūrte tathodaram .. 113 ..
4.83.d:
नमोऽस्तु कल्किने पादौ हृषीकेशाय वै कटिम् ॥
म्लेच्छप्रध्वंसनायेति जगन्मूर्ते तथोदरम् ॥ 113 ॥
4.83.m: 'Homage be to Kalkin,' for the feet; indeed for the hips, 'To Hṛṣīkeśa'; / 'To the Destroyer of Mlecchas,' and likewise the belly with 'To the Form of the Universe';

4.83.s:
śitikaṇṭhāya kaṇṭhaṃ tu khaḍgapāṇīti vai bhujau ..
śaṃkhacakre svanāmnātra viśvamūrte tathāsitaḥ .. 114 ..
4.83.d:
शितिकण्ठाय कण्ठं तु खड्गपाणीति वै भुजौ ॥
शंखचक्रे स्वनाम्नात्र विश्वमूर्ते तथासितः ॥ 114 ॥
4.83.m: the throat with 'To the Dark-throated,' and the arms with 'To the Sword-handed'; / the conch and discus with their own names, and likewise the dark one with 'To the Universal Form';

4.83.s:
evamabhyarcya medhāvī prāgvattasyāgrato ghaṭam ..
vinyasya kalkinaṃ devaṃ sauvarṇaṃ tatra kārayet .. 115 ..
4.83.d:
एवमभ्यर्च्य मेधावी प्राग्वत्तस्याग्रतो घटम् ॥
विन्यस्य कल्किनं देवं सौवर्णं तत्र कारयेत् ॥ 115 ॥
4.83.m: having thus worshiped, the wise man, having placed a jar before him as before, / should there make a golden image of the god Kalkin,

4.83.s:
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpopaśobhitam ..
kṛtvā prabhāte viprāya pradeyaḥ śāstravittame .. .. 116 ..
4.83.d:
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं गंधपुष्पोपशोभितम् ॥
कृत्वा प्रभाते विप्राय प्रदेयः शास्त्रवित्तमे ॥ ॥ 116 ॥
4.83.m: covered with a pair of white cloths and adorned with perfumes and flowers; / having made it, in the morning it should be given to a vipra most versed in the treatises.

4.83.s:
evaṃ kṛte bhavedyattu tannibodha nṛpottama ..
daśāvatāradānena pūjane caiva tatphalam .. 117 ..
4.83.d:
एवं कृते भवेद्यत्तु तन्निबोध नृपोत्तम ॥
दशावतारदानेन पूजने चैव तत्फलम् ॥ 117 ॥
4.83.m: Hear, O best of kings, what accrues when this is performed, / the fruit of giving and worshiping the ten incarnations:

4.83.s:
pūjyate matsyarūpeṇa sarvajñatvamabhīpsubhiḥ ..
svavaṃśabharaṇāyātha kūrmarūpī tu pūjyate .. 118 ..
4.83.d:
पूज्यते मत्स्यरूपेण सर्वज्ञत्वमभीप्सुभिः ॥
स्ववंशभरणायाथ कूर्मरूपी तु पूज्यते ॥ 118 ॥
4.83.m: He is worshiped in the form of the Fish by those desiring omniscience; / in the form of the Tortoise he is worshiped for the sustenance of one's lineage;

4.83.s:
bhavodadhinimagnaistu vārāhaḥ pūjyate hariḥ ..
nṛsiṃhanavarūpeṇa tadvatpāpabhayānnaraḥ .. 119 ..
4.83.d:
भवोदधिनिमग्नैस्तु वाराहः पूज्यते हरिः ॥
नृसिंहनवरूपेण तद्वत्पापभयान्नरः ॥ 119 ॥
4.83.m: Hari in the form of the Boar is worshiped by those submerged in the ocean of existence; / likewise a man worships him in the ninefold form of the Man-lion out of fear of sin;

4.83.s:
vāmanaṃ mohanāśāya vittārthe jamadagnijam ..
krūraśatruvināśāya yajeddāśarathiṃ budhaḥ .. 4.83.120 ..
4.83.d:
वामनं मोहनाशाय वित्तार्थे जमदग्निजम् ॥
क्रूरशत्रुविनाशाय यजेद्दाशरथिं बुधः ॥ 4.83.120 ॥
4.83.m: the Dwarf for the destruction of delusion; the son of Jamadagni for wealth; / the wise man should worship the son of Daśaratha for the destruction of cruel enemies;

4.83.s:
balakṛṣṇau yajeddhīmānputrakāmo na saṃśayaḥ ..
rūpakāmo yajedbuddhaṃ kalkinaṃ śatrughātane ..
sarvāṃ dattvā vidhānena pūjāṃ prāpnoti vāṃchitam .. 121 ..
4.83.d:
बलकृष्णौ यजेद्धीमान्पुत्रकामो न संशयः ॥
रूपकामो यजेद्बुद्धं कल्किनं शत्रुघातने ॥
सर्वां दत्त्वा विधानेन पूजां प्राप्नोति वांछितम् ॥ 121 ॥
4.83.m: the intelligent man who desires a son should worship Balarāma and Kṛṣṇa, there is no doubt; / one desiring beauty should worship the Buddha, and Kalkin for striking down enemies; / having offered the entire worship according to the rite, he attains what he desires.

4.83.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tadvadāśvayuje māsi śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśīm ..
saṃkalpyābhyarcayeddevaṃ padmanābhaṃ sanātanam .. 122 ..
4.83.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
तद्वदाश्वयुजे मासि शुक्लपक्षे तु द्वादशीम् ॥
संकल्प्याभ्यर्चयेद्देवं पद्मनाभं सनातनम् ॥ 122 ॥
4.83.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Likewise in the month of Āśvayuja, on the twelfth day of the bright fortnight, / having formed the resolve, he should worship the eternal god Padmanābha:

4.83.s:
padmanābhāya pādau tu kaṭiṃ vai padmayonaye ..
udaraṃ sarvadevāya puṣkarākṣāya vā uraḥ ..
avyayāya tathā śīrṣaṃ prāgvadastrāṇi pūjayet .. 123 ..
4.83.d:
पद्मनाभाय पादौ तु कटिं वै पद्मयोनये ॥
उदरं सर्वदेवाय पुष्कराक्षाय वा उरः ॥
अव्ययाय तथा शीर्षं प्राग्वदस्त्राणि पूजयेत् ॥ 123 ॥
4.83.m: the feet with 'To Padmanābha,' the hips with 'To the Lotus-born,' / the belly with 'To the God of all,' the chest with 'To the Lotus-eyed,' / and the head with 'To the Imperishable'; he should worship the weapons as before.

4.83.s:
tatastasyāgrataḥ kuṃbhaṃ mālyavastrasamanvitam ..
yathāśaktyā kāñcanena padmanābheti bhūṣitam .. 124 ..
4.83.d:
ततस्तस्याग्रतः कुंभं माल्यवस्त्रसमन्वितम् ॥
यथाशक्त्या काञ्चनेन पद्मनाभेति भूषितम् ॥ 124 ॥
4.83.m: Then, before him, a jar accompanied by a garland and cloth, / adorned with a golden image of Padmanābha according to his means, [should be placed].

4.83.s:
rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kṛtvā prabhāte vimale tataḥ ..
brāhmaṇe tatpradātavyaṃ saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā .. 125 ..
4.83.d:
रात्रौ तु जागरं कृत्वा प्रभाते विमले ततः ॥
ब्राह्मणे तत्प्रदातव्यं संसारभयभीरुणा ॥ 125 ॥
4.83.m: Having kept a night vigil, then in the morning when it is clear, / it should be given to a brāhmaṇa by one who fears the terror of saṃsāra.

4.83.s:
evaṃ kṛte tu yatpuṇyaṃ tadvaktuṃ śakyate katham ..
brahmahatyādipāpāni kiṃ tu paṃcaiva bhārata ..
naśyaṃti kṛtapuṇyasya viṣṇornāmānukīrtanāt .. 126 .. ..
4.83.d:
एवं कृते तु यत्पुण्यं तद्वक्तुं शक्यते कथम् ॥
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि किं तु पंचैव भारत ॥
नश्यंति कृतपुण्यस्य विष्णोर्नामानुकीर्तनात् ॥ 126 ॥ ॥
4.83.m: How can the merit generated when this is done be described? / Yet indeed the five sins, such as killing a brahmin, O descendant of Bharata, / are destroyed for the one of performed merit by chanting the name of Viṣṇu.

4.83.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājanmahābāho kārtike māsi dvādaśīm ..
upoṣya vidhinā yena yathāsyāḥ prāpyate phalam.. 127 ..
4.83.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु राजन्महाबाहो कार्तिके मासि द्वादशीम् ॥
उपोष्य विधिना येन यथास्याः प्राप्यते फलम्॥ 127 ॥
4.83.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen, O king of mighty arms, to the twelfth lunar day in the month of Kārttika, / by which procedure it is fasted, and how its fruit is attained.

4.83.s:
prāgvidhānena saṃkalpya vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet ..
anulomena deveśaṃ pūjayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
namo dāmodarāyeti sarvāṅgaṃ pūjayeddharim .. 128 ..
4.83.d:
प्राग्विधानेन संकल्प्य वासुदेवं प्रपूजयेत् ॥
अनुलोमेन देवेशं पूजयित्वा विचक्षणः ॥
नमो दामोदरायेति सर्वाङ्गं पूजयेद्धरिम् ॥ 128 ॥
4.83.m: Having made the ritual resolve according to the former rule, one should worship Vāsudeva. / Having worshipped the Lord of gods in direct order, the wise man / should worship every limb of Hari, saying, “Homage to Dāmodara.”

4.83.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā tasyāśca caturo ghaṭān ..
sthāpayedratnagarbhāśca sitacandanacarcitān .. 129 ..
4.83.d:
एवं संपूज्य विधिना तस्याश्च चतुरो घटान् ॥
स्थापयेद्रत्नगर्भाश्च सितचन्दनचर्चितान् ॥ 129 ॥
4.83.m: Having thus worshipped according to the rite, he should also set up four pots for it, / containing gems and smeared with white sandalwood paste,

4.83.s:
sragdāmālaṃbitagrīvānsitavastraiśca guṇṭhitān ..
sthagitāṃstāmrapātre tu tilapūrṇaiḥ sakāṃcanaiḥ .. 4.83.130 ..
4.83.d:
स्रग्दामालंबितग्रीवान्सितवस्त्रैश्च गुण्ठितान् ॥
स्थगितांस्ताम्रपात्रे तु तिलपूर्णैः सकांचनैः ॥ 4.83.130 ॥
4.83.m: their necks hung with garlands, enveloped in white cloths, / and covered with copper plates filled with sesame seeds along with gold.

4.83.s:
catvāraḥ sāgarāste ca kathitā rājasattama ..
tanmadhye prāgvidhānena sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayeddharim..131..
4.83.d:
चत्वारः सागरास्ते च कथिता राजसत्तम ॥
तन्मध्ये प्राग्विधानेन सौवर्णं स्थापयेद्धरिम्॥131॥
4.83.m: They are declared to be the four oceans, O best of kings. / In their midst he should place a golden Hari according to the former rule,

4.83.s:
yogeśvaramaṃganidhiṃ viraktaṃ pītavāsasam ..
tadvaddeyaṃ ca saṃpūjya jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet .. 132 ..
4.83.d:
योगेश्वरमंगनिधिं विरक्तं पीतवाससम् ॥
तद्वद्देयं च संपूज्य जागरं तत्र कारयेत् ॥ 132 ॥
4.83.m: the Lord of Yoga, a treasure of limbs, detached, clad in yellow garments. / Likewise, having worshipped what is to be given, he should observe a vigil there.

4.83.s:
kṛtvā tu vaiṣṇavaṃ yogaṃ yajedyogeśvaraṃ harim ..
ṣoḍaśe vai rathāṃgeṣu rajobhirbahubhiḥ kṛte .. 133 ..
4.83.d:
कृत्वा तु वैष्णवं योगं यजेद्योगेश्वरं हरिम् ॥
षोडशे वै रथांगेषु रजोभिर्बहुभिः कृते ॥ 133 ॥
4.83.m: Having performed Vaiṣṇava meditation, he should sacrifice to Hari, the Lord of Yoga, / in sixteen spokes of a wheel fashioned with powders of various colours.

4.83.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte tu brāhmaṇānpañca bhojayet ..
catvāraḥ kalaśā deyāścaturṇāṃ pañcamasya hi .. 134 ..
4.83.d:
एवं कृत्वा प्रभाते तु ब्राह्मणान्पञ्च भोजयेत् ॥
चत्वारः कलशा देयाश्चतुर्णां पञ्चमस्य हि ॥ 134 ॥
4.83.m: Having done this, at dawn he should feed five brahmins. / The four pitchers are to be given to four, and indeed to the fifth

4.83.s:
yogeśvaraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ dāpayetprayataḥ śuciḥ ..
brāhmaṇāya samaṃ dattaṃ dviguṇaṃ vedavādine ..135..
4.83.d:
योगेश्वरं च सौवर्णं दापयेत्प्रयतः शुचिः ॥
ब्राह्मणाय समं दत्तं द्विगुणं वेदवादिने ॥135॥
4.83.m: the restrained and pure [man] should cause the golden Lord of Yoga to be given. / What is given to a [mere] brahmin is equal; [it is] twofold to one who recites the Veda;

4.83.s:
vedavedāṃgaviduṣe sahasraguṇitaṃ bhavet ..
paṃcamasya rahasyaṃ tu sasamaṃ copapādayet ..136..
4.83.d:
वेदवेदांगविदुषे सहस्रगुणितं भवेत् ॥
पंचमस्य रहस्यं तु ससमं चोपपादयेत् ॥136॥
4.83.m: to one who knows the Veda and the Vedāṅgas, it becomes multiplied a thousandfold. / And he should provide the secret of the fifth [brahmin] equally.

4.83.s:
vidhānaṃ tasya paṃcaiva dattvā koṭiguṇottaram ..
itihāsapurāṇajñe dattaṃ caivākṣayaṃ bhavet .. 137 ..
4.83.d:
विधानं तस्य पंचैव दत्त्वा कोटिगुणोत्तरम् ॥
इतिहासपुराणज्ञे दत्तं चैवाक्षयं भवेत् ॥ 137 ॥
4.83.m: Having given five [gifts] by this rite, it is ten million times greater; / and what is given to one who knows the Itihāsas and Purāṇas is inexhaustible.

4.83.s:
pañcadattvā vidhānena dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇumarcya ca ..
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dayādyathāśaktyā sadakṣiṇam ..
dīnānāthādikānsarvānpūjayecchaktito nṛpa ..138..
4.83.d:
पञ्चदत्त्वा विधानेन द्वादश्यां विष्णुमर्च्य च ॥
विप्राणां भोजनं दयाद्यथाशक्त्या सदक्षिणम् ॥
दीनानाथादिकान्सर्वान्पूजयेच्छक्तितो नृप ॥138॥
4.83.m: Having given five according to the rule and having worshipped Viṣṇu on the twelfth lunar day, / he should give food to brahmins according to his capacity, along with a priestly gift. / He should honour all the poor, the helpless, and others according to his capacity, O king.

4.83.s:
dharaṇīvratametattu purā kṛtvā prajāpatiḥ ..
prajāṃ lebhe tato muktirbrahmaṇā viṣṇave śubhe .. 139 ..
4.83.d:
धरणीव्रतमेतत्तु पुरा कृत्वा प्रजापतिः ॥
प्रजां लेभे ततो मुक्तिर्ब्रह्मणा विष्णवे शुभे ॥ 139 ॥
4.83.m: Prajāpati, having performed this Dharaṇīvrata in ancient times, / obtained progeny; then liberation [was granted] by Brahmā to Viṣṇu, O auspicious one.

4.83.s:
yuvanāśvo hi rājarṣiranena vidhinā purā ..
māndhātāraṃ sutaṃ lebhe paraṃ brahma ca śāśvatam .. 4.83.140 ..
4.83.d:
युवनाश्वो हि राजर्षिरनेन विधिना पुरा ॥
मान्धातारं सुतं लेभे परं ब्रह्म च शाश्वतम् ॥ 4.83.140 ॥
4.83.m: Indeed the royal sage Yuvanāśva, by this procedure in ancient times, / obtained the son Māndhātṛ, and the supreme, eternal Brahman.

4.83.s:
tathā haihayadāyādaḥ kṛtavīryo narādhipaḥ ..
cakravartisutaṃ lebhe sahasrārjunamūrjitam ..141..
4.83.d:
तथा हैहयदायादः कृतवीर्यो नराधिपः ॥
चक्रवर्तिसुतं लेभे सहस्रार्जुनमूर्जितम् ॥141॥
4.83.m: Likewise Kṛtavīrya, the heir of the Haihayas and lord of men, / obtained a universal emperor as a son, the mighty Sahasrārjuna.

4.83.s:
śakuṃtalāpyevameva vrataṃ cīrtvā narottamam ..
lebhe śākuntalaṃ putraṃ duṣyaṃtaścakravartinam .. 142 ..
4.83.d:
शकुंतलाप्येवमेव व्रतं चीर्त्वा नरोत्तमम् ॥
लेभे शाकुन्तलं पुत्रं दुष्यंतश्चक्रवर्तिनम् ॥ 142 ॥
4.83.m: Śakuntalā also, having observed this votive observance in this very manner, / obtained a son born of Śakuntalā, the best of men, and Duṣyanta [obtained] a universal emperor.

4.83.s:
tathā purāṇarājāno vedoktāścakravartinaḥ ..
anena vidhinā prāptāścakravartitvamuttamam .. 143 ..
4.83.d:
तथा पुराणराजानो वेदोक्ताश्चक्रवर्तिनः ॥
अनेन विधिना प्राप्ताश्चक्रवर्तित्वमुत्तमम् ॥ 143 ॥
4.83.m: Likewise the ancient kings and the universal emperors declared in the Vedas / attained supreme imperial sovereignty by this procedure.

4.83.s:
dharaṇyā api pātāle magnayācaritaṃ purā ..
vratametattato nāmrā dharaṇīvratamucyate .. 144 ..
4.83.d:
धरण्या अपि पाताले मग्नयाचरितं पुरा ॥
व्रतमेतत्ततो नाम्रा धरणीव्रतमुच्यते ॥ 144 ॥
4.83.m: In ancient times it was also performed by the Earth when she had sunk into the netherworld; / therefore, by name, it is called the Dharaṇīvrata.

4.83.s:
samāpte'smiṃstadā devī hariṇā kroḍarūpiṇā ..
uddhṛtā daśanāgreṇa sthāpitā naurivāṃbhasi .. 145 ..
4.83.d:
समाप्तेऽस्मिंस्तदा देवी हरिणा क्रोडरूपिणा ॥
उद्धृता दशनाग्रेण स्थापिता नौरिवांभसि ॥ 145 ॥
4.83.m: When it was completed, the goddess was then raised by Hari in the form of a boar / with the tip of his tusk, and set in place like a boat upon the water.

4.83.s:
dharaṇīvratametatte kathitaṃ pāṃḍunandana ..
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā yaśca kuryānnarottama ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇusāyujyamāvrajet .. 146 ..
4.83.d:
धरणीव्रतमेतत्ते कथितं पांडुनन्दन ॥
य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या यश्च कुर्यान्नरोत्तम ॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुसायुज्यमाव्रजेत् ॥ 146 ॥
4.83.m: This Dharaṇīvrata has been recounted to you, O son of Pāṇḍu. / Whoever hears this with devotion, and whoever performs it, O best of men, / freed from all sins, shall attain union with Viṣṇu.

4.83.s:
cīrṇaṃ rasātalatale gatayā dharaṇyā tena prasiddhimagamaddharaṇīvrateti ..
sadyaḥ samācarati dharmaratirddharitryāmuddhṛtya sapta puruṣānsa paraṃ prayāti .. 147 ..
viśokadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.83.d:
चीर्णं रसातलतले गतया धरण्या तेन प्रसिद्धिमगमद्धरणीव्रतेति ॥
सद्यः समाचरति धर्मरतिर्द्धरित्र्यामुद्धृत्य सप्त पुरुषान्स परं प्रयाति ॥ 147 ॥
विशोकद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.83.m:
It was observed by the Earth when she had gone to the bottom of Rasātala, and on that account it became renowned as the Dharaṇīvrata. / Delighting in righteousness, if one performs it quickly upon the Earth, he delivers seven generations of ancestors and departs to the supreme [realm].
Description of the Viśokadvādaśīvrata

4.84.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kimabhīṣṭaviyogaśokasaṃghāllaghu iha samupoṣatāṃ vrataṃ vā..
vibhavodbhavakāri bhūtale'sminbhavati vibho bhayasūdanaṃ ca puṃsām .. 1 ..
4.84.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
किमभीष्टवियोगशोकसंघाल्लघु इह समुपोषतां व्रतं वा॥
विभवोद्भवकारि भूतलेऽस्मिन्भवति विभो भयसूदनं च पुंसाम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.84.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What fast or votive observance is there in this world for people who observe it simply, to free them from the mass of sorrow caused by separation from the desired, / that generates wealth on this earth, and destroys fear, O Lord?

4.84.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
paripṛṣṭamidaṃ jagatpriyaṃ te vibudhānāmapi durllabhaṃ mahattvāt ..
tava bhaktimatastathāpi vakṣye vratamindrāsuradānaveṣu guhyam ..2..
4.84.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
परिपृष्टमिदं जगत्प्रियं ते विबुधानामपि दुर्ल्लभं महत्त्वात् ॥
तव भक्तिमतस्तथापि वक्ष्ये व्रतमिन्द्रासुरदानवेषु गुह्यम् ॥2॥
4.84.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / This which you have asked is dear to the world and difficult to attain even for the gods because of its greatness. / Nevertheless, since you are devoted, I shall declare this votive observance, secret among Indra, the asuras, and the dānavas.

4.84.s:
puṇyamāśvayuje māsi viśokadvādaśīvratam ..
daśamyāṃ laghubhugvidvānārabhenniyamena tu .. 3 ..
4.84.d:
पुण्यमाश्वयुजे मासि विशोकद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
दशम्यां लघुभुग्विद्वानारभेन्नियमेन तु ॥ 3 ॥
4.84.m: The auspicious Viśokadvādaśīvrata is in the month of Āśvayuja. / On the tenth lunar day, eating light food, the wise person should begin it with a restriction.

4.84.s:
udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ..
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samyagabhyarcya keśavam .. 4 ..
4.84.d:
उदङ्मुखः प्राङ्मुखो वा दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ॥
एकादश्यां निराहारः सम्यगभ्यर्च्य केशवम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.84.m: Facing north or facing east, after cleaning his teeth, / remaining without food on the eleventh lunar day and properly worshipping Keśava,

4.84.s:
vidhivattvāṃ samabhyarcya bhokṣyāmi apare'hani ..
evaṃ niyamakṛtsuptvā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ .. 5 ..
4.84.d:
विधिवत्त्वां समभ्यर्च्य भोक्ष्यामि अपरेऽहनि ॥
एवं नियमकृत्सुप्त्वा प्रातरुत्थाय मानवः ॥ 5 ॥
4.84.m: saying, “Having worshipped you according to rule, I shall eat on the following day,” / a man, having thus made the vow and slept, rising at dawn,

4.84.s:
snānaṃ sarvauṣadhaiḥ kuryātpañcagavyajalena tu ..
śuklamālyāṃbarastadvatpūjayecchrīśamutpalaiḥ .. 6 ..
4.84.d:
स्नानं सर्वौषधैः कुर्यात्पञ्चगव्यजलेन तु ॥
शुक्लमाल्यांबरस्तद्वत्पूजयेच्छ्रीशमुत्पलैः ॥ 6 ॥
4.84.m: should bathe with all herbs and with water mixed with the five products of the cow. / Likewise, wearing white garlands and clothes, he should worship the Lord of Śrī with blue water lilies:

4.84.s:
viśokāya namaḥ pādau jaṃghe ca varadāya vai ..
śrīśāya jānunī tadvadūrū ca jalaśāyine .. 7 ..
4.84.d:
विशोकाय नमः पादौ जंघे च वरदाय वै ॥
श्रीशाय जानुनी तद्वदूरू च जलशायिने ॥ 7 ॥
4.84.m: “Homage to the sorrowless one,” the feet; and the shanks to the granter of boons; / the knees likewise to the Lord of Śrī, and the thighs to the one who reclines on the water;

4.84.s:
kaṃdarpāya namo guhye mādhavāya namaḥ kaṭim ..
dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ pārśve ca vipulāya vai .. 8 ..
4.84.d:
कंदर्पाय नमो गुह्ये माधवाय नमः कटिम् ॥
दामोदरायेत्युदरं पार्श्वे च विपुलाय वै ॥ 8 ॥
4.84.m: “Homage to Kandarpā,” the private parts; “Homage to Mādhava,” the waist; / “To Dāmodara,” the belly; and the sides to the vast one;

4.84.s:
nābhiṃ ca padmanābhāya hṛdayaṃ manmathāya vai ..
śrīdharāya vibhorvakṣaḥ karau madhubhide namaḥ .. 9 ..
4.84.d:
नाभिं च पद्मनाभाय हृदयं मन्मथाय वै ॥
श्रीधराय विभोर्वक्षः करौ मधुभिदे नमः ॥ 9 ॥
4.84.m: the navel to Padmanābha; the heart to Manmatha; / the chest of the Lord to Śrīdhara; “Homage to the slayer of Madhu,” the hands;

4.84.s:
cakriṇe nāma bāhuṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ gadine namaḥ ..
vaikuṇṭhāya namaḥ kaṇṭhamāsyaṃ yajñamukhāya vai .. 4.84.10 ..
4.84.d:
चक्रिणे नाम बाहुं च दक्षिणं गदिने नमः ॥
वैकुण्ठाय नमः कण्ठमास्यं यज्ञमुखाय वै ॥ 4.84.10 ॥
4.84.m: to the wielder of the discus, the right arm; “Homage to the wielder of the mace”; / “Homage to Vaikuṇṭha,” the neck; the face to Yajñamukha;

4.84.s:
nāsāmaśokanidhaye vāsudevāya cākṣiṇī ..
lalāṭaṃ vāmanāyeti kirīṭaṃ viśvarūpiṇe .. 11 ..
4.84.d:
नासामशोकनिधये वासुदेवाय चाक्षिणी ॥
ललाटं वामनायेति किरीटं विश्वरूपिणे ॥ 11 ॥
4.84.m: the nose to the treasure of sorrowlessness; and the eyes to Vāsudeva; / the forehead to Vāmana; the crown to the one of universal form;

4.84.s:
namaḥ sarvātmane tadvacchira ityabhipūjayet ..
evaṃ saṃpūjya goviṃdaṃ phalamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 12 ..
4.84.d:
नमः सर्वात्मने तद्वच्छिर इत्यभिपूजयेत् ॥
एवं संपूज्य गोविंदं फलमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 12 ॥
4.84.m: likewise, “Homage to the Self of all,” he should worship the head. / Having thus worshipped Govinda with fruits, garlands, and ointments,

4.84.s:
tatastasyāgrato bhavyaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ kārayenmṛdā ..
caturasraṃ samaṃtāccāratnimātramudagbhavam .. 13 ..
4.84.d:
ततस्तस्याग्रतो भव्यं स्थंडिलं कारयेन्मृदा ॥
चतुरस्रं समंताच्चारत्निमात्रमुदग्भवम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.84.m: he should then cause an auspicious raised altar to be made of earth before him, / square on all sides, one cubit in size, aligned to the north,

4.84.s:
nadīvālukayā pūrṇaṃ lakṣmyākṛtiṃ kṛtī nyaset ..
sthaṃḍile sūryamāropya lakṣmīmityarcayedbudhaḥ .. 14 ..
4.84.d:
नदीवालुकया पूर्णं लक्ष्म्याकृतिं कृती न्यसेत् ॥
स्थंडिले सूर्यमारोप्य लक्ष्मीमित्यर्चयेद्बुधः ॥ 14 ॥
4.84.m: filled with river sand; the proficient man should deposit the form of Lakṣmī [thereon]. / Having invoked Sūrya upon the altar, the wise man should worship Lakṣmī:

4.84.s:
namo devyai namaḥ śāṃtyai namo lakṣmyai namaḥ śriye ..
namaḥ puṣṭyai namastuṣṭyai namo dṛṣṭyai namonamaḥ .. 15 ..
4.84.d:
नमो देव्यै नमः शांत्यै नमो लक्ष्म्यै नमः श्रिये ॥
नमः पुष्ट्यै नमस्तुष्ट्यै नमो दृष्ट्यै नमोनमः ॥ 15 ॥
4.84.m: “Homage to the goddess, homage to tranquility, homage to Lakṣmī, homage to Śrī, / homage to nourishment, homage to contentment, homage to insight, homage, homage!

4.84.s:
viśokā duḥkhanāśāya viśokā varadāstu me ..
viśokā vāstu saṃtatyai viśokā sarvasiddhaye ..16..
4.84.d:
विशोका दुःखनाशाय विशोका वरदास्तु मे ॥
विशोका वास्तु संतत्यै विशोका सर्वसिद्धये ॥16॥
4.84.m: May Viśokā be for the destruction of sorrow; may Viśokā be a granter of boons to me; / may Viśokā be for offspring; may Viśokā be for the attainment of all success!”

4.84.s:
tataḥ śuklāṃbaradharo śūrpaṃ saṃveṣṭya pūjayet ..
bhakṣyairnānāvidhaistadvatsuvarṇakamalena ca .. 17 ..
4.84.d:
ततः शुक्लांबरधरो शूर्पं संवेष्ट्य पूजयेत् ॥
भक्ष्यैर्नानाविधैस्तद्वत्सुवर्णकमलेन च ॥ 17 ॥
4.84.m: Then, wearing white garments, he should wrap a winnowing basket and worship it / with various kinds of edible foods, and likewise with a golden lotus.

4.84.s:
rajanīṣu ca sarvāsu pibeddarbhodakaṃ vratī ..
tatastu nṛtyagītādi kārayetsarvarātrakam .. 18 ..
4.84.d:
रजनीषु च सर्वासु पिबेद्दर्भोदकं व्रती ॥
ततस्तु नृत्यगीतादि कारयेत्सर्वरात्रकम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.84.m: And on all nights, the observer of the votive observance should drink water with darbha grass. / Then he should cause dancing, singing, and other festivities to be performed throughout the night.

4.84.s:
yāmatraye vyatīte tu suptvā svasthopamānasaḥ ..
abhigamya ca viprāṇāṃ mithunāni sadārcayet .. 19 ..
4.84.d:
यामत्रये व्यतीते तु सुप्त्वा स्वस्थोपमानसः ॥
अभिगम्य च विप्राणां मिथुनानि सदार्चयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.84.m: When three watches have passed, having slept with a calm mind / and approached [them], he should continually worship married couples of brāhmaṇas,

4.84.s:
śaktitastrīṇi caikaṃ vā vastramālyānulepanaiḥ ..
śayanāsthāni pūjyāni namo'stu jalaśāyine .. 4.84.20 ..
4.84.d:
शक्तितस्त्रीणि चैकं वा वस्त्रमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
शयनास्थानि पूज्यानि नमोऽस्तु जलशायिने ॥ 4.84.20 ॥
4.84.m: three, or one according to his means, with garments, garlands, and ointments. / Reclining upon a bed, they should be worshipped, with: "Salutations to the one who reclines upon the waters!"

4.84.s:
tatastu gītavādyādyai rātrau jāgaraṇe kṛte ..
prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā dāṃpatyamarcayet .. 21 ..
4.84.d:
ततस्तु गीतवाद्याद्यै रात्रौ जागरणे कृते ॥
प्रभाते विमले स्नानं कृत्वा दांपत्यमर्चयेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.84.m: Then, when a vigil has been kept through the night with songs, instrumental music, and the like, / and having bathed at clear dawn, he should worship the married couple.

4.84.s:
bhojanaṃ ca yathāśaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..
bhuktvā śrutvā purāṇāni taddinaṃ tvativāhayet .. 22 ..
4.84.d:
भोजनं च यथाशक्त्या वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः ॥
भुक्त्वा श्रुत्वा पुराणानि तद्दिनं त्वतिवाहयेत् ॥ 22 ॥
4.84.m: And [he should provide] food according to his ability, free from miserliness with wealth. / Having eaten and listened to Purāṇas, he should spend that day.

4.84.s:
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsimāsi samācaret ..
vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyādguḍadhenusamanvitam ..
sopadhānakaviśrāmamāstarāvaraṇaṃ śubham .. 23 ..
4.84.d:
अनेन विधिना सर्वं मासिमासि समाचरेत् ॥
व्रतांते शयनं दद्याद्गुडधेनुसमन्वितम् ॥
सोपधानकविश्राममास्तरावरणं शुभम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.84.m: According to this rule, he should perform everything month after month. / At the end of the votive observance, he should give a bed accompanied by a jaggery-cow, / an auspicious [bed] with pillows, a headrest, a mattress, and a covering:

4.84.s:
yathā na lakṣmīrdeveśa tvāṃ parityajya gacchati ..
tathā kuru yathāyogyamaśokaṃ cāstu me sadā ..24..
4.84.d:
यथा न लक्ष्मीर्देवेश त्वां परित्यज्य गच्छति ॥
तथा कुरु यथायोग्यमशोकं चास्तु मे सदा ॥24॥
4.84.m: "O Lord of gods, just as Lakṣmī does not abandon you and go away, / so act appropriately, and may I always be free from sorrow.

4.84.s:
yathā devena rahitā na lakṣyīrjāyate kvacit..
tathā viśokatā me'stu bhakti ramyā ca keśave .. .. 25 ..
4.84.d:
यथा देवेन रहिता न लक्ष्यीर्जायते क्वचित्॥
तथा विशोकता मेऽस्तु भक्ति रम्या च केशवे ॥ ॥ 25 ॥
4.84.m: Just as Lakṣmī is nowhere found bereft of the God, / so may I be sorrowless, and may I have delightful devotion to Keśava."

4.84.s:
maṃtreṇānena dhyātvā tu guḍadhenusamanvitam ..
śūrpaṃ ca lakṣmyā sahitaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā .. 26 ..
4.84.d:
मंत्रेणानेन ध्यात्वा तु गुडधेनुसमन्वितम् ॥
शूर्पं च लक्ष्म्या सहितं दातव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ॥ 26 ॥
4.84.m: Having meditated with this mantra, one who desires prosperity should give / the winnowing basket accompanied by a jaggery-cow along with Lakṣmī.

4.84.s:
utpātaṃ karavīraṃ ca bāṇamamlāna kuṃḍalam ..
kesaraṃ siṃduvāraṃ ca mallikāgaṃdhapāṭalam ..
kādaṃbaiḥ kuṃkumairjātyā tathānyairapi pūjayet .. 27 ..
4.84.d:
उत्पातं करवीरं च बाणमम्लान कुंडलम् ॥
केसरं सिंदुवारं च मल्लिकागंधपाटलम् ॥
कादंबैः कुंकुमैर्जात्या तथान्यैरपि पूजयेत् ॥ 27 ॥
4.84.m: He should also worship with utpāta, oleander, bāṇa, unfading amaranth, / kesara, sinduvāra, and fragrant jasmine and pāṭala, / with kadamba flowers, saffron, royal jasmine, and other [flowers] as well.

4.84.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
guḍadhenuvidhānaṃ me tvamācakṣva jagatpate ..
kiṃrūpā kena maṃtreṇa dātavyā tadihocyatām ..28..
4.84.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
गुडधेनुविधानं मे त्वमाचक्ष्व जगत्पते ॥
किंरूपा केन मंत्रेण दातव्या तदिहोच्यताम् ॥28॥
4.84.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me the procedure for the jaggery-cow, O Lord of the world. / Of what form [is it], and with what mantra should it be given? Let that be spoken here.

4.84.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
guḍadhenuvidhānaṃ ca yadrūmiha yatphalam ..
tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 29 ..
4.84.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
गुडधेनुविधानं च यद्रूमिह यत्फलम् ॥
तदिदानीं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.84.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / The procedure for the jaggery-cow, what form it has here, and what fruit, / that which destroys all sins, I shall now declare.

4.84.s:
kṛṣṇājinaṃ caturhastaṃ prāgevaṃ vinyasedbhuvi ..
gomayenānuliptāyāṃ darbhānāstīrya sarvataḥ .. .. 4.84.30 ..
4.84.d:
कृष्णाजिनं चतुर्हस्तं प्रागेवं विन्यसेद्भुवि ॥
गोमयेनानुलिप्तायां दर्भानास्तीर्य सर्वतः ॥ ॥ 4.84.30 ॥
4.84.m: First, he should place a black antelope skin measuring four cubits on the ground / smeared with cow dung, having scattered darbha grass all around.

4.84.s:
labdhena kāṃcanaṃ tadvadvatsaṃ ca parikalpayet ..
prāṅmukhīṃ kalpayeddhenumudakpādāṃ savatsikām .. 31 ..
4.84.d:
लब्धेन कांचनं तद्वद्वत्सं च परिकल्पयेत् ॥
प्राङ्मुखीं कल्पयेद्धेनुमुदक्पादां सवत्सिकाम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.84.m: Likewise, he should fashion a calf out of gold that has been acquired. / He should fashion the cow facing east with its feet to the north, together with its calf.

4.84.s:
uttamā guḍadhenuḥ syātsadā bhāra catuṣṭayā ..
vatsaṃ bhāreṇa kurvīta dvābhyāṃ vai madhyamā smṛtā .. 32...
arddhabhāreṇa vatsaḥ syātkaniṣṭhā bhārakeṇa tu ..
caturthāṃśena vatsaḥ syādgṛhavittā nusārataḥ .. 33 ..
4.84.d:
उत्तमा गुडधेनुः स्यात्सदा भार चतुष्टया ॥
वत्सं भारेण कुर्वीत द्वाभ्यां वै मध्यमा स्मृता ॥ 32॥।
अर्द्धभारेण वत्सः स्यात्कनिष्ठा भारकेण तु ॥
चतुर्थांशेन वत्सः स्याद्गृहवित्ता नुसारतः ॥ 33 ॥
4.84.m: The best jaggery-cow is always made of four bhāras; / one should make the calf with one bhāra; the middling is recorded as made of two [bhāras], / and its calf of half a bhāra; but the lowest is made of one bhāra, / and its calf of a fourth part, according to the wealth of one’s household.

4.84.s:
dhenuvatsau kṛtāvetau sitasūkṣmāṃbarāvṛtau ..
śuktikarṇāvikṣupādau śuktimuktāphalekṣaṇau .. 34 ..
4.84.d:
धेनुवत्सौ कृतावेतौ सितसूक्ष्मांबरावृतौ ॥
शुक्तिकर्णाविक्षुपादौ शुक्तिमुक्ताफलेक्षणौ ॥ 34 ॥
4.84.m: These two, cow and calf, having been made, are covered with white, fine cloths, / having oyster-shells for ears, sugarcane for legs, and pearl-oysters for eyes,

4.84.s:
sitasūtraśirālau tu sitakaṃbala kaṃbalau ..
tāmragallakapṛṣṭau tau sitacāmararomakau .. 35 ..
4.84.d:
सितसूत्रशिरालौ तु सितकंबल कंबलौ ॥
ताम्रगल्लकपृष्टौ तौ सितचामररोमकौ ॥ 35 ॥
4.84.m: having white threads for veins, white blankets for dewlaps, / copper vessels for backs, and white chowries for hair,

4.84.s:
vidrumabhrūyugāvetau navanītastanānvitau ..
kṣaumapucchau kāṃsyadohāvindranīlakatārakau .. ..36..
4.84.d:
विद्रुमभ्रूयुगावेतौ नवनीतस्तनान्वितौ ॥
क्षौमपुच्छौ कांस्यदोहाविन्द्रनीलकतारकौ ॥ ॥36॥
4.84.m: having a pair of coral eyebrows, provided with fresh butter for udders, / with linen tails, bronze milking pails, and sapphires for pupils,

4.84.s:
suvarṇaśṛṃgābharaṇau rājatakhurasaṃyutau ..
nānāphalasamāyuktau ghrāṇagaṃdhakaraṃḍakau ..
ityevaṃ racayitvā tu dhūpadīpairathārcayet .. 37 ..
4.84.d:
सुवर्णशृंगाभरणौ राजतखुरसंयुतौ ॥
नानाफलसमायुक्तौ घ्राणगंधकरंडकौ ॥
इत्येवं रचयित्वा तु धूपदीपैरथार्चयेत् ॥ 37 ॥
4.84.m: adorned with golden horns, provided with silver hooves, / furnished with various fruits, with scent-boxes for nostrils. / Having fashioned [them] thus, he should then worship them with incense and lamps:

4.84.s:
yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yā ca deve vyavasthitā ..
dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu .. 38 ..
4.84.d:
या लक्ष्मीः सर्वभूतानां या च देवे व्यवस्थिता ॥
धेनुरूपेण सा देवी मम पापं व्यपोहतु ॥ 38 ॥
4.84.m: "That Lakṣmī who is in all beings and who abides in the God, / may that goddess, in the form of a cow, remove my sin.

4.84.s:
viṣṇorvakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhāyāṃ ca vibhāvasau ..
caṃdrārkaśakraśaktiryā dhenurūpāstu sā śriye .. 39 ..
4.84.d:
विष्णोर्वक्षसि या लक्ष्मीः स्वाहायां च विभावसौ ॥
चंद्रार्कशक्रशक्तिर्या धेनुरूपास्तु सा श्रिये ॥ 39 ॥
4.84.m: The Lakṣmī who is on Viṣṇu's chest, and in Svāhā and the fire, / the power of the moon, the sun, and Śakra—may she, in the form of a cow, be for [my] prosperity.

4.84.s:
caturmukhasya yā lakṣmīryā lakṣmīrdhanadasya ca ..
yā lakṣmīrlokapālānāṃ sā dhenurvaradāstu me .. .. 4.84.40 ..
4.84.d:
चतुर्मुखस्य या लक्ष्मीर्या लक्ष्मीर्धनदस्य च ॥
या लक्ष्मीर्लोकपालानां सा धेनुर्वरदास्तु मे ॥ ॥ 4.84.40 ॥
4.84.m: The Lakṣmī who belongs to the Four-faced One, and the Lakṣmī of the Giver of Wealth, / the Lakṣmī who belongs to the world protectors—may that cow grant me boons.

4.84.s:
svadhā tvaṃ pitṛmukhyānāṃ svāhā yajñabhujāṃ punaḥ ..
sarvapāpahare dheno tasmādbhūtiṃ prayaccha me .. 41 ..
4.84.d:
स्वधा त्वं पितृमुख्यानां स्वाहा यज्ञभुजां पुनः ॥
सर्वपापहरे धेनो तस्माद्भूतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 41 ॥
4.84.m: You are Svadhā for the foremost ancestors, and Svāhā for the enjoyers of sacrifice. / O cow, remover of all sins, therefore bestow prosperity upon me."

4.84.s:
evamāmaṃtrya tāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nive dayet ..
vidhānametaddhenūnāṃ sarvāsāmiha paṭhyate .. 42 ..
4.84.d:
एवमामंत्र्य तां धेनुं ब्राह्मणाय निवे दयेत् ॥
विधानमेतद्धेनूनां सर्वासामिह पठ्यते ॥ 42 ॥
4.84.m: Having thus addressed that cow, he should offer it to a brāhmaṇa. / This procedure is recited here for all the cows.

4.84.s:
yāstu pāpavināśinyaḥ śrūyate daśa dhenavaḥ ..
tāsāṃ svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi nāmāni ca narā dhipa .. 43 ..
4.84.d:
यास्तु पापविनाशिन्यः श्रूयते दश धेनवः ॥
तासां स्वरूपं वक्ष्यामि नामानि च नरा धिप ॥ 43 ॥
4.84.m: The ten cows that are heard of as destroying sins— / I shall tell you their nature and names, O lord of men.

4.84.s:
prathamā guḍadhenuḥ syād ghṛtadhenurathāparā ..
tiladhenustṛtīyā syāccaturthī madhudhenukā .. 44 ..
4.84.d:
प्रथमा गुडधेनुः स्याद् घृतधेनुरथापरा ॥
तिलधेनुस्तृतीया स्याच्चतुर्थी मधुधेनुका ॥ 44 ॥
4.84.m: The first is the jaggery-cow; then another is the clarified-butter-cow; / the third is the sesame-cow; the fourth is the honey-cow;

4.84.s:
jaladhenuḥ paṃcamī tu ṣaṣṭhī tu kṣīrasaṃbhavā ..
saptamī śarkarādhenurdadhidhenurathāṣṭamī ..
rasadhenuśca navamī daśamī syātsvarūpataḥ .. 45 ..
4.84.d:
जलधेनुः पंचमी तु षष्ठी तु क्षीरसंभवा ॥
सप्तमी शर्कराधेनुर्दधिधेनुरथाष्टमी ॥
रसधेनुश्च नवमी दशमी स्यात्स्वरूपतः ॥ 45 ॥
4.84.m: the fifth is the water-cow; but the sixth is produced from milk; / the seventh is the sugar-cow; then the eighth is the curds-cow; / the ninth is the juice-cow; and the tenth is [the cow] by its own nature.

4.84.s:
kuṃbhā syurdaśadhenūnāmitarāsāṃ tu rāśayaḥ ..
suvarṇadhenumapyatra kecidicchaṃti mānavāḥ .. 46 ..
4.84.d:
कुंभा स्युर्दशधेनूनामितरासां तु राशयः ॥
सुवर्णधेनुमप्यत्र केचिदिच्छंति मानवाः ॥ 46 ॥
4.84.m: There should be jars for the ten cows, but heaps for the others. / Here some men also desire a golden cow,

4.84.s:
navanītena ratnaiśca tathāpyanye maharṣayaḥ ..
etadeva vidhānaṃ syātta evopaskarāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 7 ..
4.84.d:
नवनीतेन रत्नैश्च तथाप्यन्ये महर्षयः ॥
एतदेव विधानं स्यात्त एवोपस्कराः स्मृताः ॥ 7 ॥
4.84.m: and likewise other great sages [desire cows made] of fresh butter and jewels. / The procedure is precisely this; the accessories are recorded to be the very same.

4.84.s:
maṃtrāvāhanasaṃyuktāṃ sadā parvaṇiparvaṇi ..
yathāśraddhaṃ pradātavyā bhuktimuktiphalapradā .. 48 ..
4.84.d:
मंत्रावाहनसंयुक्तां सदा पर्वणिपर्वणि ॥
यथाश्रद्धं प्रदातव्या भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदा ॥ 48 ॥
4.84.m: Accompanied by mantra and invocation, at every festival day / it should always be given according to one’s faith, granting the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

4.84.s:
guḍadhenuprasaṃgena sarvāstava mayoditāḥ ..
aśeṣayajña phaladāḥ sarvapāpaharāḥ śubhāḥ .. 49 ..
4.84.d:
गुडधेनुप्रसंगेन सर्वास्तव मयोदिताः ॥
अशेषयज्ञ फलदाः सर्वपापहराः शुभाः ॥ 49 ॥
4.84.m: In connection with the jaggery-cow, all have been declared to you by me— / auspicious, granting the fruits of all sacrifices, and taking away all sins.

4.84.s:
vratānāmuttamaṃ yatsyādviśokadvādaśīvratam ..
tadaṃgatvena caivaiṣā guḍadhenuḥ praśasyate .. 4.84.50 ..
4.84.d:
व्रतानामुत्तमं यत्स्याद्विशोकद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
तदंगत्वेन चैवैषा गुडधेनुः प्रशस्यते ॥ 4.84.50 ॥
4.84.m: The Viśokadvādaśī votive observance is the best among votive observances; / and as a subordinate part of that, this jaggery-cow is praised.

4.84.s:
ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte'tha vā punaḥ ..
guḍadhenvādayo deyā uparāgādiparvasu .. 51 ..
4.84.d:
अयने विषुवे पुण्ये व्यतीपातेऽथ वा पुनः ॥
गुडधेन्वादयो देया उपरागादिपर्वसु ॥ 51 ॥
4.84.m: At a solstice, at an auspicious equinox, or during a vyatīpāta, / or on festival days such as eclipses, the jaggery-cow and others should be given.

4.84.s:
viśokadvādaśī caiṣā sarvapāpaharā śubhā ..
yāmupoṣya naro yāti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam .. 52 ..
4.84.d:
विशोकद्वादशी चैषा सर्वपापहरा शुभा ॥
यामुपोष्य नरो याति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.84.m: And this Viśokadvādaśī is auspicious and removes all sins; / having fasted on which, a man goes to that supreme abode of Viṣṇu.

4.84.s:
iha loke tu saubhāgyamāyurārogyameva ca ..
vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnoti maraṇe sadgatirbhavet .. 53 ..
4.84.d:
इह लोके तु सौभाग्यमायुरारोग्यमेव च ॥
वैष्णवं पदमाप्नोति मरणे सद्गतिर्भवेत् ॥ 53 ॥
4.84.m: In this world he attains good fortune, long life, and health, / and he reaches the realm of Viṣṇu; at death he has a good destination.

4.84.s:
bhavārbudasahasrāṇi daśa cāṣṭau ca dharmavit ..
na śokaduḥkhadaurgatyaṃ tasya saṃjāyate nṛpa .. 54 ..
4.84.d:
भवार्बुदसहस्राणि दश चाष्टौ च धर्मवित् ॥
न शोकदुःखदौर्गत्यं तस्य संजायते नृप ॥ 54 ॥
4.84.m: For ten and eight thousand hundred-millions of births, O knower of righteousness, / grief, sorrow, and misfortune do not arise for him, O king.

4.84.s:
nārī vā kurute yā tu viśokadvādaśīmi mām ..
nṛtyagītaparā nityaṃ sāpi tatphalamāpnuyāt .. 55 ..
4.84.d:
नारी वा कुरुते या तु विशोकद्वादशीमि माम् ॥
नृत्यगीतपरा नित्यं सापि तत्फलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 55 ॥
4.84.m: Or a woman who performs this Viśokadvādaśī, / constantly devoted to dancing and singing, she too obtains that fruit.

4.84.s:
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇotīha samyaṅ madhupuranarakārerarcanaṃ yaśca paśyet ..
matimapi ca janānāṃ yo dadātīndraloke vasati sa vibudhādyaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ sadaiva .. 56 .. ..
vibhūtidvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.84.d:
इति पठति य इत्थं यः शृणोतीह सम्यङ् मधुपुरनरकारेरर्चनं यश्च पश्येत् ॥
मतिमपि च जनानां यो ददातीन्द्रलोके वसति स विबुधाद्यैः पूज्यमानः सदैव ॥ 56 ॥ ॥
विभूतिद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.84.m:
Whoever recites this thus, whoever hears it properly here, and whoever sees the worship of the enemy of Naraka of Madhupura, / and whoever directs the minds of people [toward it], he dwells always in the world of Indra, worshipped by the gods and others.
Description of the Votive Observance of Vibhūtidvādaśī

4.85.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu bhūpāla vakṣyāmi viṣṇuvratamanuttamam ..
vibhūtidvādaśīṃ nāma sarvāmaranamaskṛtam .. 1 ..
4.85.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु भूपाल वक्ष्यामि विष्णुव्रतमनुत्तमम् ॥
विभूतिद्वादशीं नाम सर्वामरनमस्कृतम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.85.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Listen, O king, I shall declare an unexcelled votive observance of Viṣṇu / named Vibhūtidvādaśī, bowed to by all the gods.

4.85.s:
kārttike vātha vaiśākhe mārgaśīrṣe ca phālgune ..
āṣāḍhe vā daśamyāṃ ca śuklāyāṃ laghubhuṅnaraḥ .. 2 ..
4.85.d:
कार्त्तिके वाथ वैशाखे मार्गशीर्षे च फाल्गुने ॥
आषाढे वा दशम्यां च शुक्लायां लघुभुङ्नरः ॥ 2 ॥
4.85.m: In Kārttika, Vaiśākha, Mārgaśīrṣa, Phālguna, / or Āṣāḍha, on the tenth lunar day of the bright fortnight, eating lightly, a man,

4.85.s:
kṛtvā sāyaṃtanīṃ saṃdhyāṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ budhaḥ ..
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya janārdanam .. 3 ..
4.85.d:
कृत्वा सायंतनीं संध्यां गृह्णीयान्नियमं बुधः ॥
एकादश्यां निराहारः समभ्यर्च्य जनार्दनम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.85.m: having performed the evening twilight worship, the wise person should take the vow: / 'Having fasted on the eleventh lunar day and worshipped Janārdana,

4.85.s:
dvādaśyāṃ dvijasaṃyuktaḥ kariṣye bhojanaṃ vibho ..
tadavighnena me yātu sāphalyaṃ madhūsūdana .. 4 ..
4.85.d:
द्वादश्यां द्विजसंयुक्तः करिष्ये भोजनं विभो ॥
तदविघ्नेन मे यातु साफल्यं मधूसूदन ॥ 4 ॥
4.85.m: I will eat on the twelfth lunar day together with twice-born men, O Lord. / Therefore, O Madhusūdana, let it attain fruition for me without obstacle.'

4.85.s:
tataḥ prabhāta utthāya kṛtasnānajapaḥ śuciḥ ..
pūjayetpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 5 ..
4.85.d:
ततः प्रभात उत्थाय कृतस्नानजपः शुचिः ॥
पूजयेत्पुण्डरीकाक्षं शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 5 ॥
4.85.m: Then, having risen at dawn, performed his bath and muttered prayers, pure, / he should worship the lotus-eyed one with white garlands and ointments:

4.85.s:
bhūtidāya namaḥ pādau viśokāya ca jānunī ..
namaḥ śivāyetyūrū ca viśvamūrte namaḥ kaṭim .. 6 ..
4.85.d:
भूतिदाय नमः पादौ विशोकाय च जानुनी ॥
नमः शिवायेत्यूरू च विश्वमूर्ते नमः कटिम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.85.m: 'Homage to the Granter of Prosperity!' [worshipping] the two feet; 'to the Sorrowless One!' the two knees; / 'Homage to Śiva!' the two thighs; and 'O You Whose Form Is the Universe, homage!' the waist;

4.85.s:
kaṃdarpāya namo meḍhramādityāya namaḥ karau ..
dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ vāsudevāya ca stanau .. 7 ..
4.85.d:
कंदर्पाय नमो मेढ्रमादित्याय नमः करौ ॥
दामोदरायेत्युदरं वासुदेवाय च स्तनौ ॥ 7 ॥
4.85.m: 'Homage to Kāmadeva!' the penis; 'Homage to the Sun!' the two hands; / 'To Dāmodara!' the belly; and 'to Vāsudeva!' the two breasts;

4.85.s:
mādhavāyeti hṛdayaṃ kaṃṭhaṃ vaikuṃṭhine namaḥ ..
śrīdharāya mukhaṃ keśānkeśavāyeti pāṃḍava .. 8 ..
4.85.d:
माधवायेति हृदयं कंठं वैकुंठिने नमः ॥
श्रीधराय मुखं केशान्केशवायेति पांडव ॥ 8 ॥
4.85.m: 'To Mādhava!' the heart; 'Homage to the Dweller of Vaikuṇṭha!' the throat; / 'To Śrīdhara!' the face; and 'to Keśava!' the hair, O son of Pāṇḍu;

4.85.s:
pṛṣṭhaṃ śārṅgadharāyeti śravaṇau varadāya vai ..
svanāmnā śaṃkhacakrāsigadāparaśupāṇaye .. 9 ..
4.85.d:
पृष्ठं शार्ङ्गधरायेति श्रवणौ वरदाय वै ॥
स्वनाम्ना शंखचक्रासिगदापरशुपाणये ॥ 9 ॥
4.85.m: 'To the Bearer of the Śārṅga bow!' the back; indeed, 'to the Boon-Giver!' the two ears; / with his own name, 'to the One who holds the conch, discus, sword, mace, and axe in his hands!'

4.85.s:
sarvātmane śiro rājannama ityabhipūjayet ..
daśāvatārarūpāṇi pratimāsaṃ kramānnṛpa .. 4.85.10 ..
4.85.d:
सर्वात्मने शिरो राजन्नम इत्यभिपूजयेत् ॥
दशावताररूपाणि प्रतिमासं क्रमान्नृप ॥ 4.85.10 ॥
4.85.m: 'To the Self of All, homage!' he should worship the head, O king. / The forms of the ten incarnations, month by month in order, O king,

4.85.s:
dattātreyaṃ yathā vyāsamutpalena samanvitam ..
dadyādanena vidhinā pākhaṃḍānapi varjayet .. 11 ..
4.85.d:
दत्तात्रेयं यथा व्यासमुत्पलेन समन्वितम् ॥
दद्यादनेन विधिना पाखंडानपि वर्जयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
4.85.m: as well as Dattātreya and Vyāsa accompanied by a blue lotus, / he should offer according to this rule, and he should shun heretics.

4.85.s:
samāpyaivaṃ yathāśaktyā dvādaśa dvādaśīrnaraḥ ..
saṃvatsarāṃte lavaṇaparvatena saha prabho ..
śayyāṃ dadyānmuniśreṣṭha gurave rasasaṃyutām .. .. 12 ..
4.85.d:
समाप्यैवं यथाशक्त्या द्वादश द्वादशीर्नरः ॥
संवत्सरांते लवणपर्वतेन सह प्रभो ॥
शय्यां दद्यान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ गुरवे रससंयुताम् ॥ ॥ 12 ॥
4.85.m: Having thus completed according to his ability the twelve twelfth [lunar days], a man, / at the end of the year, together with a salt mountain, O Lord, / should give a bed furnished with delicacies to the guru, O best of sages.

4.85.s:
grāmaṃ ca śaktimāndadyātkṣetraṃ vā bhavanānvitam ..
guruṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadvadvastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 13 ..
4.85.d:
ग्रामं च शक्तिमान्दद्यात्क्षेत्रं वा भवनान्वितम् ॥
गुरुं संपूज्य विधिवद्वद्वस्त्रालंकारभूषणैः ॥ 13 ॥
4.85.m: And if capable, he should give a village or a field with a house, / having worshipped the guru according to rule with garments and ornaments.

4.85.s:
anyānapi yathāśaktyā bhojayitvā dvijottamān..
tarpayedvastragodānairanyatra dhanasaṃcayāt .. 14 ..
4.85.d:
अन्यानपि यथाशक्त्या भोजयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान्॥
तर्पयेद्वस्त्रगोदानैरन्यत्र धनसंचयात् ॥ 14 ॥
4.85.m: Having fed other excellent twice-born men as well according to his ability, / he should gratify them with gifts of garments and cows, apart from his accumulated wealth.

4.85.s:
alpavitto yathāśaktyā stokaṃstokaṃ samācaret ..
yaścātiniḥsvaḥ puruṣo bhaktimānmādhavaṃ prati ..
puppārcanavidhānena sa kuryādvatsaratrayam ..15 ..
4.85.d:
अल्पवित्तो यथाशक्त्या स्तोकंस्तोकं समाचरेत् ॥
यश्चातिनिःस्वः पुरुषो भक्तिमान्माधवं प्रति ॥
पुप्पार्चनविधानेन स कुर्याद्वत्सरत्रयम् ॥15 ॥
4.85.m: One of small means should perform it little by little, according to his ability. / And a man who is destitute, devoted to Mādhava, / should perform it for three years according to the rule of worship with flowers.

4.85.s:
anena vidhinā yastu vibhūtidvādaśīvratam ..
kuryātsa pāpanirmuktaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tārayecchatam .. 16 ..
4.85.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु विभूतिद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
कुर्यात्स पापनिर्मुक्तः पितॄणां तारयेच्छतम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.85.m: Whoever performs the votive observance of the Vibhūtidvādaśī according to this rule / is freed from sin and redeems one hundred ancestors.

4.85.s:
janmanāṃ śatasāhasraṃ na śokaphalabhāgbhavet ..
na ca vyādhirbhavettasya na dāridyaṃ na bandhanam .. 17 ..
4.85.d:
जन्मनां शतसाहस्रं न शोकफलभाग्भवेत् ॥
न च व्याधिर्भवेत्तस्य न दारिद्यं न बन्धनम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.85.m: For a hundred thousand births he does not experience the fruit of sorrow, / nor does disease occur to him, nor poverty, nor bondage.

4.85.s:
vaiṣṇavo vātha śaivo vā bhavejanmanijanmani ..
yāvadyugasahasrāṇāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ bhavet ..
tāvatsvarge vasedrājanbhūpatiśca punarbhavet .. 18 ..
4.85.d:
वैष्णवो वाथ शैवो वा भवेजन्मनिजन्मनि ॥
यावद्युगसहस्राणां शतमष्टोत्तरं भवेत् ॥
तावत्स्वर्गे वसेद्राजन्भूपतिश्च पुनर्भवेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.85.m: He becomes a Vaiṣṇava or a Śaiva birth after birth; / for as long as one hundred and eight thousand yugas, / he dwells in heaven, O king, and becomes a ruler of the earth again.

4.85.s:
purā rathaṃtare kalpe rājāsītpuṣpavāhanaḥ ..
nāmnā lokeṣu vikhyātastejasā sūryasannibhaḥ .. 19 ..
4.85.d:
पुरा रथंतरे कल्पे राजासीत्पुष्पवाहनः ॥
नाम्ना लोकेषु विख्यातस्तेजसा सूर्यसन्निभः ॥ 19 ॥
4.85.m: Long ago in the Rathaṃtara Kalpa there was a king named Puṣpavāhana, / renowned among the worlds, equal to the sun in splendor.

4.85.s:
tapasā tasya tuṣṭena caturvaktreṇa bhārata ..
kamalaṃ kāñcanaṃ dattaṃ yathākāmagatiḥ sadā....4.85.20 ..
4.85.d:
तपसा तस्य तुष्टेन चतुर्वक्त्रेण भारत ॥
कमलं काञ्चनं दत्तं यथाकामगतिः सदा॥॥4.85.20 ॥
4.85.m: Pleasured by his ascetic practice, the four-faced [Brahmā], O descendant of Bharata, / gave him a golden lotus that moves anywhere at will always.

4.85.s:
samastabhṛtyasahitaḥ sāṃtaḥpuraparisthitaḥ ..
dvīpāni suralokaṃ ca yatheṣṭaṃ vicaratyasau .. 21 ..
4.85.d:
समस्तभृत्यसहितः सांतःपुरपरिस्थितः ॥
द्वीपानि सुरलोकं च यथेष्टं विचरत्यसौ ॥ 21 ॥
4.85.m: Accompanied by all his servants, established with his inner apartments, / he roamed at will through the continents and the realm of the gods.

4.85.s:
kalpādau saptame dvīpe tena puṣkaravāsinaḥ ..
loke saṃpūjitā yasmātpuṣkaradvīpa ucyate .. 22 ..
4.85.d:
कल्पादौ सप्तमे द्वीपे तेन पुष्करवासिनः ॥
लोके संपूजिता यस्मात्पुष्करद्वीप उच्यते ॥ 22 ॥
4.85.m: In the beginning of the kalpa, in the seventh continent, the dwellers of Puṣkara / were worshipped in the world by him, because of which it is called Puṣkaradvīpa.

4.85.s:
tadaiva brahmaṇā dattaṃ yānamasya yato nṛpa ..
puṣpavāhanamityāhustasmāttaṃ devadānavāḥ .. 23 ..
4.85.d:
तदैव ब्रह्मणा दत्तं यानमस्य यतो नृप ॥
पुष्पवाहनमित्याहुस्तस्मात्तं देवदानवाः ॥ 23 ॥
4.85.m: Since that vehicle was given to him then by Brahmā, O king, / therefore the gods and Dānavas called him Puṣpavāhana.

4.85.s:
nāgasya tasyāsya jagattrayepi brahmāṃbujasthasya tapo'nubhāvāt ..
patnī ca tasyāpratimā narendra nārīsahasrairabhito'bhinaṃdyā..24..
4.85.d:
नागस्य तस्यास्य जगत्त्रयेपि ब्रह्मांबुजस्थस्य तपोऽनुभावात् ॥
पत्नी च तस्याप्रतिमा नरेन्द्र नारीसहस्रैरभितोऽभिनंद्या॥24॥
4.85.m: Through the power of his ascetic practice, seated on Brahmā's lotus, there was no sin for him in the three worlds. / And his wife, O king of men, was peerless, praised on all sides by thousands of women.

4.85.s:
nāmnā ca lāvaṇyavatī babhūva yā pārvatīveṣṭatamā bhavasya ..
tasyātmajānāmayutaṃ babhūva dharmātmanāmagryadhanurddharāṇām .. 25 ..
4.85.d:
नाम्ना च लावण्यवती बभूव या पार्वतीवेष्टतमा भवस्य ॥
तस्यात्मजानामयुतं बभूव धर्मात्मनामग्र्यधनुर्द्धराणाम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.85.m: By name she was Lāvaṇyavatī, who was most beloved just as Pārvatī is to Bhava. / He had ten thousand sons, righteous and foremost among bowmen.

4.85.s:
tadātmanaḥ sarvamavekṣya rājā muhurmuhurvismayamāsasāda ..
sobhyāgataṃ pūjya munipravīraṃ pracetasaṃ vācamimāṃ babhāṣe .. 26 ..
4.85.d:
तदात्मनः सर्वमवेक्ष्य राजा मुहुर्मुहुर्विस्मयमाससाद ॥
सोभ्यागतं पूज्य मुनिप्रवीरं प्रचेतसं वाचमिमां बभाषे ॥ 26 ॥
4.85.m: Looking upon all that of his own, the king was filled with wonder again and again. / Having worshipped the foremost sage Pracetas who had arrived, he spoke this word:

4.85.s:
kasmādvibhūtiramalā mama martyapūjyā jāyā ca sarvavijitāmarasundarī yā ..
bhāryā tvanalpatapasā vasutoṣitena dattaṃ mamāṃbujagṛhaṃ paramaprasādāt .. 27 ..
4.85.d:
कस्माद्विभूतिरमला मम मर्त्यपूज्या जाया च सर्वविजितामरसुन्दरी या ॥
भार्या त्वनल्पतपसा वसुतोषितेन दत्तं ममांबुजगृहं परमप्रसादात् ॥ 27 ॥
4.85.m: 'Whence is my spotless prosperity, worshipped by mortals, and my wife, who surpasses all the beauties of the gods? / Indeed, a wife, and through immense asceticism, by the gratified Creator, this lotus-abode was given to me by supreme grace;

4.85.s:
yasminpraviṣṭamapi koṭiśataṃ nṛpāṇāṃ sāmātyakujaranarāśvaghanāvṛtānām ..
nālakṣya sambādhatayā hi bādhastārāgaṇairapi surāsuralokapālaiḥ .. 28 ..
4.85.d:
यस्मिन्प्रविष्टमपि कोटिशतं नृपाणां सामात्यकुजरनराश्वघनावृतानाम् ॥
नालक्ष्य सम्बाधतया हि बाधस्तारागणैरपि सुरासुरलोकपालैः ॥ 28 ॥
4.85.m: in which even though a hundred million kings entered, surrounded by ministers, elephants, men, and horses dense [in number], / no obstruction due to overcrowding was seen, nor even by hosts of stars, gods, asuras, or world protectors.

4.85.s:
tasmātkimanyajananījaṭharodbhavena dharmādikaṃ kṛtamaśeṣajanātigaṃ syāt ..
samyaṅmayātha tanayairanayā maharṣe māhāryayā tadakhilaṃ kathaya pracetaḥ ..29..
4.85.d:
तस्मात्किमन्यजननीजठरोद्भवेन धर्मादिकं कृतमशेषजनातिगं स्यात् ॥
सम्यङ्मयाथ तनयैरनया महर्षे माहार्यया तदखिलं कथय प्रचेतः ॥29॥
4.85.m: Therefore, what religious merit surpassing that of all people was performed / by another born from a mother's womb, properly by me, or by these sons, O great sage, / or by this noble wife? Tell all that, O Pracetas!'

4.85.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyānenā vekṣya cākhilam ..
pracetāstamuvācātha śṛṇu bhūpa purātanam .. 4.85.30 ..
4.85.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ध्यानेना वेक्ष्य चाखिलम् ॥
प्रचेतास्तमुवाचाथ शृणु भूप पुरातनम् ॥ 4.85.30 ॥
4.85.m: Hearing his speech, and surveying everything through meditation, / Pracetas then said to him: 'Listen, O king, to what occurred in the past.

4.85.s:
lubdhakastvaṃ purā rājansarvasattvabhayaṃkaraḥ ..
āsīdasādhucaritaḥ suhṛnmitravi varjitaḥ .. 31 ..
4.85.d:
लुब्धकस्त्वं पुरा राजन्सर्वसत्त्वभयंकरः ॥
आसीदसाधुचरितः सुहृन्मित्रवि वर्जितः ॥ 31 ॥
4.85.m: You were formerly a hunter, O king, terrifying to all living beings, / of wicked conduct, destitute of companions and friends.

4.85.s:
yatamadhyo hrasvakeśaḥ kṛṣṇāṃgo raktalocanaḥ ..
dhanuṣpāṇirvanagataḥ kṛtāṃtakasamo bhavān ..32..
4.85.d:
यतमध्यो ह्रस्वकेशः कृष्णांगो रक्तलोचनः ॥
धनुष्पाणिर्वनगतः कृतांतकसमो भवान् ॥32॥
4.85.m: Slender-waisted, short-haired, dark-bodied, red-eyed, / bow in hand, dwelling in the forest, you were like the God of Death.

4.85.s:
abhūdanāvṛṣṭiratīva raudrā kadāci dāhāranimittaroṣaḥ ..
padmānyathādāya tato bahūni gataṃ puraṃ vaidiśanāmadheyam .. 33 ..
4.85.d:
अभूदनावृष्टिरतीव रौद्रा कदाचि दाहारनिमित्तरोषः ॥
पद्मान्यथादाय ततो बहूनि गतं पुरं वैदिशनामधेयम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.85.m: There was an exceedingly terrible drought; once, enraged for the sake of food, / taking then many lotuses, [you] went to the city named Vaidiśa.

4.85.s:
unmūlya lobhācca puraṃ samastaṃ bhrāṃtaṃ tvayāśeṣamahattadā sīt ..
kretā na kaścitkamaleṣu jātastoke bhṛśaṃ kṣutparipīḍitaśca .. 34 ..
4.85.d:
उन्मूल्य लोभाच्च पुरं समस्तं भ्रांतं त्वयाशेषमहत्तदा सीत् ॥
क्रेता न कश्चित्कमलेषु जातस्तोके भृशं क्षुत्परिपीडितश्च ॥ 34 ॥
4.85.m: Having uprooted [them] out of greed, the entire city was wandered through by you, immense as it was then; / no buyer appeared for the lotuses, and you were intensely tormented by hunger with little [left].

4.85.s:
upaviṣṭastvamekasminsabhāryo bhavanāṃgaṇe ..
atha maṃgalaśabdastu tvayā rātrau tathā śrutaḥ .. 35 ..
4.85.d:
उपविष्टस्त्वमेकस्मिन्सभार्यो भवनांगणे ॥
अथ मंगलशब्दस्तु त्वया रात्रौ तथा श्रुतः ॥ 35 ॥
4.85.m: You sat down in the courtyard of a house together with your wife; / then, indeed, the sound of auspicious celebrations was heard by you at night.

4.85.s:
samāpya māghamāsasya dvādaśyāṃ lavaṇācalam ..
nivedayaṃtī gurave śayyāṃ copaskarānvitām .. 36 ..
4.85.d:
समाप्य माघमासस्य द्वादश्यां लवणाचलम् ॥
निवेदयंती गुरवे शय्यां चोपस्करान्विताम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.85.m: Having concluded [the vow] on the twelfth lunar day of the month of Māgha, [a woman] was presenting / a salt mountain and a bed furnished with utensils to her guru.

4.85.s:
alaṃkṛtya hṛṣīkeśaṃ sīvarṇaṃ paramaṃ padam ..
sātha dṛṣṭā tatastābhyāmidaṃ cittevadhāritam..37..
4.85.d:
अलंकृत्य हृषीकेशं सीवर्णं परमं पदम् ॥
साथ दृष्टा ततस्ताभ्यामिदं चित्तेवधारितम्॥37॥
4.85.m: Having decorated Hṛṣīkeśa, made of gold, the supreme state, / she was then seen by the two of [you], and this was resolved in your mind:

4.85.s:
kimebhiḥ kamalaiḥ kāryaṃ varaṃ viṣṇuralaṃkṛtaḥ..
iti bhaktistadā jātā dāmpatyasya nareśvara .. 38 ..
4.85.d:
किमेभिः कमलैः कार्यं वरं विष्णुरलंकृतः॥
इति भक्तिस्तदा जाता दाम्पत्यस्य नरेश्वर ॥ 38 ॥
4.85.m: 'What is the use of these lotuses? It is better that Viṣṇu be adorned.' / Thus devotion arose then in the husband and wife, O ruler of men.

4.85.s:
tatprasaṃgātsamabhyarcya keśavaṃ lavaṇācalam..
śayyā ca puṣpaprakaraiḥ pūjitābhūcca sarvadā .. 39 ..
4.85.d:
तत्प्रसंगात्समभ्यर्च्य केशवं लवणाचलम्॥
शय्या च पुष्पप्रकरैः पूजिताभूच्च सर्वदा ॥ 39 ॥
4.85.m: On that occasion, having worshipped Keśava, the salt mountain / and the bed were worshipped constantly with heaps of flowers.

4.85.s:
athānaṃgavatī tuṣṭā tayorhonaśatatrayam ..
prādādgṛhītaṃ tābhyāṃ ca na tatsarvāvalaṃbanāt .. 4.85.40 ..
4.85.d:
अथानंगवती तुष्टा तयोर्होनशतत्रयम् ॥
प्रादाद्गृहीतं ताभ्यां च न तत्सर्वावलंबनात् ॥ 4.85.40 ॥
4.85.m: Then Anaṅgavatī, pleased, gave three hundred gold coins to the two; / but it was not accepted by them, out of reliance on the All.

4.85.s:
anaṃgavatī ca punastayorannaṃ caturvidham..
ānāyyopahṛtaṃ kṛtvā bhujyatāmiti bhūpate.. ..41..
4.85.d:
अनंगवती च पुनस्तयोरन्नं चतुर्विधम्॥
आनाय्योपहृतं कृत्वा भुज्यतामिति भूपते॥ ॥41॥
4.85.m: And then Anaṅgavatī, having had four kinds of food brought / and offered to the two, said, 'Let it be eaten,' O king.

4.85.s:
tābhyāṃ tu tadapi tyaktaṃ bhojyāvaḥ śvo varānane ..
prasaṃgāccopavāsena tavādyāstu sukhāvahaḥ .. 42 ..
4.85.d:
ताभ्यां तु तदपि त्यक्तं भोज्यावः श्वो वरानने ॥
प्रसंगाच्चोपवासेन तवाद्यास्तु सुखावहः ॥ 42 ॥
4.85.m: Yet the two of them refused even that, [saying,] “We shall eat tomorrow, O fair-faced lady! / And through your fasting on this occasion, may it bring happiness today!

4.85.s:
janmaprabhṛti pāpiṣṭhāvāvāṃ devi dṛḍhavrate..
satprasaṃgāddhanurmadhye dharmalābhastu cāvayoḥ .. 43 ..
4.85.d:
जन्मप्रभृति पापिष्ठावावां देवि दृढव्रते॥
सत्प्रसंगाद्धनुर्मध्ये धर्मलाभस्तु चावयोः ॥ 43 ॥
4.85.m: We two have been the most sinful since birth, O lady of firm vows; / but through virtuous company in our hunting territory, we have gained righteousness!”

4.85.s:
iti jāgaraṇaṃ tābhyāṃ prasaṃgāttadanuṣṭhitam ..
prabhāte ca tayā dattā śayyā salavaṇācalā .. 44 ..
4.85.d:
इति जागरणं ताभ्यां प्रसंगात्तदनुष्ठितम् ॥
प्रभाते च तया दत्ता शय्या सलवणाचला ॥ 44 ॥
4.85.m: Thus the vigil was observed by the two on that occasion. / And in the morning, she gave away a bed together with a mountain of salt,

4.85.s:
grāmaśca gurave bhaktyā viprebhyo dvādaśaiva hi ..
vastrālaṃkārayuktāṃgā gāvaśca kanakāṃcitāḥ .. 45 ..
4.85.d:
ग्रामश्च गुरवे भक्त्या विप्रेभ्यो द्वादशैव हि ॥
वस्त्रालंकारयुक्तांगा गावश्च कनकांचिताः ॥ 45 ॥
4.85.m: and with devotion, a village to the preceptor, and indeed twelve cows adorned with garments and ornaments / and decked with gold to the brahmins.

4.85.s:
bhojanaṃ ca suhṛnmitradīnāṃdhakṛpaṇaiḥ samam ..
tattu lubdhakadāṃpatyaṃ pūjayitvā visarjitam ..46..
4.85.d:
भोजनं च सुहृन्मित्रदीनांधकृपणैः समम् ॥
तत्तु लुब्धकदांपत्यं पूजयित्वा विसर्जितम् ॥46॥
4.85.m: And [there was] a feast together with relatives, friends, the wretched, the blind, and the destitute. / Then, having honored that hunter couple, she dismissed them.

4.85.s:
bhavām̐stu lubdhako jātaḥ sapatnīko nareśvaraḥ ..
puṣpāṇāṃ prakare tasmātkeśavasya prapūjanam ..47..
4.85.d:
भवाम्̐स्तु लुब्धको जातः सपत्नीको नरेश्वरः ॥
पुष्पाणां प्रकरे तस्मात्केशवस्य प्रपूजनम् ॥47॥
4.85.m: You were that hunter, born together with your wife, O lord of men; / therefore, through the multitude of flowers, there was worship of Keśava.

4.85.s:
prāptaṃ sudurllabhaṃ vīra tvayā puṣkaramandiram ..
tasya sarvasya māhātmyādalaṃ na tapasā nṛpa .. 48 ..
4.85.d:
प्राप्तं सुदुर्ल्लभं वीर त्वया पुष्करमन्दिरम् ॥
तस्य सर्वस्य माहात्म्यादलं न तपसा नृप ॥ 48 ॥
4.85.m: The rarely attained abode of Puṣkara was reached by you, O hero; / by the greatness of all that, enough of austerity, O king!

4.85.s:
yathā kāmagataṃ dakṣaṃ padmayoniṃ viriṃcinā ..
saṃtuṣṭastasya rājendra brahmarūpī janārdanaḥ ..49 ..
4.85.d:
यथा कामगतं दक्षं पद्मयोनिं विरिंचिना ॥
संतुष्टस्तस्य राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मरूपी जनार्दनः ॥49 ॥
4.85.m: Just as Viriñci [was pleased] with Dakṣa, the lotus-born, who acted as he pleased, / so Janārdana, in the form of Brahman, was pleased with him, O king of kings.

4.85.s:
śayyānaṃgavatī veśyā kāmadeśasya sāṃpratam ..
patnī sapatnī saṃjātā ratyā prītiriti śrutā .. 4.85.50 ..
4.85.d:
शय्यानंगवती वेश्या कामदेशस्य सांप्रतम् ॥
पत्नी सपत्नी संजाता रत्या प्रीतिरिति श्रुता ॥ 4.85.50 ॥
4.85.m: The courtesan Anaṅgavatī of the bed has now become the wife of the god of love; / she became a co-wife with Rati, known as Prīti,

4.85.s:
lokeṣvānaṃdajananī sakalāmarapūjitā ..
tadapyutsṛjya rājendra nirvāṇaṃ samavāpsyasi .. 51 ..
4.85.d:
लोकेष्वानंदजननी सकलामरपूजिता ॥
तदप्युत्सृज्य राजेन्द्र निर्वाणं समवाप्स्यसि ॥ 51 ॥
4.85.m: bringing joy in the worlds, worshipped by all the immortals. / Having left behind even that, O king of kings, you will attain final liberation.”

4.85.s:
ityuktvā sa muniḥ sarvaṃ tatraivāṃtarhitobhavat ..
rājā yathoktaṃ ca punaḥ sa cakre puṣpavāhanaḥ .. 52 ..
4.85.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स मुनिः सर्वं तत्रैवांतर्हितोभवत् ॥
राजा यथोक्तं च पुनः स चक्रे पुष्पवाहनः ॥ 52 ॥
4.85.m: Having spoken thus, that sage disappeared right there; / and the king, Puṣpavāhana, performed it again as prescribed.

4.85.s:
imāmācarato brahmannakhaṇḍavratamācaret ..
yathākathaṃcitkālena dvādaśa dvādaśīrmune ..
kartavyāḥ śaktito deyā viprebhyo dakṣiṇā nṛpa .. 53 ..
4.85.d:
इमामाचरतो ब्रह्मन्नखण्डव्रतमाचरेत् ॥
यथाकथंचित्कालेन द्वादश द्वादशीर्मुने ॥
कर्तव्याः शक्तितो देया विप्रेभ्यो दक्षिणा नृप ॥ 53 ॥
4.85.m: One who observes this, O brahmin, should perform the unbroken votive observance. / Somehow over time, twelve Dvādaśīs, O sage, / are to be performed, and according to one's capacity, a sacrificial fee must be given to brahmins, O king.

4.85.s:
iti kaluṣavidāraṇaṃ janānāmiti paṭhati śṛṇoti cātibhaktyā ..
matimapi ca dadāti devaloke vasati sa paraḥśatāni vatsarāṇām .. 54 ..
madanadvādaśīvratavarṇanam
4.85.d:
इति कलुषविदारणं जनानामिति पठति शृणोति चातिभक्त्या ॥
मतिमपि च ददाति देवलोके वसति स परःशतानि वत्सराणाम् ॥ 54 ॥
मदनद्वादशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.85.m:
Whoever reads or hears with great devotion this [text] which destroys the sins of men, / or even turns their mind to it, dwells in the world of the gods for over a hundred years.
Description of the Madanadvādaśī Votive Observance

4.86.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śrotumicchāmi bhagavanmadanadvādaśīvratam ..
sutānekonapaṃcāśadyena lebhe ditiḥ purā .. 1 ..
4.86.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
श्रोतुमिच्छामि भगवन्मदनद्वादशीव्रतम् ॥
सुतानेकोनपंचाशद्येन लेभे दितिः पुरा ॥ 1 ॥
4.86.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / “O Lord, I wish to hear about the Madanadvādaśī votive observance, / by which Diti formerly obtained forty-nine sons.”

4.86.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca.. ..
tadvaśiṣṭhādibhiḥ proktamityekā tithiruttamā ..
vistareṇa tadevedaṃ matsakāśānnivodhata .. 2 ..
4.86.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच॥ ॥
तद्वशिष्ठादिभिः प्रोक्तमित्येका तिथिरुत्तमा ॥
विस्तरेण तदेवेदं मत्सकाशान्निवोधत ॥ 2 ॥
4.86.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “That was proclaimed by Vasiṣṭha and others as an excellent lunar day; / learn that very [observance] in detail from me.

4.86.s:
caitre māse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ niyatavrataḥ ..
sthāpayedavraṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ sitataṃḍulapūritam.. 3 ..
4.86.d:
चैत्रे मासे सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां नियतव्रतः ॥
स्थापयेदव्रणं कुंभं सिततंडुलपूरितम्॥ 3 ॥
4.86.m: In the month of Caitra, during the bright fortnight, on the twelfth day, constant in vows, / one should set up an unblemished jar filled with white rice,

4.86.s:
nānāphalayutaṃ tadvadikṣudaṇḍasamanvitam ..
sitavastrayugacchannaṃ sitacandana carcitam .. 4 ..
4.86.d:
नानाफलयुतं तद्वदिक्षुदण्डसमन्वितम् ॥
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्नं सितचन्दन चर्चितम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.86.m: provided with various fruits, likewise accompanied by sugarcane stalks, / covered with a pair of white cloths, and smeared with white sandalwood paste,

4.86.s:
nānābhakṣyasamopetaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca śaktitaḥ ..
tāmrapātraṃ guḍopetaṃ tasyopari nivedayeta .. 5 ..
4.86.d:
नानाभक्ष्यसमोपेतं सहिरण्यं च शक्तितः ॥
ताम्रपात्रं गुडोपेतं तस्योपरि निवेदयेत ॥ 5 ॥
4.86.m: accompanied by various kinds of food, along with gold according to one's capacity. / One should offer a copper vessel containing molasses on top of it.

4.86.s:
tasyopari tathā kāmaṃ kadalīdala saṃsthitam ..
kuryāccharkarayopetamiti tasya samīpataḥ .. 6 ..
4.86.d:
तस्योपरि तथा कामं कदलीदल संस्थितम् ॥
कुर्याच्छर्करयोपेतमिति तस्य समीपतः ॥ 6 ॥
4.86.m: On top of that, upon a banana leaf, one should likewise place Kāma / accompanied by sugar; thus in its vicinity,

4.86.s:
gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dadyādgītaṃ vādyaṃ ca kārayet..
tadalābhe kathāṃ kuryātkāmakeśavayo rnaraḥ .. 7 ..
4.86.d:
गंधं पुष्पं तथा दद्याद्गीतं वाद्यं च कारयेत्॥
तदलाभे कथां कुर्यात्कामकेशवयो र्नरः ॥ 7 ॥
4.86.m: one should offer perfume and flowers, and cause song and instrumental music to be performed. / In their absence, a man should recite the story of Kāma and Keśava.

4.86.s:
kāmaṃ nāmnā harerarcāṃ snāpayedgaṃdhavāriṇā ..
śuklapuṣpākṣatatilairarcayenmadhusūdanam .. 8 ..
4.86.d:
कामं नाम्ना हरेरर्चां स्नापयेद्गंधवारिणा ॥
शुक्लपुष्पाक्षततिलैरर्चयेन्मधुसूदनम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.86.m: One should bathe the image of Hari with fragrant water in the name of Kāma; / with white flowers, unblemished grains of rice, and sesame seeds, one should worship Madhusūdana.

4.86.s:
kāmāya pādau saṃpūjya jaṃghe saubhāgyadāya ca ..
manmathāya tathā meḍhraṃ mādhavāya kaṭiṃ namaḥ .. 9 ..
4.86.d:
कामाय पादौ संपूज्य जंघे सौभाग्यदाय च ॥
मन्मथाय तथा मेढ्रं माधवाय कटिं नमः ॥ 9 ॥
4.86.m: ‘Homage to Kāma’, having worshipped the two feet; ‘to the Giver of good fortune’, the two calves; / ‘to Manmatha’, the male organ; ‘to Mādhava’, the waist;

4.86.s:
śāṃtodarāyetyudaramanaṃgāyetyuro hareḥ ..
mukhaṃ padmamukhāyeti bāhuṃ pañcaśarāya vai .. 4.86.10 ..
4.86.d:
शांतोदरायेत्युदरमनंगायेत्युरो हरेः ॥
मुखं पद्ममुखायेति बाहुं पञ्चशराय वै ॥ 4.86.10 ॥
4.86.m: ‘to the One of tranquil belly’, the belly; ‘to Anaṅga’, the chest of Hari; / ‘to the Lotus-faced’, the face; ‘to the Five-arrowed’, the arm;

4.86.s:
namaḥ sarvātmane maulimarcayediti keśavam ..
tataḥ prabhāte kuṃbhaṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayeta .. 11 ..
4.86.d:
नमः सर्वात्मने मौलिमर्चयेदिति केशवम् ॥
ततः प्रभाते कुंभं च ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत ॥ 11 ॥
4.86.m: ‘Homage to the Self of all’, one should thus worship Keśava's head. / Then in the morning, one should offer the jar to a brahmin.

4.86.s:
brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā svayaṃ ca lavaṇādṛte ..
bhaktyātha dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādimaṃ maṃtramudīrayet .. 12 ..
4.86.d:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेद्भक्त्या स्वयं च लवणादृते ॥
भक्त्याथ दक्षिणां दद्यादिमं मंत्रमुदीरयेत् ॥ 12 ॥
4.86.m: One should feed brahmins with devotion, and oneself [eat] without salt. / Then with devotion one should give a sacrificial fee and utter this mantra:

4.86.s:
prīyatāmatra bhagavānkāmarūpī janārdanaḥ ..
hṛdaye sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā vedo'bhidhīyate .. 13 ..
4.86.d:
प्रीयतामत्र भगवान्कामरूपी जनार्दनः ॥
हृदये सर्वभूतानां यथा वेदोऽभिधीयते ॥ 13 ॥
4.86.m: ‘May the blessed Lord Janārdana, whose form is desire, be pleased here, / just as he is proclaimed in the Veda to be in the heart of all beings.’

4.86.s:
anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsimāsi samācaret ..
phalamāmalakaṃ prāśya dvādaśyāṃ bhūtale svapet .. 14 ..
4.86.d:
अनेन विधिना सर्वं मासिमासि समाचरेत् ॥
फलमामलकं प्राश्य द्वादश्यां भूतले स्वपेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.86.m: According to this procedure, one should perform everything month after month. / Having eaten an āmalaka fruit, one should sleep on the bare ground on the twelfth day.

4.86.s:
tatastrayodaśe māsi ghṛtadhenusamanvitām ..
śayyāṃ dadyāddvijendrāya sarvopaskarasaṃyutām .. 15 ..
4.86.d:
ततस्त्रयोदशे मासि घृतधेनुसमन्विताम् ॥
शय्यां दद्याद्द्विजेन्द्राय सर्वोपस्करसंयुताम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.86.m: Then in the thirteenth month, together with an effigy of a cow made of clarified butter, / one should give a bed provided with all household items to an excellent brahmin,

4.86.s:
kāñcanaṃ kāmadevaṃ ca śuklāṃ gāṃ ca payasvinīm ..
vāsobhirdvijadāṃpatyaṃ pūjya śaktyā vibhūṣaṇaiḥ..16..
4.86.d:
काञ्चनं कामदेवं च शुक्लां गां च पयस्विनीम् ॥
वासोभिर्द्विजदांपत्यं पूज्य शक्त्या विभूषणैः॥16॥
4.86.m: and a golden Kāmadeva, and a white milch cow, / having honored a brahmin couple with garments and ornaments according to one's capacity.

4.86.s:
homaḥ śuklatilaiḥ kāryaḥ kāmanāmāni kīrtayet ..
gavyena sarpiṣā tatra pāyasena ca dharmavit .. 17 ..
4.86.d:
होमः शुक्लतिलैः कार्यः कामनामानि कीर्तयेत् ॥
गव्येन सर्पिषा तत्र पायसेन च धर्मवित् ॥ 17 ॥
4.86.m: A burnt offering should be made with white sesame seeds; one should recite the names of Kāma. / One who knows dharma [should perform it] with cow's clarified butter and milk-rice pudding there.

4.86.s:
viprebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyādvitta śāṭhyaṃvivarjayet ..
ikṣudaṃḍānnaro dadyātpuṣpamālāṃ ca śaktitaḥ .. 18 ..
4.86.d:
विप्रेभ्यो भोजनं दद्याद्वित्त शाठ्यंविवर्जयेत् ॥
इक्षुदंडान्नरो दद्यात्पुष्पमालां च शक्तितः ॥ 18 ॥
4.86.m: One should give food to brahmins, avoiding stinginess with wealth. / A man should give sugarcane stalks and a garland of flowers according to his capacity.

4.86.s:
yaḥ kuryādvidhinānena madanadvādaśīmimām ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam .. 19 ..
4.86.d:
यः कुर्याद्विधिनानेन मदनद्वादशीमिमाम् ॥
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः प्राप्नोति परमं पदम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.86.m: Whoever performs this Madanadvādaśī according to this procedure, / freed from all sins, attains the highest state.

4.86.s:
iha loke varānputrānsaubhāgyaṃ sukhamaśnute ..
kaśyapo vratamāhātmyādāgatya parayā mudā .. 4.86.20 ..
4.86.d:
इह लोके वरान्पुत्रान्सौभाग्यं सुखमश्नुते ॥
कश्यपो व्रतमाहात्म्यादागत्य परया मुदा ॥ 4.86.20 ॥
4.86.m: In this world he enjoys excellent sons, good fortune, and happiness. / Through the greatness of the votive observance, Kaśyapa, having arrived with supreme joy,

4.86.s:
cakārākarkaśāṃ bhūyo rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyutām ..
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa yā ca vavre varaṃ varam ..
putraṃ śatruvadhārthāya samarthamamitaujasam .. 21 ..
4.86.d:
चकाराकर्कशां भूयो रूपलावण्यसंयुताम् ॥
वरेण च्छन्दयामास या च वव्रे वरं वरम् ॥
पुत्रं शत्रुवधार्थाय समर्थममितौजसम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.86.m: made her tender once again, endowed with beauty and charm, / and invited her to choose a boon; and she chose the best boon: / an able son of boundless splendor to slay enemies.

4.86.s:
prārthayāmi mahābhāgyaṃ sarvāmaraniṣūdanam ..
kaśyapaḥ prāha tāṃ bhadre evamastu suśobhane .. 22 ..
4.86.d:
प्रार्थयामि महाभाग्यं सर्वामरनिषूदनम् ॥
कश्यपः प्राह तां भद्रे एवमस्तु सुशोभने ॥ 22 ॥
4.86.m: ‘I request a son of great fortune, a destroyer of all the immortals.’ / Kaśyapa said to her, ‘Fair lady, so be it, O very beautiful woman!

4.86.s:
saṃvatsaraśataṃ tvekaṃ garbho dhāryaḥ sukhepsayā ..
saṃdhyāyāṃ naiva bhoktavyaṃ garbhiṇyā varavarṇini .. 23 ..
4.86.d:
संवत्सरशतं त्वेकं गर्भो धार्यः सुखेप्सया ॥
संध्यायां नैव भोक्तव्यं गर्भिण्या वरवर्णिनि ॥ 23 ॥
4.86.m: However, for one seeking happiness, the fetus must be borne for one hundred years. / A pregnant woman must never eat during the twilight, O fair-complexioned lady.

4.86.s:
na sthātavyaṃ na gaṃtavyaṃ vṛkṣamūleṣu sarvadā ..
nopaskare bhuvi viśenmusalolūkhalādiṣu .. 24 ..
4.86.d:
न स्थातव्यं न गंतव्यं वृक्षमूलेषु सर्वदा ॥
नोपस्करे भुवि विशेन्मुसलोलूखलादिषु ॥ 24 ॥
4.86.m: She must never stand nor walk under the roots of trees; / nor should she sit on household implements on the ground, such as a pestle or a mortar.

4.86.s:
jalaṃ na cāvagāheta śūnyāgāraṃ vivarjayet ..
varjayetkalahaṃ gehe gātrabhaṃgaṃ tathaiva ca ..25..
4.86.d:
जलं न चावगाहेत शून्यागारं विवर्जयेत् ॥
वर्जयेत्कलहं गेहे गात्रभंगं तथैव च ॥25॥
4.86.m: She should not plunge into water; she should avoid a deserted house; / she should avoid quarrelling in the home, and likewise stretching her limbs.

4.86.s:
muktakeśī na tiṣṭheta nāśuciḥ syātkathaṃcana ..
na śayītonnataśirā na cāpyārdraśirāḥ kvacit .. 26 ..
4.86.d:
मुक्तकेशी न तिष्ठेत नाशुचिः स्यात्कथंचन ॥
न शयीतोन्नतशिरा न चाप्यार्द्रशिराः क्वचित् ॥ 26 ॥
4.86.m: She should not remain with dishevelled hair; she must never be impure; / she should never sleep with her head raised, nor with her head wet.

4.86.s:
na vastuhīnā nodvignā nārdrapādā na bhūtale ..
nāmaṃgalyāṃ vadedvācaṃ na ca hāsyaparā bhavet .. 27 ..
4.86.d:
न वस्तुहीना नोद्विग्ना नार्द्रपादा न भूतले ॥
नामंगल्यां वदेद्वाचं न च हास्यपरा भवेत् ॥ 27 ॥
4.86.m: She should not be unclothed, nor agitated, nor have wet feet, nor lie on the bare earth; / she should not utter inauspicious words, nor indulge in loud laughter.

4.86.s:
kuryācca guruśuśrūṣāṃ nityaṃ maṃgalatatparā ..
sarvauṣadhībhiḥ koṣṇena vāriṇā snānamācaret .. 28 ..
4.86.d:
कुर्याच्च गुरुशुश्रूषां नित्यं मंगलतत्परा ॥
सर्वौषधीभिः कोष्णेन वारिणा स्नानमाचरेत् ॥ 28 ॥
4.86.m: And she should serve her elders, constantly devoted to auspiciousness; / she should bathe in lukewarm water infused with all medicinal herbs.

4.86.s:
kustriyo nābhibhāṣeta vastravātaṃ vivarjayet ..
mṛtavatsādi saṃsargaṃ paragehe ca suṃdari .. 29 ..
4.86.d:
कुस्त्रियो नाभिभाषेत वस्त्रवातं विवर्जयेत् ॥
मृतवत्सादि संसर्गं परगेहे च सुंदरि ॥ 29 ॥
4.86.m:
She should not converse with wicked women; she should avoid the breeze from clothes
and contact with those who have lost children and the like in another's house, O beautiful lady.

4.86.s:
na śīghraṃ mārgamākrāmellaṃghayenna mahānadīm ..
na ca bībhatsakaṃ kiṃcinna ca vīkṣedbhayānakam .. 4.86.30 ..
4.86.d:
न शीघ्रं मार्गमाक्रामेल्लंघयेन्न महानदीम् ॥
न च बीभत्सकं किंचिन्न च वीक्षेद्भयानकम् ॥ 4.86.30 ॥
4.86.m:
She should not walk swiftly on the road; she should not cross a great river;
and she should not look at anything loathsome or terrifying.

4.86.s:
guru vātulamāhāramajīrṇaṃ na samācaret ..
saṃpūrṇagarbhiṇyāyāmaṃ vyāyāmaṃ vā vivarjayet .. 31 ..
4.86.d:
गुरु वातुलमाहारमजीर्णं न समाचरेत् ॥
संपूर्णगर्भिण्यायामं व्यायामं वा विवर्जयेत् ॥ 31 ॥
4.86.m:
She should not consume heavy, wind-provoking, or indigestible food;
when her pregnancy is full, she should avoid overexertion or physical exercise.

4.86.s:
garbho rakṣyaḥ sadauṣadhyā hṛdi dhāryo na matsaraḥ ..
anena vidhinā sādhvi śobhanaṃ putramāpnuyāt .. 32 ..
4.86.d:
गर्भो रक्ष्यः सदौषध्या हृदि धार्यो न मत्सरः ॥
अनेन विधिना साध्वि शोभनं पुत्रमाप्नुयात् ॥ 32 ॥
4.86.m:
The embryo should always be protected with herbs; malice should not be harboured in the heart.
By this procedure, virtuous lady, she will obtain a splendid son.

4.86.s:
anyathā garbhapatanaṃ staṃbhanaṃ vā pravartate ..
tasmāttvamanayā vṛttyā garbhesmiṃśca samācareḥ ..
bhaviṣyati śubhaḥ putraḥ sarvāvayavasuṃdaraḥ .. 33 ..
4.86.d:
अन्यथा गर्भपतनं स्तंभनं वा प्रवर्तते ॥
तस्मात्त्वमनया वृत्त्या गर्भेस्मिंश्च समाचरेः ॥
भविष्यति शुभः पुत्रः सर्वावयवसुंदरः ॥ 33 ॥

4.86.s:
svastyastu te gamiṣyāmi tathetyuktastayā ca saḥ ..
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tatraivāṃtarhitobhavat .. .. 34 ..
4.86.d:
स्वस्त्यस्तु ते गमिष्यामि तथेत्युक्तस्तया च सः ॥
पश्यतां सर्वभूतानां तत्रैवांतर्हितोभवत् ॥ ॥ 34 ॥
4.86.m:
“May you have well-being; I shall depart.” And told by her, “So be it,”
he disappeared right there while all living beings watched.

4.86.s:
tataḥ sā kaśyapoktena vidhinā samatiṣṭhata ..
athāpa putrānpaṃcāśadekonānpāṃḍunaṃdana .. 35 ..
4.86.d:
ततः सा कश्यपोक्तेन विधिना समतिष्ठत ॥
अथाप पुत्रान्पंचाशदेकोनान्पांडुनंदन ॥ 35 ॥
4.86.m:
Then she adhered to the procedure stated by Kaśyapa.
Then she obtained forty-nine sons, O son of Pāṇḍu.

4.86.s:
evamanyāpi yā nārī madanadvādaśīmi mām ..
karoti putrānāpnoti saha bhartrā sukhī bhavet.. 36 ..
4.86.d:
एवमन्यापि या नारी मदनद्वादशीमि माम् ॥
करोति पुत्रानाप्नोति सह भर्त्रा सुखी भवेत्॥ 36 ॥
4.86.m:
Likewise, whatever other woman performs this Madanadvādaśī
obtains sons and becomes happy together with her husband.

4.86.s:
ekonamarddhaśatamāpa ditiḥ sutānāṃ yena vratena balavīryasamanvitānām ..
martyaḥ samācarati putradhanābhilāṣī tatsarvamatra saphalaṃ bhavatīha puṃsaḥ .. 37 .. ..
abādhakavratavarṇanam
4.86.d:
एकोनमर्द्धशतमाप दितिः सुतानां येन व्रतेन बलवीर्यसमन्वितानाम् ॥
मर्त्यः समाचरति पुत्रधनाभिलाषी तत्सर्वमत्र सफलं भवतीह पुंसः ॥ 37 ॥ ॥
अबाधकव्रतवर्णनम्
4.86.m:
The votive observance through which Diti obtained forty-nine sons endowed with strength and valour,
if a mortal desiring sons and wealth performs it, all that bears fruit here for the man.
Description of the Abādhaka Votive Observance

4.87.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvācaḥ .. ..
kāṃtāravanadurgeṣu suprasannāṭavīṣu ca ..
samudrataraṇe dāne saṃgrāme taskarārdane .. 1 ..
4.87.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाचः ॥ ॥
कांतारवनदुर्गेषु सुप्रसन्नाटवीषु च ॥
समुद्रतरणे दाने संग्रामे तस्करार्दने ॥ 1 ॥
4.87.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
In impassable forest tracts and wildernesses, and in pleasant woods,
in crossing the ocean, in giving gifts, in battle, and in being oppressed by robbers,

4.87.s:
kāṃ devatāṃ smaretkṛṣṇa paritrāṇakarīmiha ..
kathaṃ ca devaḥ puruṣaḥ paritrāṇaṃ smṛto janaiḥ .. 2 ..
4.87.d:
कां देवतां स्मरेत्कृष्ण परित्राणकरीमिह ॥
कथं च देवः पुरुषः परित्राणं स्मृतो जनैः ॥ 2 ॥
4.87.m:
which deity should one remember here as the bringer of deliverance, O Kṛṣṇa?
And how is a divine person remembered by men for protection?

4.87.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyāṃ durgāṃ bhagavatīmimām ..
nāpnoti duḥkhaṃ puruṣaḥ saṃsmaransarvamaṅgalām ..3..
4.87.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
सर्वमंगलमांगल्यां दुर्गां भगवतीमिमाम् ॥
नाप्नोति दुःखं पुरुषः संस्मरन्सर्वमङ्गलाम् ॥3॥
4.87.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Remembering this blessed goddess Durgā, the auspiciousness of all that is auspicious,
remembering Sarvamaṅgalā, a man incurs no suffering.

4.87.s:
alakṣyāṃ lakṣyabhūtānāṃ saṃsmaransarvamaṃgalām ..4
bhayaṃ samavāpnoti puruṣaḥ pārtha kutracit .. 4 ..
4.87.d:
अलक्ष्यां लक्ष्यभूतानां संस्मरन्सर्वमंगलाम् ॥4
भयं समवाप्नोति पुरुषः पार्थ कुत्रचित् ॥ 4 ॥
4.87.m:
[Remembering her who is] imperceptible to visible beings, remembering Sarvamaṅgalā,
never does a man incur any fear anywhere, O son of Pṛthā.

4.87.s:
yadā tāṃ pratijijñāsuravaṃtyāmahamāgataḥ ..
purā saṃdīpaniḥ pārtha balena saha bhārata .. 5 ..
4.87.d:
यदा तां प्रतिजिज्ञासुरवंत्यामहमागतः ॥
पुरा संदीपनिः पार्थ बलेन सह भारत ॥ 5 ॥
4.87.m:
When, desiring to learn that, I came to Avantī
formerly with Bala, O Bhārata, to Sāndīpani, O son of Pṛthā,

4.87.s:
prāptavidyena ca mayā pratijñātāsya dakṣiṇā ..
divyaṃ stavaṃ viditvā me tenāhaṃ yācitaḥ prabho .. 6 ..
4.87.d:
प्राप्तविद्येन च मया प्रतिज्ञातास्य दक्षिणा ॥
दिव्यं स्तवं विदित्वा मे तेनाहं याचितः प्रभो ॥ 6 ॥
4.87.m:
and, having acquired learning, promised him his teacher's fee,
having known my divine hymn of praise, I was solicited by him, O lord:

4.87.s:
prabhāsatīrthe putro me gataḥ kenāpyasau hataḥ ..
tamānaya mahābāho satyaṃ kuru vaco mama .. 7 ..
4.87.d:
प्रभासतीर्थे पुत्रो मे गतः केनाप्यसौ हतः ॥
तमानय महाबाहो सत्यं कुरु वचो मम ॥ 7 ॥
4.87.m:
“My son went to Prabhāsatīrtha; he was slain by someone.
Bring him back, O mighty-armed one! Make my word true!”

4.87.s:
upādhyāyasya vacanādvaivasvatapure mayā ..
prāptaḥ saṃdīpaneḥ putraḥ samānītaḥ kṣaṇādasau .. 8 ..
4.87.d:
उपाध्यायस्य वचनाद्वैवस्वतपुरे मया ॥
प्राप्तः संदीपनेः पुत्रः समानीतः क्षणादसौ ॥ 8 ॥
4.87.m:
At the preceptor's instruction, in the city of the son of Vivasvat
Sāndīpani's son was recovered by me and brought back in an instant.

4.87.s:
dakṣiṇāṃ tāmudāhṛtya prasthitau punarāgatau ..
sthānametatsvapādāṃkaṃ kṛtvāvāṃ gṛhamāgatau ..9..
4.87.d:
दक्षिणां तामुदाहृत्य प्रस्थितौ पुनरागतौ ॥
स्थानमेतत्स्वपादांकं कृत्वावां गृहमागतौ ॥9॥
4.87.m:
Having offered that teacher's fee, the two of us departed and returned again;
having marked this spot with our footprints, the two of us came home.

4.87.s:
tataḥprabhṛti putrārthāḥ pūjayaṃti janāḥ sadā ..
māṃ caiva balabhadraṃ ca madhyasthāṃ sarvamaṃgalām .. 4.87.10 ..
4.87.d:
ततःप्रभृति पुत्रार्थाः पूजयंति जनाः सदा ॥
मां चैव बलभद्रं च मध्यस्थां सर्वमंगलाम् ॥ 4.87.10 ॥
4.87.m:
From that time forward, people desiring sons always worship
me and Balabhadra, and Sarvamaṅgalā situated in the middle.

4.87.s:
vāme nārāyaṇo haṃsa evameva ca ke bhavet ..
abādhakaṃ yorcayate tṛtīyaṃ kuṃtinadana .. 11 ..
4.87.d:
वामे नारायणो हंस एवमेव च के भवेत् ॥
अबाधकं योर्चयते तृतीयं कुंतिनदन ॥ 11 ॥
4.87.m:
On the left is Nārāyaṇa, the Haṃsa; and even so it shall be [for the deity] in the waters.
Whoever worships the third, Abādhaka, O son of Kuntī,

4.87.s:
trayodaśyāṃ site pakṣe māsimāsi yatavrataḥ ..
naktenaivopavāsena ekabhaktena vā punaḥ .. 12 ..
4.87.d:
त्रयोदश्यां सिते पक्षे मासिमासि यतव्रतः ॥
नक्तेनैवोपवासेन एकभक्तेन वा पुनः ॥ 12 ॥
4.87.m:
on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight, month after month, steadfast in the vow,
either with a nocturnal meal, or by fasting, or again with a single meal,

4.87.s:
gandhapuṣpaiśca madhubhiḥ sīdhubhiśca surāsavaiḥ ..
mṛnmayīṃ kāṃcanīṃ vāpi kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ tu yaḥ .. 13 ..
4.87.d:
गन्धपुष्पैश्च मधुभिः सीधुभिश्च सुरासवैः ॥
मृन्मयीं कांचनीं वापि कृत्वा प्रतिकृतिं तु यः ॥ 13 ॥
4.87.m:
with fragrant flowers, honeys, fermented juices, and spirituous liquors,
making an image of clay or of gold—he who

4.87.s:
yakṣagandhabalikṣepaiḥ palalaudanasaṃsṛjaiḥ ..
yo'bhbhyarcayati rājendra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 14 ..
4.87.d:
यक्षगन्धबलिक्षेपैः पललौदनसंसृजैः ॥
योऽभ्भ्यर्चयति राजेन्द्र सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ 14 ॥
4.87.m:
worships with offerings and gifts of yakṣa-perfume mixed with meat and cooked rice,
O best of kings, is freed from all sins.
Together with her husband, she is honoured in the heavenly world.

4.87.s:
aṃbāṃbike dvidaśame'hni site sadaiva yaḥ pūjayetkusumamāṃsasuropahāraiḥ ..
naśyaṃti tasya bhavaneṣvatibhīṣaṇāni caurāgnirājanitāni bhayāni sadyaḥ .. 16 .. ..
mandārakanimbārkavratavarṇanam
4.87.d:
अंबांबिके द्विदशमेऽह्नि सिते सदैव यः पूजयेत्कुसुममांससुरोपहारैः ॥
नश्यंति तस्य भवनेष्वतिभीषणानि चौराग्निराजनितानि भयानि सद्यः ॥ 16 ॥ ॥
मन्दारकनिम्बार्कव्रतवर्णनम्
4.87.m:
Whoever constantly worships Ambā and Ambikā on the tenth day of the bright fortnight with offerings of flowers, meat, and liquor,
for him, terrifying dangers arising from thieves, fire, and kings in his homes instantly vanish.
Description of the Mandāraka, Nimba, and Arka Votive Observance

4.88.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
brūhi me yaduśārdūla vrataṃ gandhavināśanam ..
kaṭutiktāmladehotthadaurbhāgyaśamanaṃ tathā..1.. 1 ..
4.88.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्रूहि मे यदुशार्दूल व्रतं गन्धविनाशनम् ॥
कटुतिक्ताम्लदेहोत्थदौर्भाग्यशमनं तथा॥1॥ 1 ॥
4.88.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell me, O tiger of the Yadus, of the votive observance that destroys bad odours
and likewise appeases the misfortune arising from the pungent, bitter, and sour in the body.

4.88.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
imaṃ praśnaṃ purā pārtha jātūkarṇyo mahāmuniḥ ..
pṛṣṭo rājñyā viṣṇubhaktyā kālanaṃdanajātayā .. 2 ..
4.88.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
इमं प्रश्नं पुरा पार्थ जातूकर्ण्यो महामुनिः ॥
पृष्टो राज्ञ्या विष्णुभक्त्या कालनंदनजातया ॥ 2 ॥
4.88.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Formerly, O son of Pṛthā, this question was asked of the great sage Jātūkarṇya
by the queen, born of Kālānandana, devoted to Viṣṇu.

4.88.s:
kathayāmāsa saṃpṛṣṭā sūpaviṣṭā śṛṇoti sā ..
devī kṛtāñjalipuṭā jātūkarṇyovadadvratam .. 3 ..
4.88.d:
कथयामास संपृष्टा सूपविष्टा शृणोति सा ॥
देवी कृताञ्जलिपुटा जातूकर्ण्योवदद्व्रतम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.88.m:
Being asked, he told it as she, well-seated, listened.
To the queen, with her hands folded in supplication, Jātūkarṇya spoke of the votive observance:

4.88.s:
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
snātvā puṇyanadītoye pūjayecchubhadeśajam ..4..
4.88.d:
ज्येष्ठे मासि सिते पक्षे त्रयोदश्यां युधिष्ठिर ॥
स्नात्वा पुण्यनदीतोये पूजयेच्छुभदेशजम् ॥4॥
4.88.m:
“In the month of Jyeṣṭha, on the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
having bathed in the water of a sacred river, one should worship, born in an auspicious land,

4.88.s:
śvetamaṃdāramarkaṃ vā karavīraṃ ca raktakam ..
niṃbaṃ ca sūryadevasya vallabhaṃ durlabhaṃ tathā ..5..
4.88.d:
श्वेतमंदारमर्कं वा करवीरं च रक्तकम् ॥
निंबं च सूर्यदेवस्य वल्लभं दुर्लभं तथा ॥5॥
4.88.m:
the white mandāra or arka, and the red karavīra,
and the nimba, dear to the sun god and hard to obtain,

4.88.s:
puṣpairnaivedyadhūpādyairmaṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava ..
nirīkṣya gagane sūryaṃ dhyātvā hṛdi samuccaret ..6..
4.88.d:
पुष्पैर्नैवेद्यधूपाद्यैर्मंत्रेणानेन पांडव ॥
निरीक्ष्य गगने सूर्यं ध्यात्वा हृदि समुच्चरेत् ॥6॥
4.88.m:
with flowers, food offerings, incense, and the like, by this mantra, O son of Pāṇḍu.
Looking at the sun in the sky and meditating [on him] in one's heart, one should recite:

4.88.s:
sūryaṃ śvetāramaṃdāraśvetārkāsyasaṃśayam ..
karavīra namastubhyaṃ niṃbavṛkṣa namo'stu te .. 7 ..
4.88.d:
सूर्यं श्वेतारमंदारश्वेतार्कास्यसंशयम् ॥
करवीर नमस्तुभ्यं निंबवृक्ष नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 7 ॥
4.88.m:
‘[O] Sun, white mandāra, and white arka without doubt!
O karavīra, homage to you! O nimba tree, homage be to you!’

4.88.s:
itthaṃ yorkapaterbhaktyā varṣevarṣe pṛthaṅ naraḥ ..
mūlamaṃtreṇa nṛśreṣṭha nārī vā bhaktisaṃyutā ..
tasyāḥ śarīradaurgandhyaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ vā ajāvikam ..6..
4.88.d:
इत्थं योर्कपतेर्भक्त्या वर्षेवर्षे पृथङ् नरः ॥
मूलमंत्रेण नृश्रेष्ठ नारी वा भक्तिसंयुता ॥
तस्याः शरीरदौर्गन्ध्यं दौर्भाग्यं वा अजाविकम् ॥6॥
4.88.m:
In this way, whoever with devotion to the lord of the arka [tree/sun], year after year, as a distinct man
[recites] with the basic mantra, O best of men, or a woman endowed with devotion—
her bodily foul odour or goat-and-sheep-like misfortune [is removed].

4.88.s:
niṃbaṃ navārkakaravīralatāṃ supuṣpāṃ yāḥ pūjayaṃti kusumākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ ..
tāḥ sarvakāmasukhabhogasamṛddhibhājo daurbhāgyadoṣarahitāḥ subhagā bhavaṃti ..9..
trayodaśīvratavarṇanam
4.88.d:
निंबं नवार्ककरवीरलतां सुपुष्पां याः पूजयंति कुसुमाक्षतधूपदीपैः ॥
ताः सर्वकामसुखभोगसमृद्धिभाजो दौर्भाग्यदोषरहिताः सुभगा भवंति ॥9॥
त्रयोदशीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.88.m:
The women who worship the nimba, the fresh arka, and the karavīra creeper bearing beautiful flowers with blossoms, unbroken grains, incense, and lamps
become sharers in prosperity, enjoying all desires and pleasures, free from the blemish of misfortune, and fortunate.”
Description of the Trayodaśī Votive Observance
